About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Groups & Events to lead our Groups Contracts and Groups Bookings teams. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in the details as much as in the strategy — someone who doesn't just oversee the work but genuinely understands it, can step into it, and uses that proximity to make the team and the customer experience meaningfully better every day.

You'll own the end-to-end support experience for group travel, from contract management through booking execution, and you'll bring the rare combination of operational depth, people leadership, and strategic clarity that this function requires. You know the workflows. You know where the friction lives. And you build the systems, the culture, and the team capability to eliminate it.

At Engine, we don't aim to meet industry benchmarks — we aim to make the industry benchmark against us. This role is for someone who holds themselves and their team to that standard.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop the Groups Contracts and Groups Bookings teams. You own performance, culture, and day-to-day operations across both teams. You develop your managers and leads with directness and intention — giving real feedback, building real capability, and creating the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers. The leaders who come up under you go on to run their own functions.

Be a player/coach and power user. You don't manage from a distance. You maintain deep, current working knowledge of end-to-end group handling — from initial inquiry and contract execution through booking confirmation and post-travel support. You can pull up a contract, work a complex case, navigate the systems your team uses every day, and identify exactly where the experience breaks down. Your proximity to the work is not occasional — it's how you lead. When a high-stakes situation arises, you're in it, not watching from the sidelines.

Drive continuous improvement relentlessly. You use data and direct observation to find problems before customers report them. You build feedback loops — from QA audits to coaching sessions to SOP rewrites to retraining cycles — and you close them. You don't flag issues and wait for someone else to fix them. You identify the root cause, build the solution, and measure whether it worked. Process improvement isn't a project for you — it's an operating mode.

Own the operational metrics. Establish baselines, track performance, and hold the team accountable to clear and measurable outcomes — booking conversion rate, L90 median timing, QA scores, SLA performance, and client satisfaction. You know which numbers matter, what's driving them, and what it takes to move them.

Manage BPO vendor performance. You have experience running BPO partnerships and you bring that discipline to the Groups function. You hold external partners to Engine's quality standards — not theirs — and you know the difference between a vendor that needs coaching and a vendor that needs accountability. You manage performance cadences, escalate when the bar isn't being met, and work with the OpEx Vendor Manager on contracts and transitions. You've been on the ground with a BPO partner and you know what good looks like at the agent level, not just the reporting level.

Be the senior escalation point. For complex group contracts, high-stakes client situations, and cross-functional issues that require experienced judgment — you're the person who gets the call. You resolve with speed and confidence, you document what happened and why, and you use every escalation as an input into making the system better.

Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with Sales, Account Management, and Finance to ensure group programs are set up for success and clients are supported throughout the lifecycle. You're not a handoff point — you're a genuine partner who brings operational insight into commercial conversations and vice versa.

Contribute to the broader Member Support strategy. Bring a groups-specific lens to decisions that affect the wider organization. You're a peer on the leadership team, not just a functional operator — and you use that seat to make Client Ops better across the board.

What We're Looking For

You are customer obsessed — operationally, not rhetorically. You read case transcripts. You sit with agents. You've called a hotel on behalf of a client to understand what the experience actually feels like on the other end. You treat friction in the customer journey as a personal problem to solve, and you build teams that feel the same way. For you, customer obsession isn't a value on a wall — it's visible in every process decision you make.

You are a true player/coach. You lead by modeling. You're not above rolling up your sleeves, working a complex group contract, or jumping on a call with a client when it matters. You set the standard by demonstrating it — and your team follows because they've seen you do the work, not just talk about it. At the same time, you know when to zoom out, when to delegate, and how to build the management layer that scales without you.

You have deep contact center and BPO management experience. You've run operations with BPO partners at meaningful scale — vendor selection, performance management, commercial negotiations, quality calibration, and transitions. You know how to get the best out of a BPO relationship and when to escalate. You've managed 24/7 or extended-hours operations and built the shift structures, coverage models, and escalation protocols that keep them running.

You are a continuous improvement practitioner. You've implemented process improvement frameworks — Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent — and you've seen them produce real, measurable outcomes. You don't accept "that's how we've always done it." You build feedback loops that actually close.

You develop people intentionally. Your direct reports get better under you. You give clear, direct feedback, invest in development, and build teams that are both high-performing and resilient. You're known for producing managers and leaders, not just executing tasks.

You set standards, you don't chase them. Industry benchmarks are a starting point, not a destination. You have strong opinions about what great looks like in group travel support, you build toward it with urgency, and you hold the line when the pressure is to cut corners.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 12+ years in travel operations, group travel support, or a closely related field — with at least 5 years in a director-level or senior leadership role
  • Hands-on expertise with group travel bookings and contract management — you understand the operational complexity because you've lived it
  • Proven BPO management experience — vendor performance management, quality standards enforcement, commercial negotiations, and operational transitions
  • A track record of driving measurable improvement in team performance, process efficiency, and customer satisfaction
  • Strong people leadership — you develop talent, give direct feedback, and build teams that are both high-performing and resilient
  • Experience operating at multiple altitudes — from reviewing a contract detail to presenting a quarterly operational review to senior leadership
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills with experience partnering with Sales, Account Management, and Finance
  • High attention to detail and strong operational instincts — you notice what's broken before it becomes a problem
  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the playbook is still being written

Bonus Points

  • Experience with GDS platforms (Travelport, Sabre, or similar) in a groups or corporate travel context
  • Background in building or scaling a groups support function from the ground up
  • Familiarity with RFP management, room block logistics, or hotel commission tracking
  • Experience designing or operating a premium or tiered support model
  • Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent process improvement credential

We're building something genuinely different in the travel industry — and the Groups function is one of the most visible and commercially meaningful ways we deliver on that. This role has real scope, real visibility, and a genuine opportunity to shape how Engine supports one of the more complex and high-touch parts of our business. You'll inherit a team that's already executing well — and have the mandate, the resources, and the executive support to take it to the next level. If you want to lead a function, build the standard, and make something meaningfully better — this is the role.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager of Integrations
jobs.excerpt: KarmaCheck is the leader in modern background checks and screenings for the staffing industry, pushing the boundaries of workflow automation.
jobs.description:
KarmaCheck is the leader in modern background checks and screenings for the staffing industry, pushing the boundaries of workflow automation. Our customers work in ATS, VMS, and HRIS platforms which utilize our integrations and API to run screening, verification, and credentialing workflows without switching systems.
We are building an AI workforce: agents that automate the compliance workflows our customers run. Those products reach their full value when they show up inside the systems our customers already use. Building an agent in our own dashboard is the first half of the work. Getting it into Bullhorn, Symplr CTM, Workday, or a customer's proprietary system is the unlock.
This role owns that unlock, alongside additional workflow automation development, and the day-to-day integration products our customers depend on. The ideal hire can commit to working Eastern Time (EST).

The surface you would own

  • Pre-built ATS, HRIS, and HCM integrations: Bullhorn, where KarmaCheck selects required checks based on job placement specifications and writes completed screenings back to the candidate record. KarmaCheck is the only background check integration in Bullhorn's investment portfolio. Symplr CTM, where teams order screenings, sync candidate data, and download completed documents directly from the candidate profile. Workday, delivering background check history, status updates, and results into the candidate's Workday record. WIth additional integrations existing and to come.
  • Service and technology partners: An ecosystem spanning VMS and direct sourcing providers, currently including Conexis, Simpliant, Bridge, Shiftrx, Livehire, Renhead, and Opus Match, supported by revenue-share and referral programs.
  • Public API: An API-first architecture where customers have access to the same calls we use thousands of times a day, with a deliberately broad endpoint surface, customer-mapped data fields, automated consumer report delivery, and support for most ATS, HRIS, HCM, and VMS platforms as well as homegrown systems.

What you will own

  • Taking what we build to market, technically. This is the part of the job that makes it more than integration creation and maintenance. As we release AI agents and new screening products, you own how they reach customers inside their own systems: what the integration story is for each one, which partner surfaces it needs to land on, what has to change in the API or the partner integration to support it, and how a customer actually turns it on. You will work in tandem with the product managers driving AI and new product development.
  • Integration product and partnerships. Ongoing ownership of the Bullhorn, Symplr CTM, and Workday integrations, the partner ecosystem, and whatever we take on next. You will define what integrating with KarmaCheck means: which data flows, how statuses map, how errors surface, what we standardize and where we accommodate a partner's model. You will work directly with partner product and engineering teams and own the roadmap for each integration rather than treating it as a one-time build.
  • Customer-facing implementation and scoping. You will be in front of customers regularly: integration discovery and solutions on new deals, scoping sessions during implementation, and the calls where a customer describes a workflow we do not yet support. Enterprise deals in healthcare staffing almost always hinge on an integration, and you will be the product voice in those conversations.
  • API and developer experience. Our public API and documentation are part of the product and often the first thing a technical buyer evaluates. You will own how they evolve in partnership with engineering: endpoint and webhook design, versioning and deprecation, error semantics, sandbox and testing experience, and documentation quality.
  • Support for Implementation and Support teams. Configuration and tooling that let Implementation stand up an integration without engineering involvement, clear enablement for Support, and a discipline of turning recurring issues into roadmap items rather than repeat manual fixes. The goal is that each launch requires less of Product and Engineering than the one before it.

The requirements we're looking for

  • 5+ years in product management, with meaningful time owning integrations, APIs, or platform products
  • Integration experience across multiple different systems. We care more about the breadth of patterns you have seen than about any one platform. If you arrive with strong instincts about how integrations should be built, mapped, versioned, and supported, you will be useful on day one
  • Direct experience owning partner or API integrations as an ongoing product rather than a project. You have made standardize-versus-accommodate calls and lived with the consequences
  • Genuine comfort in front of customers, including when the goal is to sell. You will demo products, communicate value, and position our capability from a place of strength with technical buyers and operations leaders, then stay with that customer through discovery, scoping, and implementation. Much of what moves deals in this business is carried by product people, and you will be one of them.
  • Technical fluency to work directly with engineers on APIs, webhooks, data models, and error handling. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should never need a translator
  • Ability to turn input from customers, partners, and internal teams into clear, written, prioritized requirements
  • Comfort working with external partner teams, including the diplomacy of influencing a roadmap you do not control

Helpful, and learnable here

  • Healthcare staffing, background screening, credentialing, or compliance. Domain depth matters in this business, but we would rather hire strong integration instincts and ramp the domain than the reverse
  • Credentialing or verification experience, particularly locum tenens/physicians, which is a direction we are moving
  • Familiarity with ATS, VMS, HCM, or HRIS ecosystems such as Bullhorn, Symplr, or Workday
  • Developer experience or API product work
  • Experience bringing AI or automation features into third-party systems

About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior SDET / Test Automation Engineer for a project based assignment to build the automated testing and release systems that ensure our products remain reliable as traffic, data volume, integrations, partners, and release velocity increase. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on test automation, API and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, and CI/CD quality gates within an AWS-based environment.
This is not a manual QA position. You will design and build reusable test infrastructure, automate critical product and partner workflows, create realistic performance scenarios, and provide engineering teams with clear evidence of whether a release is ready for production.
You will work closely with engineering teams and the Performance & Reliability Engineering Lead to ensure quality and scalability are built into the development lifecycle rather than treated as a final release checkpoint.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and evolve the automated testing architecture across products and engineering teams
  • Build and maintain automated API, integration, contract, end-to-end, regression, and UI tests where appropriate
  • Develop reusable test frameworks, fixtures, synthetic data, mocks, and environment strategies
  • Build automated testing for distributed services and integrations running within AWS environments
  • Design and execute load, stress, spike, soak, scalability, degradation, and recovery tests
  • Translate performance and capacity scenarios into repeatable automated test suites with measurable pass/fail thresholds
  • Model realistic workloads, concurrency levels, traffic patterns, data volumes, and dependency behavior
  • Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish enforceable quality and release gates
  • Create automated release checks tied to quality, latency, reliability, and performance thresholds
  • Establish practices for identifying, quarantining, diagnosing, and eliminating flaky tests
  • Improve test observability and failure reporting so engineers can quickly understand and diagnose issues
  • Build and maintain reliable test data and test environment strategies
  • Debug failures across APIs, services, databases, infrastructure, and external integrations
  • Partner with Performance & Reliability Engineering to validate scalability assumptions and production readiness
  • Partner with Security Engineering on permissions, isolation, negative-path, and abuse-related test scenarios
  • Track testing trends and help reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, manual release effort, and regression risk
  • Coach engineers on testability, automation, quality ownership, and defect-prevention practices

Required Skills:

  • Strong experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Test Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, or similar engineering-focused testing role
  • Strong software development and test automation skills
  • Experience testing APIs, distributed services, integrations, and cloud-based applications

jobs.description:
The Paid Media Strategist serves as the subject matter expert and strategic owner of paid media

performance across a portfolio of clients. This role is primarily focused on Paid Search and Paid Social

Advertising and may also involve Programmatic Display and other third-party platforms.

The Strategist is responsible for translating client business objectives into paid media strategy,

independently diagnosing performance, developing and optimizing campaigns, establishing testing

roadmaps, and identifying opportunities for growth both within and across channels.

Successful candidates will combine deep hands-on platform expertise with broader strategic

thinking. We are looking for someone who can determine what the strategy should be, not simply execute

a strategy developed by someone else.

Requirements

Client Strategy, Ownership and Communication

-Serve as the paid media subject matter expert and strategic owner for an assigned portfolio of clients.

-Develop a deep understanding of each client's business model, goals, customers, competitive

environment, and economics.

-Translate business objectives into clear paid media strategies, KPIs, channel roles, budgets, and testing

priorities.

-Independently audit new and existing accounts, diagnose performance issues, and develop prioritized

recommendations.

-Clearly articulate what is happening, why it is happening, and what we should do next.

-Identify growth opportunities beyond individual platforms, including opportunities involving creative,

landing pages, measurement, SEO, CRM, and other marketing channels.

-Effectively present strategy, performance, and recommendations to clients and internal teams.

-Create clear documentation and reporting that connects campaign performance to client business

objectives.

-Proactively identify risks and opportunities rather than waiting for client or account-management

direction.

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

-Develop, implement, and continuously optimize Paid Search and Paid Social strategies across a variety

of client types and business models.

-Demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in Google Ads and competency in at least one major Paid Social

platform, preferably Meta.

-Build appropriate campaign and account structures across Search, Shopping, Performance Max,

-Demand Gen, and other relevant campaign types.

-Understand when automated campaign types, bidding strategies, and audience expansion should or

should not be used.

-Develop cross-channel media plans that define the specific role of Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and

other relevant platforms within the customer journey.

-Recommend and continuously manage budget allocation based on business objectives, marginal

performance, customer acquisition economics, and channel opportunity.

-Evaluate platform-reported performance critically and understand the relationship between attribution,

incrementality, and actual business outcomes.

-Stay current on changes to advertising platforms, automation, and AI, and translate those developments

into actionable recommendations for clients.

Data Analysis, Measurement & Optimization

-Extract insights from campaign and business data, identify meaningful trends, diagnose performance

changes, and develop proactive recommendations.

-Understand the fundamentals of conversion tracking, GA4, Google Tag Manager, attribution, and offline

conversion measurement.

-Evaluate performance using appropriate business metrics such as ROAS, CAC/CPA, LTV, conversion

rate, revenue, qualified leads, and pipeline.

-Distinguish between platform performance and overall business performance when evaluating

campaign success.

-Develop structured optimization plans rather than relying solely on individual platform recommendations.

-Collaborate with analytics and measurement specialists when deeper technical implementation or

analysis is required.

Testing & Creative Strategy

-Develop structured testing roadmaps based on clear hypotheses and business objectives.

-Partner with creative teams to translate campaign performance into actionable creative

recommendations.

-Establish appropriate KPIs, budgets, and evaluation criteria for campaign, audience, messaging, and

creative tests.

-Use test results to generate actionable learnings and determine subsequent iterations.

-Understand the role creative plays across different platforms and stages of the customer journey.

Cross-Functional Leadership

-Collaborate with specialists across SEO, Creative, Analytics/Measurement, CRM, and other disciplines

to improve overall client outcomes.

-Recognize when a paid media performance issue originates outside the advertising platform and

proactively engage the appropriate specialists.

-Share platform knowledge, emerging best practices, and successful testing approaches with other

members of the Paid Media team.

-Contribute to agency-wide paid media methodologies, standards, and SOPs.

-Help establish repeatable frameworks for turning account audits and campaign data into comprehensive

client strategies.

Requirements

-Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

-3+ years of hands-on paid media experience at a digital marketing agency or similarly complex multi-

client environment.

-Demonstrated experience independently owning paid media strategy, not solely executing campaigns or

recommendations developed by others.

-Deep working knowledge of Google Ads, including Search, Shopping, and Performance Max.

-Hands-on experience with at least one major Paid Social platform, preferably Meta.

-Experience managing meaningful paid media budgets and making independent budget-allocation

decisions.

-Demonstrated ability to diagnose account performance and explain the underlying causes of

performance changes.

-Strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and digital measurement.

-Experience developing structured campaign, creative, or audience testing programs.

-Ability to translate platform data into clear business recommendations.

-Strong written and verbal communication skills and comfort presenting strategic recommendations to

clients.

-Ability to independently manage multiple clients, priorities, and deadlines.

  • 401(k) plus match, to help plan for your future
  • Paid time off (starting at 15 days), plus paid holidays, paid sick days, and paid personal days.
  • Flexible Fridays

  • Access to senior management and mentoring opportunities
  • Optional COVID safe company gatherings

jobs.title: Chief Actuary
jobs.excerpt: The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation.
jobs.description:
The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions—from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.

As a Chief Actuary, you will:

  • Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.
  • Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure.
  • Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead the annual Medicare Advantage bid strategy and pricing process, framing tradeoffs among growth, competitiveness, margin, risk, and capital requirements to support enterprise planning and executive decision-making.
  • Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.
  • Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.
  • Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.
  • Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense.
  • Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain actuarial governance, model review, documentation, control, and validation standards that support regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and sound executive decision-making.

Success in this role looks like:

First 90 Days

  • Build trusted relationships across Finance and key business partners.
  • Assess the current actuarial organization, tools, and operating model.
  • Develop a roadmap for AI adoption and workflow automation across the actuarial function.
  • Gain deep familiarity with Clover's pricing, forecasting, reserving, and medical economics processes.

First 6 Months

  • Begin implementing AI-enabled actuarial workflows that improve efficiency and insight generation.
  • Strengthen forecasting, reserving, and bid processes through improved automation and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Successfully assume ownership of additional actuarial responsibilities, including reserve oversight and governance.
  • Establish a clear long-term organizational vision for the actuarial function.

Long Term

  • Build one of the industry's most modern actuarial organizations by combining deep actuarial science with AI-enabled decision support.
  • Improve forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and enterprise decision-making through advanced analytics and automation.
  • Develop a highly engaged, high-performing actuarial team that is recognized as a strategic partner across the organization.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) and a Member of the American Academy of Actuaries.
  • You have significant leadership experience in Medicare Advantage actuarial functions, including pricing, reserving, forecasting, and bid development.
  • You are an AI evangelist and have demonstrated experience deploying AI workflows across your functional areas. Moreover, you are enthusiastic about applying automation and modern tooling to fundamentally improve the actuarial function.
  • You have experience leading large, cross-functional initiatives that influence executive decision-making.
  • You are equally comfortable discussing actuarial methodology with technical experts and communicating business implications to executives and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have a track record of building, mentoring, and developing high-performing actuarial teams.
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments where you can build, innovate, and shape the future of an organization.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are anE-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

Senior Support Network Engineer – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Support Network Engineer to support and maintain ISP and fixed wireless network infrastructure while delivering exceptional technical support to U.S.-based B2B customers.

This is a customer-facing role requiring strong networking expertise, excellent communication skills, and hands-on experience with wireless networking technologies, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting. You’ll play a key role in maintaining high network availability, resolving technical issues, and supporting mission-critical connectivity solutions.

What You’ll Do

Network Operations & Support

  • Provide technical support to U.S.-based B2B customers.
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot MikroTik and Cisco routers and switches across core and edge ISP networks.
  • Monitor network performance, resolve outages, and ensure high network availability.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex network issues in a timely manner.

Fixed Wireless Infrastructure

  • Plan, deploy, and troubleshoot Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) infrastructure.
  • Support Point-to-Point (PTP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP) wireless links.
  • Work with wireless platforms including:
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti / UniFi
    • Aviat
    • Siklu / Ceragon
  • Support fixed wireless, managed Wi-Fi, Starlink, and wireless mesh/backhaul solutions.

Routing & Network Management

  • Implement and maintain dynamic routing protocols, including:
    • OSPF
    • BGP
  • Maintain reliable routing across ISP network infrastructure.
  • Support network performance optimization and stability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Flawless written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Previous experience in customer-facing technical support roles.
  • Hands-on experience with fixed wireless/WISP technologies, including:
    • Starlink
    • Managed Wi-Fi
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti / UniFi
    • Siklu / Ceragon
  • Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting MikroTik and Cisco networking equipment.
  • Experience implementing and supporting OSPF and BGP.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting PTP and PTMP wireless networks.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud networking in AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar platforms.
  • ITSM experience, preferably with Salesforce.
  • Experience with:
    • Starlink
    • 4G/5G networking
    • Peplink SD-WAN
  • Network certifications such as:
    • CCNA
    • Network+
    • Equivalent certifications

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Monitor network health and respond to customer support requests.
  • Troubleshoot routing, switching, and wireless connectivity issues.
  • Configure and maintain MikroTik and Cisco network devices.
  • Support fixed wireless infrastructure and resolve outages.
  • Work directly with customers to diagnose and resolve technical issues.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to maintain reliable network operations.

In short: You’ll support, troubleshoot, and optimize ISP and fixed wireless network infrastructure while delivering exceptional technical support to B2B customers.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Technical Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your networking experience, and highlight your expertise with fixed wireless technologies, MikroTik, Cisco, routing protocols, and customer support. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about networking, wireless infrastructure, and delivering outstanding customer support, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join a team dedicated to building and maintaining reliable network solutions.

This Role Might Fit You If

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a heads-down coding role. If you want to stay out of product and business conversations, this will frustrate you.

jobs.description:
Die APT-ONE GmbH in Berlin ist ein auf Cyber Security spezialisiertes Beratungshaus. Wir schützen die IT-, OT-, Cloud- und KI-Systeme unserer Kunden wirksam vor digitalen Bedrohungen.

Unser Ansatz ist anders: KI-gestützte Werkzeuge übernehmen Discovery, Routine-Analysen und Mustererkennung – unsere Berater:innen validieren, interpretieren und konzentrieren sich auf Strategie und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Das ergibt tiefere Analysen und belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen in kürzerer Zeit, bei 40–60 % weniger Aufwand für Routinearbeit.

KI nur mit höchster Sensibilität für Kundendaten: Datenschutz steht über jedem Effizienzgewinn. KI ausschließlich auf vertraglich abgesicherten, datenschutzkonformen Plattformen, minimierte und anonymisierte Daten, niemals Kundendaten im Modelltraining. Diesen Umgang – und die Bereitschaft,
unsere Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich mit KI weiterzuentwickeln – erwarten wir von allen Berater:innen.

Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle ist Detection Engineering: SIEM- und XDR-Plattformen, Log-Qualität, Detectionas-Code und Automatisierung – sicher in KQL, Sigma und MITRE ATT&CK.

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn:

  • du ein attraktives Fixgehalt plus überdurchschnittliche Gewinnbeteiligung willst.
  • du ortsunabhängig an hochrelevanten Projekten in Security Operations und KI-Sicherheit arbeiten willst.
  • du KI als Hebel siehst und Sicherheitsberatung neu denken willst – ohne Kompromisse beim Datenschutz.
  • du deine Expertise in SOC-Plattformen, Detection Engineering und Automatisierung ausbauen willst.

Aufgaben

  • Aufbau, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung von SOC-Plattformen (SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR)
  • Onboarding neuer Logquellen inklusive Parsing, Normalisierung und Sicherstellung der Datenqualität
  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von Detection-Regeln und Use Cases (Sigma, KQL, SPL) auf Basis von MITRE ATT&CK
  • Automatisierung von Analyse- und Response-Prozessen durch Playbooks und Skripting (Python, PowerShell)
  • Aufbau von Detection-as-Code-Pipelines inkl. Versionierung, Testing und CI/CD
  • Integration und Operationalisierung von Threat Intelligence
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Analyst:innen und Incident Respondern zur Reduktion von False Positives und Verbesserung der Detection-Qualität
  • Technische Unterstützung bei Sicherheitsvorfällen
  • Erstellung von Runbooks, Use-Case-Dokumentationen und technischen Konzepten
  • Einsatz KI-gestützter Werkzeuge für Log-Analyse, Regel- und Playbook-Entwürfe sowie Dokumentation – inklusive fachlicher Validierung und Freigabe der Ergebnisse

Qualifikation

  • Souveräner Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen im Beratungsalltag inkl. kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse
  • Ausgeprägtes Bewusstsein für Vertraulichkeit beim KI-Einsatz: Du weißt, welche Daten in welches System dürfen, und kennst die Risiken (Datenabfluss, Modelltraining, Prompt Injection)
  • Bereitschaft, Prozesse und Produkte kontinuierlich KI-basiert weiterzuentwickeln
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in IT-/Cyber-Security, davon mehrere Jahre in Architektur- oder Beratungsrollen
  • Breites Technologieverständnis über Netzwerk, Endpoint, Identity, Applikation und Cloud
  • Erfahrung mit Zero-Trust- und Segmentierungskonzepten sowie IAM/PAM (Entra ID, Active Directory)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, SABSA/TOGAF
  • Kenntnisse in Kryptografie, PKI und sicherem Applikationsdesign
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Von großem Vorteil:

  • Cloud-Architekten-Know-how: Design, Absicherung und Betrieb von Cloud- und Hybrid-Umgebungen (Azure, AWS, GCP), Cloud-native Security-Dienste, Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Erfahrung mit Prompt Engineering, KI-Agenten oder LLM-Integration in Workflows
  • Kenntnisse in KI-Governance (EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM)
  • Erfahrung in regulierten Umgebungen (KRITIS, Finanzsektor, Industrie/OT)

OffSec (Hands-on & Offensive/Defensive Integration)

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Remote-Arbeit, 30 Tage Urlaub
  • IT-Equipment wie Apple MacBook
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents

About Gladly

For business leaders who want to get AI right, Gladly is the only customer experience AI that delivers the cost savings they need AND the customer devotion that drives lasting business value. With over a decade of singular CX focus and trusted by the world's most customer-centric brands including Crate & Barrel, Breeze Airways, and Ulta Beauty, Gladly was designed for devotion, not deflection: purpose-built to engage customers and turn every conversation into lasting relationship equity. The result is experiences that are radically personal and effortlessly scalable, emotionally intelligent and operationally efficient.

At the heart of our simply powerful platform, Gladly maintains one continuous conversation across all channels while striking the perfect balance of AI and human connection. With 450M+ conversations powered globally, $510M+ cumulative cost savings delivered for customers, and a 65% increase in CSAT, this is a team where your work has real impact at scale. Learn more at.

The Team

The AI Deployment Engineering team is the tip of the spear for every new AI rollout at Gladly, working hands-on with our most strategic customers to implement, optimize, and expand their use of our AI. The culture is collaborative and experimental: we solve hard problems together, so this is no place for a lone wolf. You will report to the Manager of AI Delivery and partner closely with Implementation Managers, Professional Services Engineering, and Solution Engineering.

The Opportunity

This role puts you at the center of how Gladly’s top brands adopt AI. You will design AI use cases, build the integrations and workflows behind them, and continuously optimize for the highest possible resolution rates. The goal is simple and high-stakes: help customers automate more of their customer experience, reduce handle time, and get measurably more value from Gladly’s AI all while building end consumer devotion.

You are technical enough to build on your own and polished enough to lead the customer conversation. You can decompose a vague request into a concrete plan, connect the APIs, write the actions, workflows and guides that make the AI useful, and explain it all back to the customer in plain language. You hold yourself accountable, communicate proactively, and are energized by ambiguity and new technology.

Because this is an emerging discipline, you will help write Gladly’s playbook for what a great AI deployment looks like. It is highly technical and highly customer-facing, and that balance is exactly what makes it work.

We’re looking for someone with a passion for working directly with APIs, java script and AI the curiosity to solve complex problems, and the initiative to thrive in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

What You’ll Do

Solution Design & Business Analysis

  • Partner with customers to decompose ambiguous goals into concrete, buildable AI use cases, uncovering hidden complexity and edge cases along the way.
  • Determine whether the data a use case needs is available, identify the right APIs or MCP sources, and secure access.

Integration & Technical Build

  • Use Gladly’s CLI to register APIs on the App Platform, making customer data accessible to Gladly AI and agents.
  • Write app actions in JavaScript to condense large API payloads down to the fields the AI actually needs.
  • Build the workflows and guides that tell Gladly’s AI how to use that information and respond to the customer.

Optimization & Customer Success

  • Own use cases end to end after launch: monitor performance, optimize, and build new use cases that lift assist and resolution rates.
  • Give proactive status updates to customers and the internal team, and partner with SAMs and Implementation Managers to keep goals and timelines aligned.
  • Participate in QBRs and EBRs to show progress and ensure customers are getting measurable value.

Pre-Sales & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering on pre-sales demos, and pull in Professional Services Engineering for the most complex custom work.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions or sales engineering, support engineering, professional services, or forward-deployed engineering, ideally in SaaS, AI, or CX technology.
  • Hands-on technical ability: you can read an API payload and write JavaScript to transform it, you understand REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks, and you are comfortable in a CLI. You build things yourself rather than handing them off.
  • Strong business analysis skills: you turn an ambiguous customer goal into clear requirements and a workable solution design.
  • Exceptional English communication (C1-C2 / business fluent), with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and an aptitude for prompt engineering and workflow design.
  • Accountability and proactivity: you make commitments, keep them, communicate status without being asked, and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Based in Colombia, able to work core US business hours or with significant overlap.
  • CX, contact center, or CX SaaS background is a strong plus. Forward-deployed or deployment engineering experience at an AI company is a bonus.

Salary for this role: $40,000 - $54,000 USD (may be paid in USD or COL pesos, depending on COR or EOR contract options - but this is a full-time opportunity)

The cash compensation above includes base salary, and is not reflective of potential commission for employees in eligible roles, or annual bonus targets under Gladly’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, all Gladly’s employees are eligible to participate in Gladly’s equity incentive plan to receive stock options per the terms of the agreement. Individual compensation packages are based on a few different factors unique to each candidate, including their career level, skills, experience, specific geographic location qualifications and other job-related reasons.

Why Join Gladly?

Gladly is redefining customer experience AI; we're designed for devotion, not deflection. We put people at the center of everything we build, from our platform to our culture. When you join us, you'll enjoy:

  • Competitive salaries, stock options, and comprehensive benefits
  • Generous paid time off, parental leave, and home office stipends
  • A fully remote work environment with opportunities for in-person team gatherings
  • A strong commitment to professional growth and an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives thrive
  • A company where AI is not a buzzword. We build AI products and we expect our team to use AI tools daily

We're a team that believes in transparency, collaboration, and the idea that the best work happens when talented people genuinely enjoy working together. Top talent, good vibes, no politics. If this role excites you but you don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. The perspectives and experiences you bring matter more than checking every box.

jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role Deliver high-quality audit and assurance services to clients while exceeding their expectations through technical excellence, speed, and clear communication.

Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months

  • Outcome 1: Independent Audit Execution
    • Independently plan, execute, and complete end-to-end audit assignments for a portfolio of international and local client accounts within target timelines.
  • Outcome 2: Audit Reporting & Financial Statements
    • Prepare comprehensive audit reports and financial statements in strict accordance with SME-FRF / SME-FRS standards.
  • Outcome 3: Tax Filing & Regulatory Compliance
    • Accurately prepare and review tax computations and profits tax returns for clients to ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Outcome 4: Deadline & Workflow Ownership
    • Manage multiple client engagements simultaneously under tight deadlines, ensuring data accuracy and proactive issue resolution.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 2 years of solid audit experience within a professional accounting or audit firm.
  • Prior experience working with Big 4 firms or mid-tier equivalents is highly preferred.
  • Passed CPA professional qualification exams (HKICPA, CPA Australia, ACCA, CICPA, or equivalent recognized qualification) is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience in preparing audit files and reports using SME-FRF / SME-FRS standards.
  • Proven track record of managing end-to-end audit assignments independently and handling client queries directly.

Must-have attributes

  • Ownership: Takes full accountability for audit files from planning through sign-off; proactively resolves roadblocks to hit tight delivery deadlines without needing constant oversight.
  • Humility: Open-minded to feedback, eager to learn evolving tech tools, and willing to collaborate with diverse, cross-functional teams with emotional intelligence.
  • Structured Thinking & Sound Judgement: Applies sound logical reasoning and structured problem-solving when evaluating complex financial records and audit risks.
  • Data-Driven: Leverages quantitative financial data, analytics tools, and precise figures to back up audit findings and technical positions.
  • Positive & Courageous Communication: Able to navigate tough conversations with clients or colleagues in a constructive, empathetic, and solution-oriented manner.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

  • Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
  • Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  • Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  • Attention to detail: You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.
  • Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

  • One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to evaluate communication skills and key background details early in the process.
  • Technical Round: A 30-minute technical evaluation with the Audit Hiring Team and a 30-minute interview with the Audit Partner, focusing on your knowledge of SME-FRS standards, audit procedures, tax computations, and case scenarios.
  • Soft Skills Round: A 45-to-60-minute interview with a member of leadership to explore your work style, structured thinking, and alignment with Sleek’s core behavioral values.
  • Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct professional reference checks with your recent direct manager or supervisor.

Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.description:
Lumenci is seeking a GTM & Customer Success Lead – AI Platform to help launch, commercialize, and scale across law firms, enterprise corporations, and litigation funders. This is a hybrid, customer-facing leadership role that owns the customer journey from pre-sales discovery through onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion, while helping shape go-to-market strategy for a next-generation AI-powered patent intelligence platform.


About Lumenci
Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a premier intellectual property consulting firm specialising in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetisation for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis — including reverse engineering and source-code review — and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumOS platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients across the US, Europe, Asia, and Latin America. We have analysed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,000 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Lumenci is recognised in the IAM 300 and is Vault Top Ranked. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetisation execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly — our US team expanded 42% over the past year.


Employment Type: Full-time, exempt
Work Arrangement: Remote (possibility to work Hybrid from our Austin office)
Location: US-based Remote

This role may require approximately domestic travel for client meetings, internal strategy sessions, and product/market events.

Role Overview
Lumenci is seeking a GTM & Customer Success Lead – AI Platform to help launch, commercialize, and scale a next-generation AI-powered patent intelligence platform, across law firms, enterprise corporations, and litigation funders. This highly strategic, customer-facing role owns the full customer journey for iLumos, from pre-sales discovery and pilots through onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. This role sits at the intersection of product, go-to-market, customer success, consulting services, and enterprise AI adoption, partnering closely with leadership to drive product-market fit and recurring revenue growth. Over time, this role will help define and build the GTM and customer success function for iLumos, including establishing repeatable processes and, as the business scales, participating in future team hiring and structure.

You will work directly with the Vice President of Product, AI Platform & IP Intelligence and cross-functional teams to design and execute pilot programs, lead customer onboarding, drive AI-enabled workflow adoption, and convert successful usage into scalable commercial engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Sales, Pilots, and Commercialization

Go-to-Market Strategy and Market Intelligence

  • Partner with Lumenci leadership to refine iLumos go-to-market strategy across legal, IP, and enterprise segments.

  • Help define ideal customer profiles, target accounts, and high-value early adopter segments.

  • Contribute to product positioning, messaging, and commercialization strategy based on customer and market feedback.

  • Gather structured market intelligence, customer discovery insights, and competitive observations to inform product roadmap and GTM decisions.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across product, engineering, consulting, sales, and executive leadership teams.

  • Lay the foundations for a scalable GTM and customer success function for iLumos, including playbooks, processes, and, in later phases, input into team structure and hiring.

Who You Are
You are a customer-centric, commercially minded operator who thrives in fast-paced, evolving product environments. You are comfortable in pre-sales discovery conversations, onboarding sessions with end users, strategic reviews with executive sponsors, and cross-functional discussions with product and consulting teams. You know how to connect pre-sales strategy, onboarding design, and ongoing customer success into one cohesive experience that drives both customer value and revenue growth.

Required Qualifications

  • 6–12+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: enterprise SaaS, AI platforms, legal technology, customer success, solutions consulting, product go-to-market, consulting, or product commercialization.

  • Proven experience in customer-facing roles that span onboarding, adoption, strategic account management, and/or pre-sales support.

Preferred Qualifications

Key Traits for Success

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
Modelo de trabalho:

📍Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto

Sobre o time:

O Time de Dados é o alicerce estratégico que transforma dados brutos em inteligência competitiva. Atuamos na fronteira entre tecnologia e negócio, garantindo que a informação seja confiável, acessível e performática e, agora, a fundação de dados para a nossa próxima fronteira: a inteligência artificial generativa aplicada ao negócio. Nosso desafio é construir uma camada de dados robusta que sirva de combustível para que os times de Analytics e Data Science extraiam o máximo valor da nossa plataforma, suportando o crescimento acelerado da companhia com governança e eficiência.

Desafios da posição:

Sua missão será ser a referência técnica em engenharia de dados dentro da GCP, responsável pela espinha dorsal que sustenta todo o consumo analítico da empresa. Você vai arquitetar e implementar pipelines de ingestão e processamento — batch e near real time — sobre BigQuery, definindo os padrões de orquestração, versionamento e infraestrutura como código que o restante do time passa a seguir. Não se trata apenas de entregar pipelines: é desenhar as fundações, os contratos de dados e as ferramentas internas que tornam cada nova fonte e cada novo caso de uso mais barato de construir do que o anterior.

O desafio central é elevar a maturidade da nossa plataforma de dados e preparar o terreno para a nossa estratégia de IA, garantindo confiabilidade, observabilidade e previsibilidade de custo em escala. Você vai construir a camada de base sobre a qual analytics engineers, cientistas de dados e agentes de IA operam com autonomia — com linhagem rastreável, frescor monitorado e acesso governado. Ao final, seja um dashboard, um modelo ou um agente autônomo consumindo os dados, a fonte da informação será única, performática e confiável.


Seu dia a dia na Conta Simples:

  • Arquitetar e manter a plataforma de dados na GCP, definindo os padrões de ingestão, processamento e orquestração que sustentam todo o consumo analítico da empresa — de dashboards a agentes de IA.
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de ingestão batch e near real time a partir de bancos transacionais, APIs e eventos, garantindo que novas fontes entrem no BigQuery de forma padronizada e com esforço decrescente.
  • Estabelecer contratos de dados e governança de schema, protegendo as camadas de consumo de quebras em upstream e tornando explícito o acordo entre quem produz e quem consome dados.
  • Implementar observabilidade de dados ponta a ponta — linhagem, frescor, volume e alertas —, para que falhas sejam detectadas pelo time antes de chegarem ao negócio.
  • Tratar infraestrutura como produto, versionando recursos em Terraform, mantendo pipelines de CI/CD e reduzindo o caminho entre uma ideia e um dado disponível em produção.
  • Otimizar performance e custo no BigQuery em escala, definindo estratégias de particionamento, clusterização, reservas e monitoramento de consumo para que o crescimento da empresa não vire crescimento proporcional de custo.
  • Garantir segurança e privacidade dos dados, implementando controles de acesso, mascaramento e políticas de retenção compatíveis com um ambiente financeiro regulado.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentor do time, conduzindo decisões de arquitetura, revisões de código e a disseminação de boas práticas de engenharia aplicadas a dados.
  • Colaborar diretamente com Analytics Engineering e Data Science, oferecendo a base e as ferramentas para que essas pessoas trabalhem com autonomia, sem depender de você para cada nova entrega.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Senioridade técnica para tomar decisões de arquitetura com trade-offs explícitos e influenciar times além do seu próprio.
  • Domínio em SQL: capacidade de escrever e depurar queries complexas, performáticas e legíveis.
  • Experiência sólida em Python aplicado a dados: construção de pipelines, integrações com APIs e ferramentas internas — com testes e código de qualidade de produção.
  • Ecossistema GCP: vivência prática com BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub e serviços de processamento (Dataflow, Dataproc ou equivalentes).
  • Orquestração: experiência com Airflow/Cloud Composer, incluindo idempotência, backfills e gestão de dependências.
  • Infraestrutura como código e cultura de engenharia: Terraform, Git/GitHub, CI/CD e Code Review como prática cotidiana.
  • Modelagem de dados: entendimento de Data Warehousing e modelagem dimensional o suficiente para desenhar camadas que sirvam bem a quem consome.
  • Experiência com Dataform ou dbt e com o ciclo de vida de transformações versionadas.
  • Confiabilidade e qualidade: prática em testes automatizados de dados, monitoramento e resposta a incidentes.

Será diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com processamento em streaming (Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Kafka ou Flink) em cenários de baixa latência.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de plataforma de dados: data mesh, catálogo e discovery, self-service para times de negócio.
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de dados para RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): estruturação de dados e metadados para otimizar a recuperação e o contexto de informações por LLMs.
  • Experiência com Kubernetes, containers e práticas de SRE aplicadas a pipelines de dados.
  • Vivência no setor financeiro ou fintechs, incluindo requisitos de compliance e auditoria.

Informações adicionais

The NitroAI team is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to take dedicated ownership of our business consulting teams’ analytics infrastructure — an AWS and Kubernetes platform that’s ready for a focused engineering owner.     • Follow the application process and submit your resume.

    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

Two Chairs is building a new kind of mental health system based on the idea that the status quo isn’t good enough. Industry-best clinician experiences, better client outcomes, groundbreaking innovation, and access to the highest quality care are how we’ll raise the bar for the entire industry. One of our company values is "Embrace Differences" and diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are the principles guiding how we build our business and teams. We encourage interested candidates from all backgrounds to apply even if they don't think they meet some expectations of the role.

Why Two Chairs is consistently a Great Place to Work

  • Competitive Pay: Earn a total hourly rate of $62–$81 (guaranteed base + incentive potential), paid semi-monthly. Base rate determined by clinical experience, place of residence, and overall qualifications.
  • Truly Flexible Work: Work remotely with a schedule that fits your life: no nights, no weekends, no on-call responsibilities. We also provide paid administrative time so documentation doesn’t follow you home.
  • Mission-Driven, Clinician-Led: We’re dedicated to creating a world where everyone has access to exceptional mental healthcare. Clinical decisions are made by clinicians for clinicians, ensuring you’re supported by a team that is focused on centering the client and enabling clinicians to deliver exceptional care.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct 60-minute psychiatry assessments and 30 minute follow-up sessions remotely.

You will have established a robust caseload of clients and delivered exceptional care, as evidenced by clinical outcomes. You will have made contributions to our program and to a world where everyone has access to exceptional mental health care.
