Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why this job matters:

Serves as a hands-on technical resource responsible for engineering, implementing, optimizing, automating, and supporting enterprise data platforms and database technologies. Accountable for translating data architecture and product roadmap requirements into scalable, secure, highly available, and operationally supportable solutions across enterprise data platforms. Partners closely with the Data Platform Operations Manager to ensure platform standards, operational best practices, security requirements, governance controls, automation practices, and support processes are consistently implemented across the data platform ecosystem. Provides senior technical leadership for complex initiatives, platform modernization efforts, cloud adoption programs, performance optimization activities, operational engineering, and Level 3 production support.

Platform scope: Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server on Azure VM, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EDB Postgres, Oracle databases and Oracle-based data platforms, IBM Netezza, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric where applicable, Azure-native data services, data integration technologies, analytical platforms, enterprise reporting and BI environments, and Salesforce Data Cloud knowledge where applicable.

What you will do:

  • Design, engineer, implement, configure, and support enterprise database and cloud data platform solutions supporting operational, analytical, reporting, and data integration workloads.
  • Partner with Data Architects to translate target-state architectures, technology roadmaps, modernization initiatives, and business requirements into implementable engineering designs and operationally sustainable solutions.
  • Lead hands-on implementation and support activities across Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, and related enterprise data platforms.
  • Serve as a senior technical contributor supporting both project delivery and ongoing operational platform needs.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure, platform configurations, deployment standards, automation routines, and operational processes that improve platform reliability, scalability, security, performance, and supportability.
  • Engineer database platform solutions that align with enterprise security, data governance, compliance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational standards.
  • Implement and maintain database security controls, authentication methods, RBAC models, service account governance, encryption capabilities, access controls, and audit requirements.
  • Design and support highly available and resilient platform architectures including backup, recovery, replication, failover, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities.
  • Provide senior-level troubleshooting and Level 3 support for complex platform incidents, performance issues, integration failures, data integrity concerns, security events, and critical production outages.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for recurring operational issues and implement permanent corrective actions to improve long-term platform stability.
  • Partner with the Data Platform Operations team to establish operational runbooks, monitoring standards, support procedures, escalation models, and automation opportunities.
  • Monitor and optimize database performance, query execution, storage utilization, warehouse consumption, platform scaling, indexing strategies, and workload management.
  • Support analytical platform workloads, reporting environments, Power BI integrations, ETL/ELT pipelines, data engineering solutions, and enterprise data consumption patterns.
  • Design and implement automated provisioning, environment refreshes, cloning processes, administrative workflows, monitoring integrations, and recurring operational activities.
  • Support database deployment pipelines, CI/CD processes, release activities, change management reviews, and production readiness assessments.
  • Review solution designs, data models, engineering approaches, and platform usage patterns to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
  • Participate in technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and emerging platform assessments to support modernization and innovation initiatives.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers, database administrators, contractors, and platform support personnel.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, architecture, application development, analytics, and vendor teams to coordinate platform implementations and support activities.
  • Support cloud migration initiatives, platform modernization programs, database consolidation efforts, and data platform transformation projects.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation including engineering designs, implementation guides, support procedures, platform standards, architecture diagrams, operational documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements for operational efficiency, platform architecture, automation, governance, security, performance, and cost optimization.
  • Stay current on advancements in database technologies, cloud-native data services, Snowflake capabilities, Microsoft data platforms, Oracle technologies, PostgreSQL ecosystems, Salesforce Data Cloud, and emerging data engineering practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5-7 years of experience supporting, engineering, administering, or developing enterprise database and data platform technologies.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with multiple enterprise database platforms, cloud data services, or analytical data technologies.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting production-grade data platform solutions within medium to large enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production systems with responsibilities spanning performance, availability, security, reliability, and incident response.
  • Strong technical knowledge of relational database platforms including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and cloud-native database services.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake architecture, administration, performance tuning, security, RBAC, warehouses, storage optimization, replication, and platform automation.
  • Knowledge of modern cloud data platforms including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, and data warehouse architectures.
  • Strong understanding of database internals, query tuning, indexing strategies, partitioning, storage management, statistics management, workload optimization, and performance engineering.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale analytical and reporting environments.
  • Understanding of data integration patterns, ETL/ELT architectures, API integration concepts, and data movement technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of data security, governance, compliance, privacy controls, auditability requirements, and least-privilege access principles.
  • Experience designing and supporting backup, recovery, replication, disaster recovery, high-availability, and business continuity capabilities.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues affecting databases, cloud data services, reporting platforms, analytics environments, integrations, and application systems.
  • Experience working with monitoring and observability platforms including Grafana, Azure Monitor, Snowflake monitoring capabilities, and database performance tools.
  • Understanding of DevOps and DataOps principles, including source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, configuration management, and release governance.
  • Ability to automate operational tasks using scripting languages, APIs, infrastructure automation frameworks, database-native automation tools, and cloud automation capabilities.
  • Experience supporting hybrid environments containing legacy, on-premises, hosted, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Ability to interpret architecture standards and implement engineering solutions that align with strategic technology objectives.
  • Ability to identify technical risks, operational gaps, capacity constraints, performance concerns, and supportability issues while recommending practical remediation plans.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with architects, engineers, DBAs, developers, product owners, project teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and technology leadership.
  • Ability to mentor technical team members and promote engineering excellence, operational discipline, documentation quality, and adoption of best practices.
  • Comfortable operating within Agile, DevOps, Waterfall, hybrid, and governance-driven delivery models.
  • Ability to balance project delivery responsibilities with operational support, production stability, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The extras:

  • Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Experience working within healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience with Snowflake platform engineering and administration.
  • Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure-native data services, and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with Oracle database platforms, PostgreSQL, EDB Postgres, and SQL Server administration and engineering.
  • Experience with data warehousing, dimensional modeling, data lake architectures, ELT/ETL platforms, and modern analytics ecosystems.
  • Experience with DataOps, DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native operational practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, customer data platforms, customer identity solutions, or enterprise data activation platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or other BI environments.
  • Relevant certifications in Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, cloud engineering, data engineering, or related technologies.

Location:
BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:

  • In-office: onsite 5 days per week
  • Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
  • Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia

Reporting directly to the Director of Price Realization Strategy, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for shaping global pricing and discounting frameworks, build and design executive-facing dashboards, and optimizing revenue performance across our entire product portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Shape & Drive Pricing Strategy: Architect and execute price optimization models that accelerate business performance. You will blend price elasticity, competitive differentiation, and deep financial analysis into actionable monetization frameworks.
  • Lead PLG & Self-Service Monetization: Partner directly with Growth Marketing, Self-service Sales, Console Engineering, and Finance teams to align on product-led growth (PLG) strategies, ensuring seamless pricing execution across digital touchpoints.
  • Analytics Design: Own the design, optimization, and scaling of advanced pricing analytics dashboards (Tableau/Looker) and operational workflows. Turn complex data infrastructure into strategic tools that enhance efficiency and maximize profitability.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Act as a critical bridge and internal champion across GTM Strategy, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to ensure organizational alignment and flawless execution of new pricing initiatives.

While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Real Estate Acquisition Specialist – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Compensation: $1,500–$2,000 USD/month + Performance Bonuses

About the Role

We’re hiring a Real Estate Acquisition Specialist to convert inbound seller leads into signed real estate contracts.

This is a phone-intensive, consultative sales role for someone with direct experience in real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, FSBO, Subject-To, or distressed property sales.

You’ll speak with motivated homeowners generated through direct marketing campaigns, understand their situation, evaluate properties, negotiate offers, and move qualified opportunities toward contract.

This role is ideal for someone who knows how to:

  • Build rapport with motivated sellers
  • Qualify real estate opportunities
  • Calculate ARV and evaluate repairs
  • Negotiate cash offers
  • Handle seller objections
  • Follow up consistently
  • Get properties under contract

If you’ve successfully worked acquisitions for a U.S. real estate investor or wholesaling business, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Seller Leads & Qualification

  • Handle inbound leads from property owners responding to:
    • Cash buyer campaigns
    • Foreclosure marketing
    • Probate campaigns
    • Distressed property campaigns
  • Conduct structured seller qualification calls
  • Identify:
    • Seller motivation
    • Timeline
    • Property condition
    • Pricing expectations
    • Deal viability
  • Build trust and rapport while understanding each homeowner’s situation
  • Prioritize highly motivated sellers and qualified opportunities

Property Evaluation & Deal Analysis

  • Conduct preliminary property evaluations over the phone
  • Assess:
    • Property condition
    • Estimated repairs
    • After-Repair Value (ARV)
    • Potential acquisition price
    • Wholesale/investment viability
  • Gather the information needed to make informed acquisition decisions
  • Work within company-approved acquisition guidelines

Offer Negotiation & Closing

  • Present cash offers to motivated homeowners
  • Negotiate pricing and purchase terms
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally
  • Guide sellers through the decision-making process
  • Create win-win solutions based on seller circumstances
  • Drive qualified opportunities toward signed purchase agreements

Pipeline Management & Follow-Up

  • Maintain consistent follow-up with sellers who don’t convert immediately
  • Manage a pipeline of active acquisition opportunities
  • Track:
    • Seller conversations
    • Follow-up dates
    • Offer status
    • Negotiations
    • Contract status
  • Keep CRM records complete and accurate
  • Ensure no qualified lead falls through the cracks

Contracts & Team Coordination

  • Secure signed purchase agreements from qualified sellers
  • Maintain accurate documentation throughout the acquisition process
  • Coordinate with:
    • Acquisitions
    • Underwriting
    • Dispositions
    • Internal operations teams
  • Ensure smooth handoffs after contracts are executed
  • Communicate important deal details clearly to internal stakeholders

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • Previous hands-on experience in at least one of the following:
    • Real Estate Wholesaling
    • Real Estate Acquisitions
    • FSBO transactions
    • Subject-To transactions
    • Distressed Property Sales
  • Proven experience getting motivated sellers under contract
  • Strong phone-based sales and negotiation skills
  • Experience handling seller objections and difficult conversations
  • Strong rapport-building ability
  • Experience negotiating purchase agreements
  • Understanding of:
    • ARV calculations
    • Repair estimates
    • Wholesale deal analysis
  • Experience using CRM systems and managing sales pipelines
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong follow-up and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience working remotely with U.S.-based real estate investors or wholesaling companies
  • Experience with:
    • Foreclosure leads
    • Probate leads
    • Tax-delinquent properties
    • Distressed sellers
  • Familiarity with:
    • Podio
    • GoHighLevel
    • Salesforce
    • Similar real estate CRM platforms
  • Knowledge of creative financing, particularly Subject-To deals
  • Track record of exceeding acquisition, contract, or sales targets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’re likely to succeed in this role if:

  • You’re confident speaking with homeowners all day
  • You understand motivated-seller psychology
  • You know how to uncover the real motivation behind a property sale
  • You’re comfortable discussing price and negotiating directly
  • You can balance empathy with a strong closing mindset
  • You don’t give up after the first conversation
  • You maintain disciplined follow-up
  • You’re comfortable working toward measurable acquisition targets
  • You take ownership of your pipeline from lead to signed contract

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You’ll start by reviewing new inbound seller leads and identifying high-priority follow-ups.

Throughout the day, you’ll:

  • Speak with motivated property owners
  • Qualify seller situations and property opportunities
  • Evaluate property condition and potential value
  • Calculate or review ARV and repair considerations
  • Present and negotiate offers
  • Handle objections
  • Follow up with active opportunities
  • Move qualified sellers toward signed contracts
  • Update CRM records
  • Coordinate active deals with internal teams

In short: you turn motivated seller conversations into qualified real estate opportunities and signed purchase agreements.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Qualified seller conversations
  • Offers presented
  • Contracts signed
  • Lead-to-contract conversion rate
  • Follow-up completion rate
  • Speed-to-lead
  • Pipeline accuracy and CRM hygiene
  • Closed deal performance
  • Acquisition goals achieved

Compensation & Benefits

  • $1,500–$2,000 USD monthly base salary
  • Performance bonuses tied to:
    • Contracts signed
    • Closed deals
  • Fully remote position
  • Work with a growing U.S. real estate investment team
  • Clear performance metrics and growth opportunities
  • Support from experienced acquisitions professionals

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have direct real estate acquisitions or wholesaling experience
  • Know how to speak with and qualify motivated sellers
  • Can evaluate deals and negotiate confidently
  • Have a track record of getting properties under contract
  • Thrive in phone-intensive, performance-driven sales roles

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help turn motivated seller opportunities into successful real estate acquisitions.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This is your opportunity to introduce yourself and highlight your experience with real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, motivated seller conversations, negotiations, and getting properties under contract.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Parse Biosciences, a QIAGEN company, is a global life sciences company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. The company develops and commercializes single-cell sequencing technologies and related products used in biomedical research. Parse products are utilized in more than 3,000 laboratories worldwide and include Evercode™ Whole Transcriptome, Evercode™ TCR, Gene Capture, and associated software solutions.

Founded based on technology developed at the University of Washington, Parse operates a 34,000-square-foot headquarters and laboratory facility in Seattle’s South Lake Union district.

THE POSITION

The Associate Product Marketing Manager will support the development and execution of product marketing initiatives that communicate the value of Parse Biosciences’ products and technologies to existing and prospective customers. This role will help create compelling, scientifically informed content and messaging across the company’s product portfolio and support new product launches and commercial initiatives.

Working closely with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and scientific teams, this individual will help translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, engaging content for a variety of audiences. The ideal candidate brings a strong scientific foundation, excellent communication and organizational skills, and an interest in developing their product marketing expertise within the rapidly evolving field of single-cell genomics.

IN THIS POSITION, YOU WILL:

  • Support the development of product positioning, messaging, and value propositions for Parse Biosciences’ product portfolio and new product initiatives.
  • Create and coordinate content for multi-channel marketing efforts, including product collateral, presentations, web content, email campaigns, sales enablement materials, and other customer-facing resources.
  • Help tailor messaging and content to different customer segments, applications, and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Partner with Product Managers and other stakeholders to support product launches, campaigns, and ongoing commercial initiatives.
  • Assist in gathering customer, market, and competitive insights to inform messaging, content, and product marketing activities.
  • Support the development and refinement of customer personas, segmentation, customer journeys, and key messaging.
  • Coordinate the development, review, and maintenance of product marketing collateral and supporting materials.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Marketing, including Brand, Design, Digital Marketing, Communications, and other functions, to develop effective campaigns and materials.
  • Partner with Sales and customer-facing teams to understand their needs and develop tools and content that support customer engagement.
  • Help ensure product messaging and marketing materials are accurate, consistent, and aligned across channels.
  • Stay current on advances in single-cell genomics, Parse Biosciences’ technology and products, customer needs, and the broader competitive landscape.
  • Support additional product marketing projects and initiatives as the business and product portfolio continue to grow.

FOR THIS POSITION, WE LOOK FOR

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, marketing, business, or a related discipline; a scientific background is strongly preferred.
  • 1 - 3 years of relevant experience in product marketing, marketing, product management, customer/application support, or another relevant role within life sciences, biotechnology, genomics, or a related industry.
  • An interest in developing expertise in product marketing and translating complex scientific concepts into clear, compelling customer-facing communications.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with scientific and technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and functions.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about customers, markets, products, and emerging scientific technologies.
  • Experience with genomics, next-generation sequencing, or single-cell technologies is preferred but not required.

JOB CONDITIONS

  • This position is home office based and will require a reliable internet connection and suitable workspace to fulfill job duties effectively. Laptop and any other essential technical/home office equipment will be provided.
  • Regular communication and collaboration with team members will occur virtually through Zoom meetings, instant messaging, and email.

Parse Biosciences is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

As part of our commitment to fairness and inclusion, we do not use artificial intelligence or automated systems to screen job applications. Every application is reviewed by a member of our hiring team to ensure that hiring decisions are made thoughtfully and equitably.

To meet the health and wellness needs of our team, Parse offers a comprehensive benefits package for all full time employees, including:
  • Medical, dental, vision, and Rx (prescription) coverage beginning on the 1st day of the month following your start date. Parse covers 90% of the monthly premiums for employees, and 60% for dependents.
  • A 401(k) program with no waiting period to participate
  • Basic life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage. Monthly premiums for both are covered at 100% by Parse.
  • Flexible spending account (FSA) options for medical, dependent care, and commuter expenses
  • A transportation program (Seattle only)
  • 12 paid holidays annually and a winter holiday break
  • A generous time off policy

Our client operates two established businesses in Australia: a growing dental practice and a professional education company serving dental professionals. The team is seeking a highly organised and proactive professional who can support both patient and client enquiries while helping keep executive priorities, projects, and administration running smoothly across the two businesses.

This is a unique dual-role position combining:

  • Patient & Delegate Enquiry Coordination (approximately 60%)
  • Executive Assistant Support (approximately 40%)

The successful candidate will serve as the first point of contact for prospective dental patients and course delegates while also providing executive support to the business owner.

This role is ideal for someone who has experience in both customer-facing phone work and high-level administration.

Patient & Delegate Enquiries (Approx. 60%)

Lead Response & Appointment Booking

  • Follow up on missed appointments and rebooking opportunities.

  • Ensure all interactions are accurately recorded.

CRM & Data Management

  • Maintain complete and accurate CRM records.
  • Log all calls, notes, outcomes, and next actions.
  • Update lead stages and contact information.
  • Maintain high standards of data accuracy and reporting.

Source Education Support

  • Handle enquiries from dentists interested in education programs.
  • Coordinate strategy calls and enrolment processes.
  • Follow up on registrations, deposits, and documentation.

Executive Assistant Support (Approx. 40%)

Executive Administration

  • Manage calendars, appointments, and scheduling.
  • Coordinate meetings across both businesses.
  • Draft and manage correspondence.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and action summaries.
  • Manage inboxes and prioritise communications.

Project & Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate with marketing agencies, suppliers, accountants, bookkeepers, and external partners.
  • Track outstanding commitments and project deliverables.
  • Follow up proactively to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Coordinate travel, accommodation, and event logistics when required.

Course Administration

  • Process enrolments and attendee records.
  • Maintain event and course checklists.
  • Coordinate venues, catering, equipment, certificates, and delegate materials.

Finance & Compliance Administration

  • Assist with supplier bill coding and approval workflows.
  • Support expense tracking and receipt management.
  • Maintain compliance calendars and renewal schedules.
  • Assist with reporting and administration processes.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain CRM data quality.
  • Compile monthly reporting packs.
  • Turn meeting notes, transcripts, and voice notes into professional documents.
  • Support process documentation and administrative improvements.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience combining customer-facing phone support and administrative/executive support responsibilities.
  • Previous experience supporting Australian clients.
  • Experience within dental, medical, healthcare, aesthetics, allied health, or professional services environments is highly preferred.
  • Exceptional verbal English communication skills with a clear and professional speaking voice.
  • Strong written English with the ability to draft professional emails and business correspondence.
  • Demonstrated CRM discipline and accurate record-keeping.
  • Strong organisational skills and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch between customer-facing and administrative tasks.
  • Confidence following up stakeholders and ensuring commitments are completed.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Comfortable following established processes, scripts, and compliance requirements.
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Technical & Home Office Requirements

  • Quiet, dedicated home office environment.
  • Professional headset suitable for frequent phone work.
  • Reliable computer setup.
  • Stable primary internet connection.
  • Backup internet connection (mobile hotspot or secondary connection).
  • Backup power solution (UPS or equivalent).

Preferred Experience

  • HubSpot CRM experience.
  • Experience working within an Australian dental practice.
  • Familiarity with Australian customer service environments.
  • Xero experience.
  • Executive Assistant experience supporting business owners or senior executives.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in a professional setting.

Systems & Software

Experience with some or all of the following is highly desirable:

  • HubSpot
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)
  • Trello
  • Dialpad
  • CallRail
  • WooCommerce
  • Calendly
  • Eventbrite
  • Xero
  • Lightyear
  • Zoom
  • Canva
  • AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate will:

  • Consistently respond to new enquiries promptly during business hours.
  • Maintain high call-answering rates during enquiry windows.
  • Ensure all enquiries are accurately logged and managed in the CRM.
  • Successfully support consultation attendance and follow-up processes.
  • Maintain an organised executive workflow and task management system.
  • Keep inboxes, calendars, meetings, and follow-ups running smoothly.
  • Proactively identify and resolve outstanding actions and commitments.

Key Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

  • Warm, professional, and personable on the phone.
  • Highly organised and process-driven.
  • Proactive and accountable.
  • Detail-oriented.
  • Confident in following up and driving tasks to completion.
  • Adaptable and capable of switching between different communication styles.
  • Dependable and trustworthy.
  • Comfortable working directly with a business owner.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the corporate Subject Matter Expert (SME) for HF and sulfuric acid alkylation technology, providing technical leadership and support across all refining assets.
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor unit performance indicators, benchmarking metrics, and technology health dashboards to identify performance gaps, reliability risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Serve as the corporate steward and technical authority for HF and sulfuric acid alkylation process safety standards, engineering best practices, and risk management strategies.
  • Own and maintain corporate alkylation technology standards, operating envelopes, critical process parameter guidance, and lessons-learned documentation to ensure consistent execution across all refining assets.
  • Provide technical consultation and troubleshooting support to refinery process engineers, production teams, and operations personnel on unit performance, process optimization, operating issues, and process safety concerns.
  • Lead efforts to improve alkylation unit safety, reliability, environmental performance, and economic optimization through application of industry best practices and sound engineering principles.
  • Develop, maintain, monitor, and benchmark key alkylation performance indicators, including process safety, reliability, acid consumption, alkylate quality, equipment performance, and unit energy intensity.
  • Mentor and develop refinery process engineers, technical supervisors, and operations leaders through coaching, technical training, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain corporate standards, best practices, engineering guidelines, and operating philosophies related to alkylation technology.
  • Lead the refinery alkylation best-practice network and facilitate periodic technology collaboration meetings, including agenda development, action tracking, knowledge sharing, and deployment of lessons learned.
  • Coordinate and lead annual technology health assessments for alkylation units, including performance reviews, gap identification, risk assessment, and improvement plan development.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, licensor developments, catalyst advancements, process improvements, and industry trends to identify opportunities for business improvement and competitive advantage.
  • Maintain active engagement with technology licensors, catalyst suppliers, engineering consultants, industry organizations, and peer networks to ensure awareness and application of current industry best practices and technological advancements.
  • Support process studies and technology evaluations focused on yield improvement, energy efficiency, asset utilization, environmental compliance, process safety, and profitability enhancement.
  • Provide technical leadership during unit startups, shutdowns, major operating events, turnarounds, commissioning activities, and post-startup performance stabilization efforts.
  • Participate in and provide technical leadership for process hazard analyses (PHA), layer of protection analyses (LOPA), management of change (MOC) reviews, pre-startup safety reviews (PSSR), and other process safety management activities impacting alkylation units.
  • Serve as the technical authority for alkylation-related management of change reviews, significant process deviations, operating envelope exceedances, and major technology recommendations.
  • Lead or participate in incident investigations and root cause failure analyses involving process safety events, reliability incidents, environmental events, and production losses. Partner with reliability, maintenance, and operations personnel to identify corrective actions, capture lessons learned, and prevent recurrence.
  • Own and facilitate the development, maintenance, and deployment of alkylation-specific training materials, operating guidance, and competency development programs.
  • Support capital project development through concept evaluation, technology selection, design review, risk assessment, process design package review, and startup readiness activities.
  • Provide periodic updates and recommendations to refinery and corporate leadership regarding technology risks, constraints, performance gaps, improvement opportunities, and long-range strategic initiatives.
  • Exercise broad technical judgment and independent decision-making to resolve complex technical issues and influence business outcomes across multiple facilities.
  • Support other refining process technologies and business initiatives as required based on organizational needs, individual expertise, and business priorities.
  • This position relies on extensive industry experience, advanced technical knowledge, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to influence organizational decisions across multiple refining assets. A high degree of creativity, initiative, leadership, and independent decision-making is expected.

Required Qualifications – Education, Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering.
  • 15+ years refining experience.
  • 10+ years supporting alkylation technology.
  • Expertise in operation, optimization, troubleshooting, and performance improvement of HF and sulfuric acid alkylation units.
  • Knowledge of alkylation reaction chemistry and process fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with HYSYS and applicable process modeling software.
  • Experience with startups, shutdowns, and turnarounds.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
  • Knowledge of process safety management principles and regulatory requirements.
  • Familiarity with staged-gate project development processes.

Preferred Qualifications – Education, Skills & Experience:

  • Experience with both HF and sulfuric acid alkylation technologies.
  • Experience leading or participating in PHAs, LOPAs, MOCs, and PSSRs.
  • Experience developing corporate standards and best practices.
  • Experience serving as a corporate or multi-site technology resource.
  • Experience with technology-specific modeling software.
  • Participation in industry committees, licensor forums, or professional organizations.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.

jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity ServiceNow is looking for a Senior Manager, Partner Strategy & Operations to own the operational rhythm and execution quality of AMS Global Partner & Channels.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

ServiceNow is looking for a Senior Manager, Partner Strategy & Operations to own the operational rhythm and execution quality of AMS Global Partner & Channels. Your job is ensuring that forecasting, deal reviews, pipeline health, and performance management practices are executed consistently, work together seamlessly, and give leadership real-time visibility into the business. You'll be on point as the operational lead for our largest hub, ensuring consolidated forecasting and hub-level coordination run with precision.

What You'll Own

Operations Strategy & Support (60%)

Your Role: You oversee the consistent execution of AMS GPC's forecasting, deal management, and performance management practices. The Center of Excellence (COE) Practice Lead designs and rolls out these practices across the organization. Your job is ensuring all teams execute them consistently, all pieces work together within a unified rhythm, and leadership has real-time visibility into the business.

  • Forecast execution & quality: Coordinate weekly forecast submission, validation, and rollup. Ensure forecasts are clean, submitted on time, and accurate. Audit data integrity and flag risks or discrepancies, including pre-buy burndown forecasting.

  • Deal review execution: Ensure deal review sessions happen consistently across all teams, follow the agreed-upon standards, and surface the right insights. Audit execution consistency and recommend adjustments.

  • Pipeline health monitoring: Roll up of pipeline composition, stage velocity, and sourced vs. sell-through metrics across all teams. Identify risks, stalled opportunities, and pull-in candidates. Surface early-warning signals to leadership.

  • Performance management cadence: Coordinate rhythm of quarterly and annual performance management—MBO setting, attainment tracking, and rollup reporting across all teams.

  • Systems & data coordination: Work with the Data & Systems team to ensure operational requirements are met—dashboards are accurate, planning tools reflect reality, and data flows correctly. Audit technical delivery and flag issues.

  • Practice execution oversight: Monitor how forecasting and deal review practices are being executed across all teams. Work with the COE Practice Lead to identify execution gaps, coach teams, and ensure consistency. You're the quality auditor, not the practice designer.

  • Operational audits & escalation: Weekly validation of operational health (forecasts submitted? Data clean? Processes followed?). Catch errors before they hit leadership. Escalate issues and drive corrective action.

Global & Regional Hub Operations Support (40%)

  • Consolidated forecasting: Collect, validate, and consolidate forecasts from sub-leaders within the hub into a unified hub forecast. Identify risks and discrepancies before they escalate.

  • Hub-level dashboards: Own the consolidated operational view—pipeline health, deal velocity, performance tracking, partner attainment. Provide hub leadership with real-time visibility.

  • Weekly operational rhythm: Run weekly operational check-in with hub leadership to review consolidated forecast, flag issues, and maintain discipline.

  • Pre-buy burndown forecasting: Track pre-buy inventory and forecast burndown velocity across the hub. Identify early if the hub is on pace to meet targets or at risk.

  • Partner attribution & audit: Ensure consistent deal coding across all teams within the hub. Audit sourced vs. sell-through classification and catch errors before they affect forecasting.

  • Hub attainment tracking: Consolidate monthly and quarterly attainment. Flag risks and celebrate wins.

Key Relationships

  • Head of AMS GPC Business Operations: Weekly sync on operational health, risks, and improvements.

  • Data & Systems Manager: Define operational requirements; they execute systems/data delivery.

  • Center of Excellence (COE) Practice Lead: Collaborate on practice rollout and execution consistency. They design and roll out practices; you audit execution and ensure consistency.

  • Hub Leadership: Weekly operational partner managing consolidated forecasts, hub dashboards, and risk escalation.

  • Field Business Partners: Support them with operational infrastructure, answer questions, escalate systems issues.

  • AMS GPC Leadership: Provide operational visibility—forecasts, pipeline health, performance metrics.

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • 8+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or similar operational roles at scale.

  • 3+ years overseeing execution of forecasting processes, deal management cadences, or performance management infrastructure across multiple teams and geographies.

  • Deep expertise in sales forecasting, deal review processes, and pipeline health. You know what 'clean' means and how to enforce it.

  • Experience with complex, multi-route-to-market go-to-market models. Partner channels or hub-and-spoke organizations are a plus.

  • Strong analytical mindset. You can pull data, spot patterns, identify root causes, and recommend process improvements.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, data analysis, and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar).

  • Experience with planning/forecasting tools or ability to learn quickly.

  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive adoption of processes across teams.

  • Cross-functional collaboration skills. You've worked with Finance, IT, Sales Leadership, and other teams.

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SaaS enterprise sales operations experience.

  • Familiarity with enterprise software platforms and CRM systems.

  • Track record scaling processes from manual to systematic and automated.

  • Experience with partner/channel sales teams and multi-geography dynamics.

  • Demonstrated ability to design and audit operational quality.

  • Experience presenting operational insights to senior leadership.

Character Traits

  • Obsessed with clarity. You communicate complexity simply and make standards easy to follow.

  • Relentlessly detail-oriented. You care about accuracy—data must be trustworthy, processes must be followed, and errors caught early.

  • Systems thinker. You understand how forecasting, pipeline health, deal reviews, and performance management all connect.

  • Execution-oriented. You implement, audit, and iterate. You own outcomes.

  • Collaborative and curious. You ask great questions, listen to feedback, and build strong relationships.

  • Resilient and adaptable. You handle changing priorities without losing momentum.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Accommodations

jobs.description:
Newfire Global Partners is a leading technology firm that specializes in building transformative software solutions for some of the world’s most innovative companies. With a presence across four continents, Newfire Global brings deep expertise in digital healthcare, AI-driven analytics, and enterprise technology. The firm’s track record of delivering scalable, high-impact solutions has made it a trusted partner for organizations seeking to drive meaningful change through technology.
We are passionate about the purpose-driven mission to help improve the quality of care for patients and are building a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture. We are a fully funded company founded by serial entrepreneurs with a stable client base.

Opportunity for impact
Newfire Global Partners, a leader in developing disruptive healthcare technology, collaborates with Fortune 500 companies and start-ups to drive transformation.

Newfire is seeking a Data Architect

What's the Project?
Our client is a well-established company in the luxury retail industry undergoing a significant technology transformation. Newfire is taking ownership of the client's engineering ecosystem, including its core e-commerce platform, multiple online storefronts, and ERP integrations, with the goal of modernizing the platform and dramatically accelerating software delivery.
As part of this engagement, we're building a team of experienced engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, improving large production systems, and working through real-world technical debt. This is not a greenfield project—it's an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by increasing reliability, scalability, and development velocity across a business-critical platform.

About the Role
The Data Architect will own the data engineering workstream, responsible for the pipelines that synchronize ERP and business data, support the client's data warehouse, help build the company's analytics capabilities, and work closely with the client stakeholders to prioritize the highest impact work. In addition, the Data Architect will work closely with the Software Architect to ensure that the data and engineering strategies reinforce each other and create a stable system. Because this area has limited documentation, we're looking for someone who is proactive, self-directed, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with cross-functional engineering teams.

Your day-to-day activities:

  • Own and define the backend data architecture and reliable data pipelines connecting ERP systems, business applications, and the data platform.
  • Lead the data engineering workstream and drive technical decisions for data architecture and platform reliability.
  • Map data flows, dependencies, and interactions between systems across the Customer’s technology landscape.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to ensure data is accurately synchronized across multiple systems.
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and recovery mechanisms to improve pipeline reliability.
  • Help rebuild the company's analytics capabilities by enabling high-quality, trustworthy data.
  • Improve existing data infrastructure while reducing technical debt and increasing maintainability.
  • Participate in Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions.
  • Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Take ownership of the overall quality, stability, and long-term evolution of the data platform.

You’re a perfect match if you have:

  • Data Engineering Expertise: 7+ years of professional experience designing, building, and maintaining production-grade data platforms and ETL pipelines. This includes creating and maintaining clear data definitions, data governance processes, and related functions to create a high performing data team producing high quality data products.
  • Advanced SQL: Expert-level SQL skills with experience optimizing complex queries and handling large datasets.
  • Production ETL Pipelines: Hands-on experience designing and operating reliable ETL/data synchronization pipelines, including monitoring, alerting, failure recovery, and operational excellence.
  • Snowflake & PostgreSQL: Strong experience designing schemas, optimizing performance, and working with Snowflake and PostgreSQL databases.
  • Programming: Professional experience working with Java or Python codebases.
  • Self-Driven Mindset: Comfortable working with limited documentation, taking ownership of ambiguous problems, and driving technical decisions independently.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent collaboration skills to effectively work with Engineering, Product, and other cross-functional teams to create a stable technical ecosystem.
  • Problem Solving: Proven ability to improve existing systems while balancing technical debt, scalability, and business priorities.
  • Experience implementing or supporting BI and analytics platforms.
  • As a Senior team member, you will be expected to actively participate in our hiring processes by serving on interview panels for future roles across the company
Nice-to-Have:
  • Experience building or maintaining Kafka or other streaming data pipelines.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch.
  • Previous experience working with e-commerce, ERP, or retail data domains.
  • Experience inheriting and modernizing legacy data platforms.
Please note that employment will be contingent upon providing documentation verifying your legal work authorization in the country of residence, in accordance with applicable law.

Marts&Lundy Job Description
Contracts Administrator

Reports to: Director, Client Relations

Firm Overview
Founded in 1926, Marts&Lundy is one of the most experienced and trusted consulting firms serving mission-driven organizations around the world. For a century, we have partnered with nonprofits to shape ambitious visions, strengthen fundraising performance, and build the capacity needed for long-term success. Based in the United States, Australia, Canada, and the United Kingdom, our team brings deep experience across higher education, healthcare, independent schools, and arts and culture. We combine data-informed insight with practical, creative strategy to help our clients advance their missions and achieve meaningful results. Our integrated counsel spans campaign planning, board development, annual to transformational giving, strategic planning, prospect management, analytics, communications, and talent development. We believe in philanthropy’s power to transform not only the institutions we serve but the communities and causes they support. Marts&Lundy is committed to a culture of forward-thinking teams that implement today’s best solutions while developing tomorrow’s next innovation. Learn more at:

Summary
The Contracts Administrator manages and coordinates all aspects of client contracting for the firm, ensuring a large portfolio of client agreements are executed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with firm standards, client requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations. This role serves as a central steward of the contract lifecycle—from initial drafting through execution, renewal, and billing enablement—and plays a critical role in supporting timely client onboarding, financial integrity, and continuity of service. The Contracts Administrator drafts, reviews, and processes new contracts, amendments, extensions, and renewals; maintains complete and accurate contract records in Microsoft Dynamics CRM; prepares and submits required state filings and registrations; monitors contract status and renewal timelines; reviews and ensures compliance with client procurement requirements; and supports approved billing schedules.

As the firm's sole Contracts Administrator and a key member of the Client Relations team, this role requires independent ownership of contract operations while working collaboratively with colleagues across the firm. This position works closely with Client Relations, Finance, consultants, clients, contract vendors, outside counsel, and state agencies to manage contract activity, track status and deadlines, resolve issues, mitigate risk, and support accurate invoicing and a positive client experience. The Contracts Administrator also provides backup support to the Client Relations team, helping ensure continuity of service, responsiveness, and communication.


Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration and Execution
  • Draft, review, track, and process contracts using established firm templates, including new agreements, extensions, addenda, and renewals.
  • Review and negotiate client-provided contracts and procurement documents for alignment with firm standards; identify and escalate issues as appropriate.
  • Communicate with clients and firm members to gather required information and ensure timely contract execution.
  • Monitor contract execution progress and proactively follow up on outstanding items.
  • Submit contracts to state agencies as required and track state-mandated waiting periods.
Compliance, Risk, and Regulatory Coordination
  • Collaborate with outside counsel to maintain ongoing state registration and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate required supporting documentation, including certificates of insurance, vendor registrations, and state submissions.
  • Monitor state filing requirements and renewal timelines to support compliance and uninterrupted operations.
Systems, Data Integrity, and Reporting
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date contract and invoicing data in Microsoft Dynamics CRM PSA and SalesHub in alignment with approved billing structures.
  • Prepare and provide monthly and ad hoc contract status reports.
  • Support timely and accurate invoicing through effective contract tracking and data management.
Stakeholder Engagement and Service Delivery
  • Deliver consistently high-quality, responsive service to internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Serve as a point of contact and liaison among firm team members, clients, attorneys, vendors, and state offices regarding contract matters.
  • Collaborate with and provide backup support to the Client Relations team to ensure continuity of service, responsiveness, and communications.
  • Perform other related dutiesas assigned.
Key Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree or a minimum of five years of progressive administrative or contracts-related experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with business or professional services contracts; paralegal certification or formal contract training is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communications skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, complete, and error-free work.
  • Sound judgment and ability toapply established processes and procedures, identify exceptions and potential risks proactively, escalate issues appropriately, and recommend process improvements when warranted.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, manage a high-volume workload, and take ownership of responsibilities while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment, adapting to changing business needs, and providing flexibility during peak workload periods when necessary.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word and Adobe Acrobat, including document formatting, editing, version control, and preparation of client-facing contract documents.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Teams and experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or comparable systems to manage records and workflows.
Compensation & Benefits
The salary for this position is $70,000-$80,000 annually, commensurate with experience. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package that includes medical/dental/vision/life and disability, retirement, employee stock ownership plan, and a generous holiday/vacation policy. This is a remote position, and Marts&Lundy will provide the equipment and supplies necessary to perform the role effectively. Occasional travel for firm-related business (e.g., firm-wide meetings, team retreats) is required and may include overnight and airplane travel.

We are committed to diversity and building an equitable and inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and experiences. Marts&Lundy will not discriminate based on age, race, color, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or religion. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, and people with disabilities.

Description

Ledgebrook is an InsurTech MGA on a mission to bring Specialty insurance into the modern era. Burdened with legacy technology and processes, the industry has not kept pace with the speed of innovation seen in other sectors. Positioned at the cutting edge of the next generation of InsurTech, Ledgebrook offers the best of both worlds: innovative world-class technology deployed by a leadership team armed with over 100 years of insurance expertise.

We are looking for a Reinsurance Operations Specialist to join our dynamic and growing Operations Team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in delivering exceptional operational support to our Reinsurance Brokers and internal teams, including Data, Finance, and Claims. This role supports the end-to-end operational workflow, from contract setup and data processing to settlement tracking and client service delivery. You'll gain deep exposure to a variety of reinsurance contracts and have the opportunity to streamline processes that enhance both operational efficiency and client satisfaction.

This is an exciting chance to blend your reinsurance expertise with a strong customer focus, contributing meaningfully to our service excellence.

Ledgebrook is expanding rapidly, including a recent entry into the Polish market, and you’ll be an integral part of our long-term growth. We operate in a fully remote environment with a culture that values openness, collaboration, and transparency - giving you access to leadership and cross functional teams from day one.

As we scale, this role offers fantastic opportunities for personal development, career progression, and involvement across a wide range of reinsurance contracts and projects.

About the Role

Analyze and interpret reinsurance contract terms to ensure clarity and compliance.

Enter, update, and validate contract information in the company’s system, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.

Maintain comprehensive contract records and status updates throughout the contract lifecycle, adhering to established best practices and internal guidelines.

Ensure accurate and consistent data labeling, while maintaining a clear audit trail for all risk data entered into systems.

Check claim coverage, treaty/risk limits and process/book relevant data in cooperation with Technical Accounting and Claims Team assuring accuracy and integrity of the technical bookings.

Verify and process claim settlement requests and general claim related administrative requests from cedents.

Identify and investigate data discrepancies or account issues, collaborating with internal teams and business partners to resolve them effectively.

Conduct regular data reviews and updates based on quality control reports and internal standards.

Manage, extract, review, and cleanse data from multiple sources and repositories to support business accuracy and decision-making.

Provide general risk administration support to Ledgebrook Reinsurance Brokers and business partners, including ad hoc data analysis and report generation.

Deliver prompt, confident responses to internal inquiries, backed by accurate and reliable information.

Contribute to the ongoing development and improvement of internal processes, placement documentation, and technical delivery standards.

Improve efficiency, ensure compliance, and implement operational or regulatory changes in all processes.

Requirements

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven experience in the insurance industry, with a minimum of 3 years in reinsurance. Deep understanding of reinsurance structures and terminology (especially brokered placements).
  • Knowledge of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements (sanctions, reporting obligations).
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently and maintain high productivity.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving start-up environment. Open-minded and solutions-oriented, with a focus on delivering best-in-class service.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative team player.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels. Customer-centric mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace applications.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Additional Assets

  • Previous experience working in a start-up environment.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with broker-specific systems such as: Brokasure Enterprise, Xchanging (IMR/ECF), Global Reinsurance Platform (GRP), DXC, OpenTWINS, SICS, or Sequel.
  • Understanding and knowledge of best practices and current trends in reinsurance. Project management and process design experience.
  • Familiarity with American regulations i.e. NAICS, Texas Department of Insurance or Oklahoma Insurance Department.
  • Experience with various sanctions lists (OFAC, FCDO or UNSOL).
  • Familiarity with S&P or AM Best platforms.
  • Experience with Slack, Monday, Workday, Claude AI, Front, Miro, Google Meet, Zoom. Holding internationally recognized (Re)Insurance certifications.

Benefits

  • 100% Remote Work
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Private Healthcare (Lux Med)
  • Helping Hand Program
  • Meaningful Equity
  • High-Growth Startup Environment
  • Exposure to the U.S. Insurance Market
  • Career Growth Opportunities
  • International Team & Cross-Border Collaboration
  • Opportunity to Meet and Collaborate with Colleagues in the U.S. Through Occasional Business Travel

Compensation

  • The base salary range for this position is 12,950 - 16,250 PLN gross/month. This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.
  • Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.

Summary of Position

Under the general direction of the Director of Opportunity Development, the Opportunity Development Specialist is responsible for achieving key performance metrics and revenue goals by securing customer/prospect engagement through multiple channels and facilitating client introductions to the sales team. The Opportunity Development Specialist will develop strong and collaborative relationships with sales personnel. This position plays a critical role in engaging key health system decision makers, attracting net-new health system clients and building a quality sales pipeline.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Source new opportunities through outbound cold calls, campaign follow up, emails and social media network outreach to prospects.
