jobs.title: Senior Account Executive – Enterprise
jobs.excerpt: OverviewAt iGrafx, we help organizations turn process into competitive advantage.
jobs.description:
Overview

At iGrafx, we help organizations turn process into competitive advantage. By combining process intelligence, AI, and automation, we enable enterprises to understand how work gets done, identify where it can be improved, and confidently transform the processes that matter most.

Every business process now has three participants: people, automation, and AI agents. Enterprises are deploying agents faster than they can govern them — and in regulated industries, an agent without process context is an operational risk, not an efficiency gain. The iGrafx Agentic Process Foundation is the process intelligence layer that gives AI agents the visibility, context, and guardrails they need to operate reliably. It is the most urgent conversation in our market, and this role exists to go have it.

We are looking for a Senior Account Executive to own full-cycle enterprise sales for the Agentic Process Foundation across North America. This is a quota-carrying, build-it-yourself seat. You will source the majority of your own pipeline, run your own outreach, earn your own executive meetings, and close six-figure deals with operations, transformation, risk, and technology leaders who are under pressure to make AI work safely at scale.

This is deliberately not a coverage role on a mature patch. There is no inbound firehose, no dedicated BDR pod feeding you meetings, and no brand that opens doors on its own in every account you will call into. What there is: a differentiated product in a category buyers are actively budgeting for, three decades of process credibility behind it, direct access to leadership, and the freedom to run your territory like it is your own business.

We hire for hunger, commercial judgment, and the determination to deliver results. Our strongest sellers are ambitious without ego, comfortable operating with autonomy and ambiguity, and committed to winning as a team. If you have carried a number somewhere you had to create demand rather than harvest it, this is a role where that muscle is the whole job.

Our Core Values

At iGrafx, we believe in empowering our people to make an impact. We value integrity, teamwork, accountability, and customer success above all. Our mission extends beyond revenue; we help clients achieve operational excellence, manage risk, and accelerate transformation through the power of process intelligence. Check out our core values, and if they resonate with you, consider joining our team.

At iGrafx you will:

Self-Sourced Pipeline and Outbound Outreach

  • Build and personally generate the majority of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting — targeted email, phone, social, events, and referral paths — rather than relying on inbound or assigned meetings.
  • Research and prioritize accounts in your territory, map the organizations behind them, and identify the specific operational or regulatory pressure that makes a process foundation urgent right now.
  • Write your own outreach. Craft point-of-view messaging that earns a first meeting with senior operations, transformation, risk, and IT leaders who are not waiting for a vendor email.
  • Run a disciplined daily prospecting rhythm and hold yourself to activity and pipeline-creation targets alongside your revenue number.
  • Follow up on inbound leads, marketing programs, and event registrations quickly and thoroughly, treating them as an accelerant to self-sourced pipeline, not a substitute for it.

Selling the Agentic Process Foundation

  • Become deeply fluent in the Agentic Process Foundation and articulate why AI agents deployed without process context create risk in regulated environments — and how iGrafx removes it.

  • Help customers unify systems, SOPs, and workflows into a single end-to-end view of how work actually gets done.

  • Guide customers to evaluate value, cost, and risk before deploying AI, so they automate the right processes rather than the loudest ones.

  • Position the structured process intelligence — roles, controls, and expected flow patterns — that AI agents need to act reliably in live workflows.

  • Show customers how to compare expected versus actual outcomes against real execution data and improve continuously.
  • Connect Process360 Live, process mining, modeling, simulation, and PIA (Process Intelligence Assistant) to the AI, automation, compliance, and operational excellence initiatives already funded inside the account.
  • Sell to the compliance and auditability agenda, not only the efficiency agenda — enterprise leaders consistently rank governance among their top AI priorities, and that is where iGrafx wins.

Full-Cycle Enterprise Selling

  • Own the full sales cycle end to end: prospect, qualify, run discovery, build the business case, align stakeholders, negotiate commercial terms, and close.
  • Lead multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles focused on business outcomes rather than features, with deal sizes in the five- and six-figure range.
  • Engage senior executives across operations, transformation, risk, compliance, and IT, and build multi-threaded relationships that do not depend on a single champion.
  • Apply consultative and value-based selling methods such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, and ROI modeling to diagnose problems, quantify improvement opportunities, and justify investment.
  • Land new logos and expand them: identify the next process, the next business unit, and the next use case after the first win.
  • Work opportunities alongside partners and alliances where they open doors or add delivery capacity, without depending on partner-sourced pipeline to make your number.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Solution Consultants to deliver sharp demos, proofs-of-concept, and pilot plans that prove value quickly.
  • Work with marketing on campaigns, events, and content, and feed real objections and buyer language back into the messaging.
  • Hand off cleanly to services and customer success with clear outcomes and success criteria, so adoption, value realization, and renewal are set up from day one.
  • Bring competitive intelligence and product feedback back to leadership — in a company this size, your input actually changes the roadmap and the pitch.

Pipeline Discipline and Forecasting

  • Maintain accurate, current pipeline and forecast data in CRM, applying rigorous qualification standards and honest deal inspection.
  • Forecast with credibility: commit what you will close, call risk early, and never manage the number by hiding it.
  • Track and report on pipeline creation, conversion, cycle length, and win rates, and adjust your own approach based on what the data shows.

Who Thrives in This Role

We want to be direct about the environment, because the wrong fit is expensive for everyone.

  • You have sold somewhere you had to create demand yourself — an early-stage company, a new product line, a new market, or a territory that was empty when you got it.
  • You are comfortable when the playbook is incomplete, and you help write the next version of it rather than waiting for one.
  • You do your own research, your own list building, and your own outreach, and you are proud of that rather than looking to hand it off.
  • You measure yourself on pipeline created and revenue closed, not on meetings attended.
  • You want to be close to leadership, product, and customers, and you would rather have influence than infrastructure.

This role is likely not the right fit if your success has depended on a well-known brand opening doors, a large inbound engine, a dedicated SDR team booking your meetings, or a deep bench of support functions handling everything outside the meeting itself.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of quota-carrying, full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Demonstrated experience at a startup, scale-up, or early-stage business unit where you were responsible for generating your own pipeline in a market that did not yet know the category.
  • Proven success self-sourcing outbound pipeline — able to speak specifically to the percentage of your pipeline you created yourself and how you did it.
  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles into enterprise or upper mid-market organizations, ideally with $1B or more in annual revenue.
  • Comfort selling technical value to both business and IT audiences; exposure to process intelligence, process mining, BPM, automation, AI, or adjacent enterprise software is a strong plus.
  • Genuine interest in AI and agentic systems, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about governance, risk, and compliance with senior leaders.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, manufacturing, life sciences, or the public sector is a plus.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Command of the Message.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Skills

  • Exceptional written outreach — able to earn a reply from a senior executive who has never heard of us.
  • Strong discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to challenge a prospect’s assumptions constructively.
  • High personal accountability and self-direction; you set your own cadence and hold to it without being managed to it.
  • Resilience and persistence — you treat a hard territory as a problem to solve rather than a reason to miss.
  • Curiosity and speed of learning; you can get to credible fluency on a technical category quickly.
  • Collaborative mindset and the ability to work across technical and business teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and manage multiple priorities with precision and professionalism.

Reporting Structure

Reports to: SVP, North America

iGrafx Company Description

iGrafx is a global leader in process intelligence, helping organizations understand, improve, and transform the processes that power their business. By bringing together process intelligence, process mining, modeling, simulation, and AI, iGrafx gives enterprises the visibility and context they need to make smarter decisions, accelerate transformation, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

For more than three decades, iGrafx has helped shape the business process management industry. From pioneering process diagramming and simulation technologies to contributing to the development of BPMN and advancing enterprise process modeling, innovation in process has been at the core of who we are.

Today, that foundation is increasingly important as enterprises embrace AI. AI is only as effective as the processes and business context behind it. iGrafx helps organizations build that foundation — connecting people, processes, systems, and data so they can identify opportunities for improvement, understand the impact of change, and deploy AI and automation with greater confidence and control.

Trusted by organizations around the world, iGrafx supports global enterprises across highly complex and regulated industries. With an international presence and a partner ecosystem spanning more than 20 countries, we combine global scale with deep process expertise.

Our mission remains focused: to turn process into competitive advantage. For our customers, that means more efficient operations, better decisions, reduced risk, and measurable ROI. For our employees, it means the opportunity to help define the next generation of process intelligence and play a meaningful role in how enterprises transform in the age of AI.

Environmental Law Alliance Worldwide (ELAW) is an international NGO, registered in Oregon as a nonprofit. That’s why we support a global network of public interest lawyers and scientists in 80+ countries working to protect communities and ecosystems through law. We're running a paid study on what it's actually like to set up and live with a brand-new Android phone. This study asks more of you than a typical survey. We would rather you know everything up front than discover it halfway through.

You buy the phone yourself, and we reimburse you in full. The phone becomes your main phone for a month. You will transfer your SIM to the new device and use it as your primary phone for the duration of the study.

The study needs some data from the device. You will install an app that provides the device identifiers, and keep "Usage & Diagnostics" switched on in settings for the length of the study.

  1. You apply and complete a short screening questionnaire.

About the role

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams, solving the highest-scope and most complex problems in your area. You will lead large, cross-cutting backend initiatives, drive our modular architecture strategy, and define the standards that let teams move faster without compromising quality, security, reliability, or operability.

This is a technical leadership role that combines deep backend expertise, systems judgment, product judgment, and influence across organizational boundaries. You will work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Engineering Managers, and engineers across product groups, bringing subject matter expertise, and you will do it without relying on formal authority.

Why you’ll love this role

  • Leverage: Your work multiplies across teams. The platforms, standards, and architectural decisions you lead determine how quickly everyone else can ship.
  • Genuinely Hard Problems: You’ll lead the modernization of a large monolith toward modular, reusable, appropriately independent systems — at the scale of a platform used by millions of users.

Establish Go service patterns and Kubernetes operating practices where they matter to our production estate, and guide Rust adoption where it solves a real systems, security, performance, or supply-chain problem.

  • Deep Architecture Experience: Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.

ultrafocused – Work together to fearlessly uncover new possibilities

Remote: Officially documented as working full-time from home, with travel to Ultragenyx's offices or other locations on occasion as needed.

  • Stakeholder & executive engagement. Build trusted relationships across Development, IT, the AI Steering Committee, CMC, PPM, and other partner functions; align stakeholders and communicate progress and impact to senior leadership.
  • Capability building. Develop and mentor project delivery talent and establish repeatable program-management standards, tools, and playbooks that scale responsible AI delivery across Development.

  • Education. Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, technology, or business discipline required; advanced degree (MS, MBA, or PhD) preferred.
  • Experience. 12+ years of experience in biopharma/life sciences drug development, R&D operations, or technology-enabled transformation, including 5+ years leading large, cross-functional programs and teams.
  • Delivery track record. Demonstrated success leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives end-to-end and delivering measurable business outcomes and value realization.
  • AI & digital fluency. Working knowledge of AI/automation solutions and how they apply to Development workflows; able to bridge business needs and technical delivery in partnership with IT.

jobs.description:
What We're Researching

We are running a paid study on clinical workflows within outpatient and community-based healthcare settings. Our goal is to map the realities of patient care delivery outside of traditional hospital environments. This research directly informs how modern clinical tools can better support day-to-day medical practice.

How It Works

You will participate in a remote voice and video interview moderated by our AI platform. During the session, you will describe your typical patient care routines and outline the steps you take to manage outpatient workflows. We will ask you to react to hypothetical clinical scenarios and share the operational hurdles you face most often. Your feedback will be collected through guided conversational prompts to capture a realistic picture of your practice.

Who This Is For

We are looking for practicing clinicians who currently work in outpatient or community-based medical settings. We welcome primary care physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and specialist clinicians managing community clinics. You should have direct experience coordinating patient care workflows outside of a large inpatient hospital system.

What You'll Do

  • Describe your daily clinical workflow in an outpatient setting

  • Walk us through how you manage routine patient care delivery

  • Identify operational challenges or bottlenecks in your current practice

  • Respond to AI-guided questions about community-based care scenarios

Who Should Apply

As the first formal layer of consultant leadership beneath the Director, the Manager provides consistent oversight for approximately 6–10 consultants. Key responsibilities include coaching, performance feedback, development planning, employee engagement, utilization management, and day-to-day consultant support.
The Manager also maintains an active role in client delivery, ensuring Learning, Training, OCM, Adoption, Readiness, Communications, and related workstreams are executed with quality, consistency, and accountability.

This role strengthens leadership capacity across the practice by improving consultant support, increasing accountability, promoting delivery consistency, and creating a scalable management structure that supports continued growth.

  • Share engagement lessons learned and best practices.
  • Support practice meetings, talent discussions, knowledge sharing, and capability development.

Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

Being a Talent Partner at Who Gives a Crap is about way more than just filling roles. You'll be a trusted partner collaborating directly with the business to build teams that do good in the world. As our Talent Partner, you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing Who Gives A Crap’s talent strategy to life, matching brilliant humans with work that truly matters.

You'll run the end-to-end recruitment process. While utilising talent tools, automation, and real-time data to keep things super smooth and efficient. By staying ahead of industry trends, you'll craft a delightfully transparent candidate experience that boosts our employer brand and grows our community. Ultimately, your work directly supports our culture of flourishing, purpose, and impact, ensuring we have the team power and diverse perspectives to hit our big, bold goals.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Tapped into your knowledge of sourcing tools and trends and designed creative outreach for hard-to-fill roles, ensuring our pipelines are proactively diverse and inclusive.
  • Used your analytical skills to dig into our recruitment data, spot a bottleneck in the process, and roll out a quick automation to reduce our time-to-hire.
  • Leant on your background in inclusive hiring to upskill new hiring managers, giving them practical, data-backed tips to run fair, effective interviews.
  • Put your experience with recruitment tools to work by managing complex offers and onboarding handoffs, making sure the experience felt delightful for new hires and managers alike.
  • Drew on your pipeline management know-how to juggle competing priorities effortlessly and keep every role moving forward while keeping everyone informed along the way.
  • Brought your curiosity for tech to strategic projects, like test-driving new automation tools and experimenting with fresh candidate engagement methods.

Let’s talk about you

  • You are a seasoned full-lifecycle recruiter: Who runs structured, high-quality hiring processes that get results effectively, efficiently and inclusively.
  • While being obsessed with candidate experience: Seriously. From the first 'hello' to the final offer, you use smart automation to make sure every touchpoint is transparent, human, and runs like clockwork.
  • You're a data-informed strategist: who naturally turns analytics and market trends into better recruitment workflows, spotting bottlenecks before they happen.
  • Alongside being a forward-thinking recruiter: Who loves staying on top of the latest tech, trends, and tools to automate the monotonous stuff, freeing you up for real human connection.
  • You're an inclusive talent finder: You don't just find people; you find everyone. You align your sourcing tools to broaden our pool and bring brilliant, diverse humans into every search.
  • And you are a trusted talent partner: You empower hiring teams with market data and best practices so they can run fair, effective processes all while keeping your own portfolio of roles moving with urgency and care.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off,as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world,generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Project Overview

We are looking for individuals to collect video of themselves performing natural, everyday activities across a variety of indoor, outdoor, and vehicle environments.

Collection may include third-person recordings of everyday activities as well as vehicle navigation tasks.

Camera Requirements

You must already own or have access to a compatible camera with:

- A minimum 170° field of view (FOV)

- A minimum recording resolution of 720p

Compatible camera examples include:

- Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6

- DJI Osmo 360

- GoPro MAX, MAX2

  • Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements

Mounting Equipment

You do not need to already own the required mounting equipment to apply.

Depending on the task, you may need:

  • A rigid backpack, harness, or similar third-person mounting rig with an extension arm or pole
  • A secure vehicle camera mount for vehicle navigation recordings

Already owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may allow you to begin collecting sooner.

Reasonable equipment costs for required mounting hardware may be reimbursed.

Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:

  • Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension system

Third-Person Camera Setup

The camera must be:

- Mounted above and behind you

- Angled slightly downward

  • Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible
  • Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement

If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment.

Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.

Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

Expected Recording Tasks may include:

- Natural everyday activities

- Indoor and outdoor activities

  • Walking and moving through different environments
  • Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings
  • Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions

For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.

Recording Requirements

  • Capture a variety of activities and environments
  • Each continuous clip must be at least 60 seconds long

- Record at a minimum resolution of 720p

  • Follow the required camera position for each assigned task
  • Keep the relevant activity and surrounding environment consistently visible
  • Follow all provided recording and safety instructions

jobs.description:
Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

Location: This position is remote within the United States.

Role Summary:

We’re looking to hire a Senior Distributed Systems Engineer on our Internet Map Connections team to build highly-available and scalable, data-driven services that provide value directly to customers and across our organization. Censys operates distributed infrastructure for Internet-wide scanning, bulk DNS resolution, and X.509 certificate ingestion: your job will be to go below the surface of our data, and help us find and attribute ownership to assets and find how assets on the Internet relate to one another.

At Censys, we believe in working iteratively, but we’re always thinking about the big picture. We’re building a platform that enables fast development of future products, and integration with new data collection methods. You'd be great for this position if you're someone who considers not just initial development, but ongoing maintenance and monitoring. You consider delivery and developer experience, and everything you do can be built upon in the future by others.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help build large scale, real-time services and applications which leverage our massive datasets to power internal APIs and external applications.
  • Build tooling, libraries, frameworks, and services that support security, research and data platform initiatives.
  • Productionize prototypes into reliable internal tools, services, or platform capabilities.
  • Participate in planning and technical discussions with engineering and product teams to help build the right solutions.
  • Develop and maintain systems such as data pipelines, messaging systems, databases, caching layers, and services that run in the cloud or on-prem.
  • Work with Machine Learning Engineers and Security Researchers to realize solutions that affect security outcomes.

Skills You Have:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building distributed systems (i.e. data ingestion pipelines, databases, services).
  • Experience with object-oriented programming - we use Go.
  • Experience with at least one cloud provider, like: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience or familiarity with message queue technologies, like: AWS Kinesis , Google Pub/Sub, Kafka, or other.
  • Experience working with databases, like: BigTable, Cloud Spanner, HBase, Cassandra, or other.
  • Understanding of core distributed systems concepts such as scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability.
  • Familiarity with using AI.
  • Ability to write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with other engineers and product managers.
  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

Things that make you stand out:

  • Familiarity with gRPC or REST.
  • Familiarity with data serialization technologies, like: Protobuf, MessagePack, etc.
  • Experience building, deploying, or maintaining containerized services in Kubernetes.
  • An understanding of how the Internet works; how machines and services communicate using defined protocols / standards.
  • Any Security Domain knowledge is a bonus

About the Role (Automation & AI Quality Engineering)

We are looking for a highly skilled Mid to Senior Quality Engineer to champion quality as a core engineering discipline. This role goes beyond executing test cases. You will shape our engineering culture by embedding quality throughout the software development lifecycle, enabling engineers to build with confi dence through test-driven development (TDD), automation, and AI-powered testing approaches.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Designers, and DevOps engineers to ensure every feature delivered to citizens and public agencies meets the highest standards of reliability, security, performance, and user experience.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building engineering capabilities, coaching teams, and modernising quality engineering practices.

Responsibilities

Champion Quality Engineering

  • Define and drive the overall quality engineering strategy for CrowdTaskSG.
  • Establish quality standards, testing principles, and engineering best practices across all products.
  • Shift quality ownership left by embedding testing early in the development lifecycle.
  • Build a strong culture where quality is everyone's responsibility rather than solely the QA team's.

Drive Test-Driven Development (TDD)

  • Coach engineers in adopting Test-Driven Development and Behaviour-Driven Development where appropriate.
  • Review implementation approaches to ensure sufficient unit, integration, API, and end-to-end test coverage.
  • Work with engineering leads to ensure new features are designed with testability in mind.
  • Advocate for automated regression coverage before production deployment.

Lead Test Automation

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks
  • Continuously improve test execution speed, stability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support rapid and reliable deployments.

Expand automation across:

  • Unit testing
  • Integration testing
  • API testing
  • End-to-End UI testing
  • Contract testing
  • Performance testing
  • Security validation

Drive AI-Powered Quality Engineering

  • Evaluate and implement AI-assisted testing tools to improve engineering productivity.
  • Guide the engineering team in adopting practical AI-driven testing workfl ows that improve speed without compromising quality.

Engineering Enablement

  • Mentor software engineers in writing effective automated tests.
  • Conduct quality-focused code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Establish engineering guidelines for maintainable and testable code.
  • Create reusable testing libraries, frameworks, and utilities that increase team productivity.
  • Run internal workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions on modern testing practices.

Quality Governance

  • Define and monitor quality metrics
  • Recommend improvements based on engineering insights and production data.
  • Support incident investigations by identifying quality gaps and preventive measures.

Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate emerging tools, frameworks, and engineering practices.
  • Improve release confi dence while reducing manual effort.

jobs.description:
Do you instinctively click through a competitor's checkout just to see where they're losing people?

Do you open a PDP and immediately start forming hypotheses before you've even read the copy?

Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers and redefining grooming for the modern consumer. We've built one of the strongest paid acquisition engines in DTC. The next phase of growth isn't about more traffic. It's about designing experiences that convert, retain, and compound.

We're looking for a UX/UI Designer who doesn't just make things look good, but builds the design system and conversion-focused surfaces that make the numbers move. This role owns the Freebird visual execution layer, the component library that scales it, and the high-stakes pages where customers decide whether to buy.

This is not a "here are the brand guidelines, go design some screens" role. You'll be hands-on in Figma every day, running A/B test variants, maintaining a design system that the entire organization depends on, and shipping production-ready work within sprint cadence, with metrics attached to every major decision.

You'll report to the Senior Director of Design and partner closely with our CRO Manager. This role is 100% remote. We require meaningful overlap with US working hours.

If you think in components, conversion hypotheses, and funnel mechanics, and you've been waiting for a seat where design decisions are measured, not debated, this role is for you.

What You'll Own:

Design the Surfaces That Drive Revenue

  • Own UX/UI for conversion-critical pages, including PDPs, checkout flows, landing pages, CTAs, and post-purchase experiences.
  • Design every A/B test variant with a clear hypothesis and defined success metric before it goes into development.
  • Evaluate test results and iterate. Winning patterns get documented, while losing variants get analyzed.
  • Partner with the CRO Manager to build and maintain a design hypothesis backlog that is never empty or stale.
  • Identify friction points in the customer journey using heatmaps, session replays, and analytics, then turn insights into test briefs.

Build and Own the Freebird Design System

The design system is not a side project. It is the foundation that makes everything else scalable.

  • Own the component library, design tokens, and pattern documentation in Figma.
  • Maintain version control and governance so the system grows predictably without introducing drift.
  • Act as the consistency gatekeeper by reviewing team output, flagging deviations, and evolving the system as Freebird's product lines expand.
  • Create clear specifications and acceptance criteria that enable smooth implementation with minimal back-and-forth.

Ship Production-Ready UI at Sprint Velocity

  • Take stakeholder briefs to polished, production-ready designs within sprint cadence.
  • Maintain pixel-perfect execution across web and app experiences.
  • Deliver clean handoffs to the development team with complete specifications, interaction notes, and edge-case coverage.
  • Contribute to sprint planning and grooming by estimating work accurately, flagging risks early, and delivering on commitments.

Scale the Design Function

  • Help establish scalable design practices as the team grows, including critique culture, file organization, and handoff standards.
  • Set the quality bar the team builds toward through strong execution and high standards.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months:

  • A documented, scalable design system is used consistently across all digital touchpoints.
  • A steady cadence of design-led experiments ships alongside the CRO roadmap.
  • Measurable improvements in CTR, CVR, or AOV are directly tied to design decisions you made.
  • Design handoffs are clean, complete, and require minimal clarification from engineering.
  • Junior designers have a clear quality standard and structured way of working.
  • You become the internal authority on the Freebird design system and its evolution.

Requirements

We're looking for an execution-first designer with strong CRO instincts, not just someone who creates beautiful interfaces.

  • 4-7 years of UX/UI design experience, with significant experience in DTC or e-commerce, specifically PDPs, checkout flows, and subscription experiences. This experience is required.
  • Proven experience building, maintaining, and scaling design systems in Figma, including components, variants, design tokens, and documentation.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates measurable business impact, including conversion improvements, increased CTR, CVR gains, AOV growth, or similar performance metrics.
  • Experience working through the full experimentation process, from hypothesis development and variant design to analyzing results and iterating.
  • Ability to work independently, proactively communicate blockers, and maintain momentum without waiting for perfect processes.
  • Comfortable presenting and defending design decisions using customer insights and performance data.
  • Advanced Figma proficiency.
  • Experience building a design system from scratch at a DTC brand.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working closely with a CRO or experimentation team.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or headless commerce environments.
  • Background in direct-response marketing or performance creative.

Benefits

  • Your design decisions are measured. You'll see the impact of your work through real business results.
  • No politics, just execution. Join a fast-moving, high-ownership, results-driven culture.
  • Make your mark by helping scale a 9-figure DTC brand on the verge of global breakout.
  • Kind, people-focused team that communicates openly, collaborates well, and supports one another.
  • We embrace growth and change, never settle, and continuously improve.
  • We move fast, keep things simple, and innovate without fear.
  • Remote-first and flexible. Work from anywhere with autonomy and trust.
  • Unlimited PTO. Recharge when you need to, without counting days.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Faro AI aims to improve lives by helping life sciences companies answer complex clinical questions simply, efficiently and effectively. The Opportunity

Faro is looking for a (Senior) Solutions Consultant to join our growing team. As Faro’s first Solutions Consultant, you’re joining at an exciting time in Faro’s growth, with an opportunity to truly define this function and its future. You’ll work alongside our Enterprise Account Partner team, reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer, as the critical bridge between client challenges and Faro’s solutions. You own the ‘why Faro’ conversation: partnering with sales in discovery, shaping tailored demonstrations, and building a business case that makes it easy for clients to act — even in a world they often perceive as impossibly complex.

This role leans toward the Solutions Consultant persona, but carries the dynamic range you’d expect from a fast-growing startup. You shine at the executive and clinical stakeholder level — translating complexity into clarity, and turning sophisticated client challenges into prescriptive, confident next steps. Your technical fluency enables you to navigate product evaluations with credibility, but your superpower is making clients feel genuinely understood and giving them a clear path forward. You are the example of how technical and relational depth live together to deliver a compelling customer experience.

You will not be expected to replace Faro's Product, Data or technical specialists. Instead, you will provide the bridge between business and technical stakeholders, translating between audiences, helping to drive decisions and ensure specialist expertise is brought in where it creates the greatest value.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced solutions consultant, management consultant, strategic advisor or customer transformation leader with a background in data and analytics who wants to have a hand in helping shape how AI and technology transform clinical development.

Build the Function

Build Client Relationships

  • Bring the client’s voice back inside — translating evaluation feedback into product, marketing, and strategic insight

Navigate Technical Evaluations

  • Handle integration and product questions with confidence, partnering with Faro’s technical product managers and implementation services professionals
  • Support security and compliance reviews, building enterprise-level confidence in Faro’s platform
  • Quantify the business impact of Faro’s solution through ROI analysis and business case development — giving economic buyers the justification they need to move forward with confidence

Requirements

Requirements

  • 7+ years in a Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, or Pre-Sales role within enterprise SaaS, or comparable experience in a management consulting role, with meaningful exposure to life sciences, biotech, or pharmaceutical clients.

jobs.description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Are you ready for your next career challenge?

Leidos Defense provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Test Director to lead and oversee all testing activities associated with our RADAR system development and deployment program. The Test Director will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing developmental and operational testing to validate system performance, reliability, and compliance with requirements. This is a critical role that requires strong technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced environment.

Primary Responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy:

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, test procedures, and test schedules for RADAR system developmental and operational testing.

  • Define test objectives, scope, and success criteria based on system requirements and program goals.

  • Coordinate with program management, engineering, and logistics teams to ensure test readiness.

Test Execution and Oversight:

  • Direct and oversee all aspects of RADAR system testing, including laboratory, field, and operationally relevant threat environment testing.

  • Monitor test execution to ensure adherence to approved plans, procedures, and safety protocols.

  • Serve as the primary decision-maker during test events, with authority to halt testing in the event of safety concerns or anomalies.

  • Travel up to five months at a time to customer testing sites.

Team Leadership and Coordination:

  • Serve as Integrated Program Team (IPT) Lead

  • Maintain IPT’s budget as a Cost Account Manager (CAM)

  • Lead and manage a multidisciplinary test team, including engineers, data analysts, and subject matter experts.

  • Assign roles and responsibilities to team members and ensure they are trained on testing procedures and tools.

  • Coordinate with government test agencies as required including frequent presentation of status and plans to customer.

Data Collection and Analysis:

  • Oversee the collection, processing, and analysis of test data to evaluate RADAR system performance against requirements.

  • Identify anomalies, trends, and areas for improvement based on test results.

  • Ensure accurate and thorough documentation of test data and findings.

Reporting and Communication:

  • Prepare and present detailed test reports, after-action reviews, and briefings to program management and stakeholders.

  • Communicate test results, findings, and recommendations clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Conduct post-test debriefs and hotwashes to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.

Compliance and Risk Management:

  • Ensure all testing activities comply with applicable standards, regulations, and government requirements, including cybersecurity and environmental standards.

  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with test activities, including operational disruptions and safety concerns.

  • Maintain compliance with DoD testing policies and directives.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Analyze results from previous test events to identify trends and areas for improvement.

  • Refine testing methodologies, tools, and procedures based on lessons learned and evolving program requirements.

  • Support the integration of digital engineering tools and methodologies into the test process.

System Integration and Check Out (SICO):

  • Support SICO activities to ensure RADAR system components are properly integrated and ready for testing.

  • Coordinate with engineering teams to resolve integration issues identified during SICO.

Basic Qualifications

  • The position requires an ABET accredited B.S. or equivalent degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or systems engineering.

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in systems testing, test management, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in RADAR system testing, development, or operations.

  • Demonstrated experience planning and executing developmental and operational testing for complex systems.

  • Strong understanding of RADAR system principles, components, and performance metrics.

  • Familiarity with test and evaluation methodologies, including developmental testing (DT) and operational testing (OT).

  • Knowledge of applicable standards and regulations, including DoD testing policies and directives

  • Proven ability to lead and manage multidisciplinary teams in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to address challenges and resolve issues under pressure.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical information to diverse audiences.

  • Experience preparing and presenting test reports, briefings, and after-action reviews.

  • Active Secret security clearance required, with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance if needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or systems engineering.

  • Experience working with government test agencies, such as the U.S. Army Operational Test Command or U.S. Army Test and Evaluation Command.

  • Experience with RADAR systems in an operational or deployed environment.

  • Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM) and program management principles.

  • Experience supporting System Integration and Check Out (SICO) activities for complex systems.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and best practices for RADAR systems, including compliance with DoD cybersecurity directives.

  • Experience with environmental testing, including temperature, vibration, humidity, and electromagnetic interference testing

  • Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) Test and Evaluation certification.

  • Systems Engineering certification or equivalent.

  • Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance.

jobs.excerpt: The companySmall businesses move fast.  Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight.
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Junior Technical Integration Manager in our Partnerships team (Hybrid in London, UK).

Partners send us thousands of small businesses each month looking for finance, using our Lending API embedded in the apps those businesses already use. You’ll be the person who makes those integrations work: guiding partners’ developers through the build, fixing what breaks, and turning what partners need — and what we learn from them — into what we build next. You don’t need to arrive with extensive experience of debugging API’s, but you do need to be curious and open to learning whatever it takes to help partners.

The team

The Partnerships team puts iwoca’s lending inside the platforms small businesses already use — banking apps, accounting software, payment providers and comparison sites— through our Lending API. Partners range from recognisable global names to one-person businesses, and each one needs its integration to work differently. The team’s job is to grow those partnerships and to keep the journey from a partner’s app to a funded loan as short as it can be. You will also work very closely with our Partner Flow team, who build and maintain the Lending API and any features partners need.

The role

You’ll be the main contact for partners’ developers, helping them with all things API. You’ll need to be curious, meticulous, and happy working under your own steam.

Mastery: become the person who knows the Lending API best

  • Learn the Lending API end to end — every endpoint, webhook and failure mode.

  • Guide a partner’s engineers from sandbox, to live and any ongoing optimisations. Shaping the integration they build along the way.

  • Review partner customer journeys and tell them what to change to get more businesses funded.

  • Triage live integration issues, trace them through the logs and code, and work with Partner Flow engineers on the fix.

Influence: turn what partners tell you into what we build

  • Own the technical relationship with each partner, from their engineers to their commercial leads.

  • Pitch new API features to partners alongside our commercial team, and make the case for why they’d move the numbers.

  • Be the partners’ voice inside iwoca — collect what they need and push it onto the roadmap.

Ownership: run the systems the whole partner channel depends on

  • Build the monitoring that tells us an integration is degrading before a partner has to tell us, then analyse and investigate what’s going wrong.

  • Dig into integration performance data to find the problems nobody has reported yet.

  • Own our public API documentation and make it the reason partners choose to build with us.

The requirements

Essential:

  • A degree in a technical or scientific subject — computer science, engineering, maths, physics or similar

  • An understanding and interest in how APIs work — enough to follow the logic in a partner’s integration.

  • Clear, concise communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike, and the credibility to manage a partner’s expectations.

  • An analytical approach that gets to the root of a problem, not just the symptom.

  • Commercial sense to judge which problems, and which partners, are worth your time first.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to investigate, analyse and get to answers faster.

Bonus:

  • Experience in a partner-facing or customer-facing technical role.

  • Experience reading API documentation or debugging an integration yourself, even on a side project.

  • Basic coding experience.

The salary

We expect to pay £32,500 - £37,500 (+20% quarterly OTE bonus) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:
CrowdStrike is seeking an exceptional Senior Data Scientist to join our NGSIEM Agentic AI team. In this role, you will design, build and deploy advanced AI systems that analyze and prioritize millions of security events per second, enabling organizations to rapidly identify and respond to emerging threats. You will develop intelligent models for anomaly detection, event classification, ranking, correlation, and automated security reasoning. As a key contributor, you will take ownership of complex technical challenges, drive innovation across the AI stack, and help shape the next generation of AI-powered security operations.

What You'll Do:

AI, Search & Retrieval Strategy

  • Lead the architecture and technical strategy for large-scale retrieval, ranking, vector search, RAG, and anomaly detection systems operating at enterprise scale.

  • Drive innovation across LLMs, AI-powered discovery, personalization, and autonomous AI workflows.

  • Define the future direction of AI-driven reasoning, ranking and investigation capabilities across the platform.

AI/ML Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Own end-to-end AI/ML architecture, including data pipelines, feature engineering, model development, deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

  • Establish scalable architecture patterns, engineering standards, experimentation frameworks, and operational best practices across multiple teams.

  • Drive foundational investments and technical direction across AI platforms, retrieval infrastructure, model-serving systems, and ML tooling.

  • Balance model quality, customer experience, latency, scalability, reliability, security, and infrastructure cost when making architectural decisions.

Product & Business Impact

  • Define evaluation methodologies, experimentation strategies, and success metrics to assess product, model, and business impact.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, and Operations teams to identify high-value opportunities and deliver scalable AI solutions.

  • Communicate technical trade-offs, recommendations, and results clearly to both technical and executive audiences.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead highly ambiguous, multi-quarter initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Data Science, and other stakeholders.

  • Influence organization-wide technical strategy, investment priorities, and long-term AI roadmap decisions.

  • Represent the organization in executive reviews and drive alignment on major technical and product initiatives.

  • Mentor junior scientists while fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.

What You'll Need:

  • 8+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale AI/ML, search, retrieval, ranking in the cybersecurity space.

  • MS, PhD, or equivalent industry experience in Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline.

  • Deep expertise in semantic retrieval, vector search, ranking systems, recommendation systems, NLP/LLMs, RAG architectures, and agentic AI systems.

  • Strong understanding of retrieval and ranking trade-offs, experimentation methodologies, model evaluation, and operational excellence.

  • Experience operating large-scale production systems with demanding latency, scalability, reliability, and cost requirements.

  • Proven track record of delivering measurable business impact through AI and machine learning innovation.

  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across multiple organizations and stakeholder groups.

  • Ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive strategic technical decisions across large organizations.

  • Exceptional communication, leadership, strategic thinking, and mentoring skills.

  • Strong programming skills in Go, Python, SQL, and modern machine learning ecosystems.

  • Experience designing and deploying end-to-end ML solutions, including data acquisition, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Strong knowledge of experimentation frameworks, online evaluation, A/B testing, causal inference, and model validation methodologies.

  • Proficiency in Anomaly Detection, MITRE entities, Detection Engineering,Triage and Investigation.

  • Experience with modern AI infrastructure, large-scale data processing, distributed systems, and production ML platforms.

  • Ability to communicate data-driven insights, uncertainty, assumptions, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Technologies:

  • Python, Go, SQL, Spark, Kafka, S3, Iceberg, Parquet

  • Machine Learning, Deep/Reinforcement Learning, Time-Series Modeling, Anomaly Detection, Recommendation Systems, Ranking Systems

  • LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Systems, AI Evaluation

  • Vector Search, Hybrid Search, Embeddings, Retrieval Systems, Knowledge Graphs, Ranking & Relevance Optimization

  • Kubernetes, Distributed Systems, Model Serving, Feature Stores, ML Pipelines, Experimentation Platforms, Model Monitoring

  • Threat Detection, Security Analytics, UEBA, Detection Engineering, AI-Powered SOC Workflows

Bonus Points:

  • Published research, patents, open-source contributions, or recognized thought leadership in AI, machine learning, search, retrieval, or cybersecurity.

  • Experience building large-scale search, recommendation, retrieval, or agentic AI systems serving enterprise or consumer products.

  • Experience leading technical strategy for AI platforms, ML infrastructure, or AI-native product initiatives.

  • Demonstrated success driving zero-to-one innovation and scaling solutions to enterprise-wide adoption.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

jobs.excerpt: Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.
jobs.description:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

Spring Health is looking for a Clinical Research Scientist to join our Health Economics and Outcomes Research team. This role combines clinical research and scientific analysis with research program management, with approximately 50% of time focused on each. You will design and execute rigorous research, translate real-world clinical data into actionable insights, and help coordinate clinical study activities from protocol initiation through close-out. You will work closely with scientists and cross-functional partners, with guidance and support from research leadership on study operations, prioritization, risk management, and complex program decisions. This is a full-time position that is fully remote.

What you'll do

  • Publish novel, high impact academic research
  • Conduct comprehensive program evaluation for tools and trainings implemented throughout our network of psychologists and psychiatrists
  • Support development and maintenance of detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets for clinical studies, with guidance from research leadership
  • Track and report study progress against key milestones; identify risks or process gaps and escalate issues while supporting mitigation plans
  • Coordinate cross-functional study timelines, deliverables, and dependencies to support on-time execution of clinical projects
  • Support protocol adherence and compliance activities, including IRB submissions, financial tracking, and management of study protocols

What success looks like in this role

  • Research Output: Produce rigorous academic and applied research, including peer-reviewed publications, white papers, or internally-facing analyses
  • Study Execution: Support achievement of key study milestones by maintaining clear plans, proactively surfacing risks, and coordinating follow-through across stakeholders
  • Scientific Communication: Develop clear customer-facing and internal assets that translate research findings into compelling clinical or business insights

What you'll bring

  • Licensed mental health clinician, with PhD or PsyD in psychology or related field
  • Track record of peer-reviewed academic research, including first-author publications
  • Fluency in a statistical programming language (R, Python)
  • Experience supporting clinical research studies or research programs, including coordinating timelines, deliverables, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple workstreams with appropriate guidance, prioritization, and escalation
  • Initiative and ability to self-direct scientific work while collaborating effectively on program-management activities

Nice to have:

  • Professional experience working within mental health tech or employee benefits

The target base salary range for this position is$120,000 - $140,000, and is part of a competitive total rewards package including benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually using Radford Global Compensation Databaseat minimum to ensure competitive and fair pay.

Benefits provided by Spring Health:

Note: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria.

  • Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medicalaccounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.

jobs.description:
Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, minimum 4 hours overlap with UK GMT

Contract Type: Independent contractor

You write ads that sell. You can watch a winning VSL and break down exactly why it works. You read ad comments sections for fun. You've written scripts that stopped thumbs, moved product, and hit CPA targets, and you can prove it.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

About Purolabs

Purolabs is an independent, family-run DTC supplements brand based in South London. We've served over 350,000 customers with clean, science-backed supplements. No fillers, no additives, no nonsense. Featured in Vogue, Women's Health, and Evening Standard, we're a profitable, fast-growing brand proving that natural wellness can be both effective and transparent.

No shareholders to impress. No cutting corners. Just a genuine mission to help people feel better.

The Role

Creative strategy is our biggest growth lever. We're hiring a Creative Strategist to own the full creative system for our paid advertising, from research and ideation through to briefing, production, and performance analysis. You'll develop ad concepts, write scripts and copy, create briefs, and work with editors and creators to produce ads that convert at scale.

This is a performance role. Data guides everything. You'll live inside our ad accounts, study what's working, and use those insights to develop the next round of winning creatives. Creative instinct matters, but the numbers have the final say.

Beyond individual ad creation, you'll build and refine the system itself: creative roadmaps, testing cadence, playbooks, feedback loops, and production workflows. The goal is a repeatable engine, not a series of one-offs.

Your primary focus is Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising is a bonus.

What You'll Do

Research & Insight

  • Mine customer reviews, surveys, forums, and ad comments to understand the language, pain points, and motivations of our audience
  • Monitor competitor ads, offers, angles, and landing pages across the DTC landscape
  • Turn research into clear hypotheses and test plans grounded in consumer psychology

Creative Development

  • Develop ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for video ads, VSLs, and UGC content
  • Write direct-response copy for static ads, carousels, and advertorials
  • Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators
  • Own landing page strategy and messaging for paid campaigns, working with the team to build high-converting pages
  • Build and maintain a library of proven hooks, frameworks, and winning ad structures

Performance & Iteration

  • Analyse ad account data to identify winning patterns, fatiguing creatives, and new opportunities
  • Iterate on winning ads at scale, producing variations of hooks, body copy, CTAs, and visual treatments
  • Run a tight feedback loop: learn from data, iterate on what works, kill what doesn't
  • Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations for what to test next

Process & Production

  • Maintain a strong creative cadence: roadmap, launch schedule, timelines, and quality control
  • Manage creative production flow, approvals, and external vendors
  • Build and refine playbooks, workflows, and processes to improve creative output over time
  • Collaborate with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • 3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce (brand-side, agency, or freelance)
  • Proven track record writing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that delivered measurable results
  • Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles (AIDA, PAS, and similar frameworks)
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads platform and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments
  • Experience creating detailed creative briefs and managing creative production workflows
  • Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivation, and what makes people click
  • Ability to analyse ad performance data and translate insights into actionable creative direction
  • Experience using AI tools like Claude and Gemini
  • Excellent written English, clear and persuasive

Nice to Have

  • Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands
  • TikTok or YouTube advertising experience
  • Experience casting and managing UGC creators
  • Familiarity with tools like Foreplay, Motion, Triple Whale, or Meta Ad Library
  • Landing page copywriting or CRO experience
  • Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)
  • Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for static ad concepts

You'll Thrive Here If You Are

  • Data-obsessed. You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling. You'd rather test than argue.
  • Commercially minded. You care about ROAS and CPA, not just aesthetics. A beautiful ad that doesn't convert is a failed ad.
  • Fast-moving. You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality. Speed and volume matter in creative testing.
  • Proactive. You don't wait to be told what to test next. You bring ideas to the table constantly.
  • Detail-oriented. Your briefs are clear. Your scripts are tight. You spot what others miss.
  • A student of the game. You're constantly saving ads, studying hooks, and analysing what's working across DTC.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

  • Creative strategy is fully owned and running as a consistent, repeatable system
  • You have deep customer understanding and clear positioning across the funnel
  • You've made measurable impact on ad performance through stronger creative strategy and faster iteration
  • Creative roadmap, playbooks, and production workflows are documented and running smoothly

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, work from anywhere with at least 4 hours daily overlap with UK timezone
  • Competitive rate based on experience
  • Paid time off including UK bank holidays
  • Creative freedom to test bold ideas and own your work from concept to results
  • Direct collaboration with founders, no layers of management
  • A small, dedicated team that values transparency, results, and doing things the right way
  • Products that genuinely help people feel better

How to Apply

Your application must include:

  1. Your CV in English
  2. A portfolio of ad creative work. Show us ads you've written or developed, with context on the results they drove. This can be a PDF, website, Google Drive link, or Notion page. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
  3. A short Vocaroo recording (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself, what you've worked on, and why this role interests you. Applications without a Vocaroo will not be considered.

This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. Applications are welcome globally.
