Job Title: Associate Director, Quality Assurance & Governance

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

About This Role

The Associate Director, Clinical Quality & Compliance (CQC), serves as a strategic quality leader within R&D Quality & Compliance (RDQC), providing oversight, guidance, and expertise to support the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS) across Research, Development, and Medical (RD&M).

This role is responsible for driving a culture of quality and compliance through leadership of Vendor Quality Governance activities, Functional Quality Representation (FQR) for clinical studies, quality risk management, investigations, CAPA oversight, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Associate Director partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to proactively identify quality risks, implement sustainable solutions, and ensure compliance with applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards.

The incumbent plays a critical role in protecting study participants, preserving scientific integrity, and ensuring the quality and reliability of clinical data throughout the development lifecycle.

** While this is a remote-based role, it is strongly preferred that the employee is located within either the Eastern or Central Time Zones. **

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the Clinical Quality & Compliance representative for assigned studies, programs, and functional areas, providing expert guidance on quality and compliance matters.

  • Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System by driving quality governance, process enhancement, and compliance initiatives.

  • Lead quality oversight activities for clinical studies and programs, including Study Risk Assessments (SRAs), quality health assessments, trend analyses, and risk mitigation planning.

  • Provide strategic leadership and consultation to study teams and functional stakeholders on GCP requirements, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.

  • Lead and approve investigations related to deviations, non-conformances, protocol compliance concerns, and other GCP-regulated quality events.

  • Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA development, implementation, and effectiveness verification to ensure sustainable issue resolution and continuous improvement.

  • Drive Vendor Quality Governance activities, including vendor qualification, performance oversight, quality risk assessments, issue management, and remediation activities.

  • Partner with vendor quality representatives and internal stakeholders to ensure vendor compliance with global regulations, industry standards, and contractual quality obligations.

  • Support internal audits, sponsor audits, investigator site audits, and regulatory inspections through preparation, risk assessment, response management, and inspection readiness activities.

  • Identify emerging compliance risks and recommend proactive mitigation strategies that strengthen quality performance and organizational readiness.

  • Lead cross-functional quality improvement initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance.

  • Monitor quality trends and metrics, providing insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making and continuous quality improvement.

Who You Are

You are a strategic and collaborative quality professional with deep expertise in clinical development, GCP compliance, and quality systems. You are comfortable operating independently, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and providing practical solutions to complex quality and compliance challenges. You excel in risk-based decision making, foster strong partnerships across functions, and are passionate about advancing a culture of quality that supports both patient safety and business objectives. You bring strong leadership, analytical thinking, and communication skills, along with a commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related discipline.

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Clinical Operations, Clinical Quality, Compliance, Quality Assurance, or related pharmaceutical/biotechnology functions.

  • Extensive knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) regulations and global clinical development requirements, including FDA regulations, ICH guidelines, and applicable international regulations.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting quality oversight within clinical development programs and studies.

  • Experience leading investigations, root cause analyses, CAPA development, implementation, and effectiveness verification.

  • Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), risk management principles, quality metrics, and continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, sponsor audits, and internal audit activities.

  • Experience with vendor oversight and Vendor Quality Governance activities.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Proven ability to influence without authority and effectively collaborate across multiple functions and organizational levels.

  • Ability to independently manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.

  • Clinical trial systems and process expertise required.

Preferred Skills

  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in Life Sciences, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Healthcare, or a related discipline.

  • Regulatory inspection management experience.

  • Experience serving as a Functional Quality Representative (FQR) for clinical studies.

  • Experience with Study Risk Assessments, quality governance frameworks, and quality-by-design methodologies.

  • Experience leading cross-functional quality transformation or process improvement initiatives.

  • Prior leadership, coaching, or mentoring experience strongly preferred.

  • Location within either the Eastern or Central Time Zones strongly preferred.

Why Biogen?

Our mission to find therapies for neurological and rare diseases is a unique focus within our industry and this shared purpose is what connects us as a team. We work together to overcome obstacles and to follow science. We are resilient as we strive to make an impact on our patients’ lives and on changing the course of medicine. Together, we pioneer. Together, we thrive.

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $148,000.00-$204,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)

As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Summary



This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 10% travel.

Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible to you.

Company will not sponsor visas for this position.

The Associate Director, Customer Engagement Communications supports the development and execution of high-impact strategic communications for the Novartis US Customer Engagement (US field sales) organization. This role plays a key part in translating strategy, leadership direction, and business milestones into clear, compelling communications that resonate with the Customer Engagement organization and other relevant stakeholders. Working closely with senior leadership, Customer Engagement partners, and cross functional teams, the Associate Director helps ensure communications are timely, aligned, and effective. With a strong strategic mindset and exceptional executional abilities, this role contributes to building clarity, confidence, and engagement across Customer Engagement and the broader US field organization.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Help build integrated communications strategies and plans aligned to Customer Engagement priorities and grounded in a deep understanding of customer-centricity, pharmaceutical field organization dynamics, evolving healthcare and communications trends.
  • Assist in shaping change and transformation focused narratives that clearly communicate priorities, decisions, rationale and progress to key stakeholders.
  • Partner with transformation and change teams to support communications that drive clarity and enable adoption of new initiatives and ways of working.
  • Develop executive communications content in support of business milestones including talking points, executive briefs, presentations.
  • Develop associate communications that keep field and HQ-based teams informed, engaged, and aligned.
  • Support communications for large organizational meetings including town halls, leadership meetings and all-field forums.
  • Lead the development of written and visual content for internal channels, including articles, videos, and digital assets, using internal and external resources as needed.
  • Support the management of channels and content calendars to ensure efficiency and alignment.
  • Monitor engagement metrics and feedback to track sentiment and continuously improve communications effectiveness.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required from 4-year college or university, preferably in communications, public relations, journalism, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in internal communications, executive communications, corporate communications, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior leaders with executive‑level communications.
  • Demonstrated experience in change and transformation communications.
  • Experience working in matrixed organizations and collaborating across functions.
  • Pharmaceutical experience required. Experience in pharmaceutical field communications is a plus.
  • Ability to leverage approved AI tools and programs strategically and responsibly to optimize the Communications team output.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Ability to support large, geographically dispersed teams.
  • Familiarity with digital communication platforms and internal communications tools.

Novartis Compensation Summary:

The salary for this position is expected to range between $126,000 and $234,00 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together?

jobs.excerpt: Hammerspace is a fast-growing software company building the data foundation for the AI era.
jobs.description:
Hammerspace is a fast-growing software company building the data foundation for the AI era. We are changing how organizations access, move, and use unstructured data by eliminating data silos and creating a single, high-performance data environment across sites, clouds, and storage systems—so AI, GPUs, HPC, and data-intensive applications can operate at full speed.

Our technology combines a high-performance parallel global file system with intelligent data orchestration to make data available wherever compute needs it, without disruptive migrations or infrastructure lock-in. The result is faster AI pipelines, higher GPU utilization, quicker time-to-insight, and a radically simpler way for researchers, developers, and enterprises to put their data to work.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Channel Sales Director to lead our partner ecosystem strategy across the 18 states of the Americas’ Western Region. Reporting directly to the SVP, Global Partnerships & Business Development, in this pivotal role, you will drive revenue growth through strategic channel partnerships, including VARs, system integrators, distributors, and technology alliances. You will own the full lifecycle of channel development, from recruitment and enablement to joint business planning and performance optimization. The ideal candidate is a proven sales and Partner Ecosystem leader with deep knowledge of the Americas’ Western Region storage and IT infrastructure market, passionate about building high-impact partnerships that deliver mutual success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Channel Strategy & Development: Develop and execute a comprehensive channel strategy for the Americas’ Western Region, identifying, recruiting and executing plans with high-potential partners aligned with Hammerspace's go-to-market priorities.
  • Partner Recruitment & Onboarding: Source, negotiate, and onboard new channel partners, ensuring seamless integration with Hammerspace's sales processes and tools.
  • Enablement & Training: Design and deliver training programs, certifications, and resources to empower partners with product knowledge, sales methodologies, and competitive positioning.
  • Joint Business Planning: Collaborate with partners to create and execute joint business plans, including marketing campaigns, demand generation activities, and pipeline development targets.
  • Performance Management: Monitor partner performance metrics (e.g., revenue, bookings, pipeline velocity), provide coaching, and implement incentive programs to drive consistent overachievement.
  • Market Expansion: Identify opportunities for geographic and vertical expansion within the Americas’ Western Region, leveraging insights from regional trends in AI, cloud migration, and data-intensive workloads.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal sales, business development, alliances, marketing, product, and customer success teams to ensure cohesive partner support and alignment on customer outcomes.
  • Revenue Accountability: Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual channel revenue targets, contributing to overall the Americas’ Western Region sales goals.
  • Travel & Engagement: Represent Hammerspace at industry events, partner summits, and customer meetings, with up to 40% travel across the Americas’ Western Region.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years in channel sales leadership, with at least 5 years focused on the Americas’ Western Region markets in enterprise software, storage, data management or IT infrastructure solutions.
  • Track Record: Demonstrated success in building and scaling channel programs that deliver multi-million-dollar revenue growth; experience with partner ecosystems in storage or data management is highly preferred.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Americas’ Western Region sales dynamics, including industry, cultural, and competitive landscapes; familiarity with enterprise, hyperscalers (e.g., OCI, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), neoclouds, AI, HPC and storage technologies (e.g., NFS, SMB, parallel file systems).

Skills:

oExceptional relationship-building and negotiation abilities.

oStrong analytical skills for forecasting, pipeline management, and ROI analysis.

oProficiency in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and channel management platforms (e.g., Vartopia, PartnerStack, Impartner).

oExcellent communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English; additional languages (Spanish, French or Portuguese) a plus.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field; MBA or relevant sales training/certifications advantageous.

Personal Attributes: Strategic thinker with a hands-on execution mindset; resilient, collaborative, and passionate about partner success in a fast-paced startup environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Equity & Benefits: Stock options in a high-growth company; comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage; generous PTO and remote work flexibility.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a collaborative, innovative culture; access to ongoing training and industry conferences.
  • Work-Life Balance: Supportive environment with emphasis on diversity, inclusion, and employee well-being.

To the extent required by state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

The anticipated salary range for this role is $250,000-300,000OTE.Actual compensation will be determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional/education experience, skills/abilities, internal equity, and budgetary considerations. In addition, Hammerspace offers a broad range of health plans for medical, dental, vision, life and disability. We also offer 401k plans and flexible time off. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

Hammerspace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, or national origin or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.

As a Senior Consultant in our Commercial Business Consulting practice, you won’t just advise on the future of Life Sciences - you’ll be building it. The Vox Media Podcast Network is hiring a Video Producer for its award‑winning show On with Kara Swisher. The show reaches a large, influential audience and regularly welcomes headline‑makers across politics (Kamala Harris, Bernie Sanders, Pete Buttegieg), tech (Sam Altman, Geoffrey Hinton, Bill Gates), and culture (Margaret Atwood, Laverne Cox, Ronny Chieng).

The Video Producer manages the technical workflows for full episodes and social video, creates thumbnails and other assets, and oversees publishing. They will deliver polished, high-performing content tailored to YouTube and other social platforms, and consult on strategy. This is a hands-on role for an experienced visual storyteller with a background in news.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Edit and produce longform video episodes for platforms like YouTube, ensuring strong pacing, dynamic visuals, and high production value across remote, in-studio, and hybrid formats.
  • Create platform-native shortform video content optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts—translating strong podcast moments into compelling visual stories.
  • Design and implement scalable visual elements (motion graphics, captions, lower-thirds, etc.) that align with each show’s tone and target platform.
  • Manage and mentor freelance editors and designers, assigning work, giving creative feedback, and ensuring brand consistency and quality across deliverables.
  • Write and edit scripts as needed in collaboration with hosts/show teams, contributing to the editorial shape and clarity of visual content.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with editorial, social, and audience development teams to ensure content meets performance goals and platform best practices.
  • Stay current on visual and social trends across the podcast and digital media landscape, offering insights and ideas that help teams evolve and stand out.
  • Assembling, refining, and packaging the video version of each episode in Descript, while also producing polished audio using Descript and Pro Tools for advanced cleanup.
  • Shape the pacing, clarity, and visual presentation of each episode and ensure both formats deliver a compelling, high-quality viewer and listener experience.
  • Lead the complete video editing workflow for each episode in Descript, shaping visual pacing, structure, and clarity.
  • Handle multi-track/multi-camera assembly, visual layout adjustments, framing continuity, and sync across tracks.
  • Record and remotely direct host video intros, ensuring consistency in framing, lighting, and delivery.
  • Prepare and refine video assets such as thumbnails, captions, on-screen text, and other YouTube-optimized elements.
  • Maintain efficient ingest-to-publish workflows for all video materials.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 6-8+ years of experience in digital video production, with a track record of success creating editorial content for podcasts and social platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce both longform and shortform video content, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats.
  • Strong editing expertise in Adobe Premiere
  • Motion design and graphics capabilities in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience managing freelancers or vendors, and clear creative direction that ensures timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Excellent editorial instincts and news judgement.
  • A collaborative, consultative working style and the ability to plug into existing teams to help elevate their visual presence.
  • A deep understanding of video platform ecosystems (YouTube, TikTok, Reels), including what drives performance, how users engage, and what makes shows grow.

WHERE YOU’LL WORK

This is a remote, US-only position

WHAT WE OFFER

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life. You can find more information about our benefits here. This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East

Overview

What We Do

We calm the confusion of IT by guiding the connection between people and technology. If a customer is looking for a better way to manage their warehouse inventory, equip their workforce, or secure their data, we make it happen. All it takes is finding the right combination of tech hardware, software, cloud solutions, and support services. That’s what we do. We’re the IT Department’s IT Department.

Who We Are

Our team is made stronger by a multitude of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. It’s what makes Connection unique—what drives us to innovate and create technology solutions that stand apart from the crowd. We’d love for you to be a part of that fabric, to share your ideas and experiences with a team that thrives on fresh thinking, creativity, and helping others.

Why You Should Join Us

You’ll find supportive teammates and a rewarding career at Connection—plus great benefits. We take pride in supporting employees with a total rewards package that provides financial, emotional, and physical resources for you and your family. Our compensation, 401k plans, medical insurance, and other benefits are progressive and competitive. We value the importance of our employees’ emotional wellbeing. To support employees, we provide free therapy visits, mental health coaching and tools, and meditation resources. You’ll also enjoy a generous paid time off package that includes not only vacation and sick time, but also Wellness and Volunteer Time Off days.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Responsibilities

The Onboarding Inside Account Manager (OBIAM) is more than a sales training role—it's the launchpad for a successful career in enterprise technology sales. As an OIAM, you'll combine customer relationship management, consultative selling, and operational excellence while learning from experienced Enterprise Account Executives (EAEs).

In this hybrid role, you'll serve as both an Inside Account Manager (IAM) and Client Experience Specialist, helping new customers experience the best of Connection from day one. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives, manufacturers, distribution partners, and internal support teams to onboard customers, uncover new business opportunities, drive revenue growth, and deliver exceptional service throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you're motivated by building relationships, solving business challenges, and developing a career in technology sales, this role offers hands-on experience, mentorship, and a clear path for growth.

What You'll Do

Create Exceptional First Impressions

You'll lead a world-class onboarding experience that helps new customers quickly realize the value of partnering with Connection.

  • Deliver a personalized, "white glove" onboarding experience for new enterprise clients.
  • Introduce customers to their dedicated Connection team and available resources.
  • Demonstrate our technology solutions, customer portal, reporting capabilities, and self-service tools.
  • Understand each customer's business priorities, challenges, and strategic initiatives.
  • Configure customer portals, standards, and purchasing workflows to align with business needs.
  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders from the very beginning.

Develop into a Trusted Sales Advisor

Working alongside experienced Enterprise Account Executives, you'll learn to identify opportunities, support sales initiatives, and contribute to business growth.

  • Support one or more Enterprise Account Executives with proactive sales activities.
  • Develop and manage customer quotes, including technically configured solutions.
  • Maintain a four-hour response goal for customer quote requests.
  • Register opportunities and manage deal registrations with manufacturer partners.
  • Follow up on active proposals and sales opportunities.
  • Identify cross-sell, upsell, and whitespace opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct spend analysis and proactively recommend new technology solutions.

Build Strong Customer Relationships

You'll become a trusted business partner by providing responsive service and strategic account support.

  • Maintain ongoing communication with customers, manufacturers, distributors, and internal teams.
  • Build relationships across multiple customer departments and decision-makers.
  • Help customers maximize the value of their technology investments.
  • Partner with customers on pricing strategies, standards management, and procurement optimization.
  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and proactive account recommendations.

Lead Operational Excellence

You'll coordinate the resources needed to deliver a seamless customer experience from quote through fulfillment.

  • Oversee daily account activity to ensure timely order processing and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Inside Sales Support to maintain order accuracy and meet shipment expectations.
  • Assist with pricing reviews, order escalations, and complex open-order management.
  • Support return merchandise authorization (RMA) escalations.
  • Ensure Salesforce opportunities remain accurate and up to date.
  • Analyze customer activity and prepare meaningful business reports.

Collaborate and Lead

As your knowledge grows, you'll become a key resource for both customers and teammates.

  • Coordinate activities across Sales, Operations, Customer Support, and manufacturer partners.
  • Mentor and guide Inside Sales Support Representatives on customer priorities.
  • Share best practices and contribute to team success.
  • Support new Enterprise Account Executives during onboarding by introducing company resources, sales processes, and operational tools.
  • Help accelerate new EAE productivity through coaching, collaboration, and ongoing support.

What Success Looks Like

Successful OIAMs:

  • Build lasting customer relationships based on trust and responsiveness.
  • Deliver an outstanding onboarding experience that drives customer confidence.
  • Identify and develop new revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Meet or exceed sales, gross profit, and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Collaborate effectively across teams to deliver seamless customer experiences.
  • Continuously grow their sales, technical, and business knowledge.

Why Join Connection?

At Connection, you'll gain exposure to enterprise technology sales while working alongside experienced professionals who are invested in your success. You'll receive hands-on training, mentorship, and opportunities to build meaningful customer relationships, develop consultative selling skills, and grow into increasingly strategic sales roles.

If you're driven by learning, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career with a company that values innovation, partnership, and continuous growth.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities and qualifications for this position. Duties and responsibilities may evolve to meet business needs.

  • Strong experience in customer service, sales support, account management, or inside sales.

  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry.
jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

﻿Role Overview

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

Responsibilities

﻿

﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

2. User Needs & Automation

  • Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
  • Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

3. Product Development & Delivery

  • Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
  • Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration

  • Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
  • Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

5. Experimentation & Optimization

  • Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
  • Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
  • Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
  • Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
  • Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. (Examples will be requested).
  • Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
  • Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
  • Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
  • Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
  • Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
  • Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

jobs.excerpt: About FlexspringEverything connects.  That's not just our tagline - it's the whole job.
jobs.description:
About Flexspring

Everything connects. That's not just our tagline - it's the whole job.

Flexspring is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) built for one of the thornier problems in enterprise software: getting HR systems to actually talk to each other. We link payroll, recruiting, benefits, and HRIS platforms API-to-API so data moves between them cleanly and in near real-time, with no manual re-entry anywhere. The results back it up - 3,000+ integrations delivered, 800+ clients including Fortune 500 companies, ADP Marketplace Platinum Partner, and named HR Data Integration Experts of the Year 2025. And we do it all as a remote-first team spread across Canada and beyond.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Developer Co-op to join our R&D team - and we'll be upfront about what that means.

This is real experience, in the fullest sense. No throwaway side project, no busywork to fill the term - from your first weeks you'll work on our actual product, as a real part of the team, shipping features that real customers depend on. Many of our co-ops go on to join us full-time after graduation.

You'll work mainly in a Java-based stack, and you'll quickly find that integration work is half code, half business reasoning - every feature exists because a real company needs its HR data to move without breaking. If you like building things that ship, and you tend to ask "what is this really for?" before writing a line of code, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Building and improving features in Flexspring's product - and understanding the customer problem each one solves
  • Writing backend and full stack code in Java and JavaScript
  • Working with APIs and the data flowing between HR systems, where getting the small details right is the whole job
  • Using modern tooling, AI included, to work efficiently - and reviewing what it produces with a careful eye before it ships
  • Writing and running tests so you know your work holds up before it reaches a customer
  • Collaborating with experienced developers through code reviews and team discussions

What We're Looking For

  • Strong analytical thinking. You like connecting the work in front of you to the reason it matters - the why, the outcome, the customer on the other end. Seeing the full picture is more satisfying to you than just closing a ticket.
  • A thoughtful approach to new tools. You enjoy picking up unfamiliar technology, including AI tools, and using it to work faster and smarter. You also know that generating output is only the start - the real value is in reviewing it, catching what's off, and being able to stand behind the result.
  • You've already completed minimum one co-op term or have some relevant professional work experience - this won't be your first time in a real work environment
  • You're currently studying Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • A solid foundation in Java and JavaScript
  • Some exposure to Spring and JUnit (school projects absolutely count)
  • You've worked with or learned about APIs
  • You're curious, motivated, and enjoy getting to the bottom of a problem

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with REST APIs, React, GraphQL, Groovy, JMS, or SOAP
  • Interest in integration platforms (iPaaS) and how systems connect
  • Curiosity about how large systems talk to each other - and what happens when they don't

What You'll Walk Away With

  • Real, hands-on experience shipping to a production platform that real customers rely on
  • Mentorship from senior developers who'll invest in how you think, not just the code you write
  • A working understanding of how HR data actually moves between enterprise systems
  • Real practice using AI and modern dev tooling the way strong engineers do - fast, but with judgment
  • Competitive co-op pay
  • Flexible hours in a remote-first environment
  • A strong chance to grow into a full-time role after graduation

The NAM Retail Asset Management Finance Lead is a senior leadership role within Real Estate Services (RES) responsible for managing portfolio planning, forecasting, reporting, governance execution, and decision-support activities that support the U.S. Branch Network (USBN).

Operating within Asset Management and reporting to the Head of the Financial Planning Unit (FPU), this role serves as a key integrator across RES functions including Asset Management, Design & Construction, Transactions, and Facilities Management. The position partners closely with RES leadership, Finance, Controllers, and USBN stakeholders to operationalize portfolio priorities, maintain governance processes, and provide actionable financial and operational insights that support informed decision-making.

The role is responsible for consolidating information across multiple functions and translating strategic direction established by RES and business leadership into actionable portfolio management activities, investment reporting, forecasting processes, governance routines, and executive-ready recommendations. Through strong cross-functional coordination and team leadership, the Retail Finance Lead helps improve portfolio transparency, optimize funding utilization, strengthen stakeholder accountability, and support successful execution of branch network priorities.

This position utilizes a team responsible for forecasting, analytics, reporting, and portfolio support activities and is accountable for ensuring consistent, accurate, and actionable information is delivered to leadership.

Responsibilities:

Portfolio Integration & Investment Decision Support

  • Integrate financial, operational, and portfolio information across RES functions to support informed decision-making and execution of USBN.
  • Translate strategic direction and portfolio objectives into actionable planning, forecasting, reporting, and governance activities.
  • Develop insights, recommendations, and executive-ready materials that support investment planning, prioritization, funding decisions, portfolio execution, and evaluation of current and future investment opportunities.
  • Identify portfolio risks, opportunities, dependencies, and funding impacts and communicate findings to leadership.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Portfolio Management

  • Lead forecasting, planning, and budget management activities supporting RES programs and USBN real estate investments.
  • Support annual planning processes, multi-year investment outlooks, and ongoing financial reviews.
  • Partner with Finance and Controllers to support forecasting assumptions, financial governance, expense management, and reporting activities.
  • Support optimization of portfolio funding through proactive forecasting, investment pipeline monitoring, and identification of opportunities to improve utilization of approved funding.
  • Drive continuous improvement in forecast accuracy, funding utilization, and financial transparency.

Governance, Reporting & Analytics

  • Execute governance processes and portfolio review routines established by RES leadership and the FPU.
  • Execute portfolio governance routines that provide visibility into investment pipelines, project readiness, portfolio risks, funding utilization, and key business decisions.
  • Oversee production of executive reporting, dashboards, portfolio analytics, scenario analyses, and investment performance updates.
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency across reporting, forecasting, and portfolio management activities.
  • Monitor portfolio performance, project readiness, funding availability, and key approvals to support effective investment execution and redeployment of available funding where appropriate.
  • Promote accountability across stakeholder groups through structured reporting, governance, and portfolio oversight.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Execution

  • Partner with stakeholders across Asset Management, Design & Construction, Facilities Management, Transactions, Finance, and USBN leadership to support portfolio planning and investment execution.
  • Coordinate activities that improve alignment, visibility, collaboration, and execution across multiple workstreams and business partners.
  • Support process improvements that enhance governance effectiveness, operational efficiency, investment readiness, and “speed-to-market”.

Risk Management & Controls

  • Promote strong financial, operational, and governance controls across supported activities.
  • Assess and escalate risks impacting investments, forecasts, portfolio performance, or business objectives.
  • Ensure adherence to applicable policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.

Leadership Principles & Influence:

  • Demonstrate ownership and accountability for portfolio outcomes and business objectives.
  • Build strong partnerships across functions and levels of the organization to drive alignment and execution.
  • Influence stakeholders through data-driven recommendations, sound judgment, and effective communication.
  • Drive clarity and focus in a complex, highly matrixed environment.
  • Promote a culture of transparency, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

  • 10+ years of experience in financial planning, corporate real estate, business analytics, program and portfolio management, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex investment portfolios, governance processes, forecasting activities, and cross-functional business initiatives.
  • Strong financial analysis, forecasting, reporting, and decision-support capabilities.

CrowdStrike’s Strategic Advisory Services team assists our customers with a wide array of proactive engagements to help enhance security programs, educate employees, and develop tailored cyber initiatives. The Principal Consultant role is the leader on the ground. This role serves as the primary day-to-day lead for Strategic engagements, interacting with client leadership and ensuring that projects run on time and to our highest standards. Principal Consultants also assist our Strategic leadership team with staffing, thought leadership, business development, and other “back of office” tasks.

  • Support staffing and scheduling of strategic resources on upcoming engagements.

Successful candidates will have at least 8-15 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • IT / Security Management Consulting: you’ve held leadership positions and owned relationships with organizational executives as a management or technical consultant. You’ve worked on a range of infosec and IT issues, including both technical cyber security (applying controls, improving architectures, etc.) and operational cyber security (organizational alignment, cyber policy review, etc.)

  • Security Program Development: you’ve personally contributed to the development, management, and implementation of a security program, helping organization build, enhance, or recalibrate their plans for a successful future-leaning security program. This may include aspects of developing a SOC, CSIRT, Fusion Center, or several security initiatives that support a centralized security function.

  • Security Analysis / Operations: you’ve held leadership or key delivery positions in organizations or on teams that focus on organizational security (such as SOCs, IR teams, etc.). You understand cybersecurity from a practitioner standpoint, and importantly, you also understand how to consolidate and communicate results to senior leaders.

  • Business Strategy / Risk Analysis: you’ve helped businesses address a range of risks, including cyber risks, across their organization. You’re familiar with how organizational risk frameworks are developed, and you have experience helping organizations improve and apply their risk frameworks to address cyber risks.

  • Cybersecurity Policy: you’ve been responsible for developing new policies or enhancing existing policies that inform how private or government organization performs and manages its various cyber security activities. You have played a key role in developing policies, plans, and/or playbooks focusing on cyber security activities, and have ideally been part of the process of transitioning these plans into practice within an organization.

Designed for beauty, built for growth, PatientNow brings clinical-grade EMR with intuitive charting, smart AI automation, advanced photography, marketing, patient engagement, and seamless practice management into one elegant system. Everything works together naturally, helping clients create a smooth, intentional patient experience from consultation to checkout. Supported by a U.S.-based team that understands the pace and artistry of aesthetics, PatientNow provides the technology and partnership to scale with confidence.

Vision: Empowering practices and businesses to improve health and wellness worldwide by helping their clients look and feel their best.

Mission: PatientNow is elevating businesses focused on beauty, wellness and medical aesthetics with innovative, all-in-one software and consulting service solutions. People who partner with us stand out in the industry with strong market differentiation, while streamlining operations for long term success and sustainable growth.

Values:

We Deliver Simplicity
We turn complexity into clarity. We focus on what matters most, remove friction, and create solutions that are easy for customers and teammates to understand and use.
We Set the Pace
We take ownership of outcomes, act with urgency, and follow through on our commitments. We are proactive problem-solvers who drive progress and help our customers move faster.
We Act with Intention
We work thoughtfully and purposefully. We prioritize effectively, communicate clearly, and make decisions that consider the impact on our customers, colleagues, and business.
We Practice Precision
We hold ourselves to a high standard of quality and accountability. We pay attention to detail, continuously improve, and earn trust through excellence in everything we do.

Position Summary:

This role is for an experienced and highly motivated SaaS Sales professional specializing in payments solutions. The Payments Sales Representative will be responsible for driving revenue growth by selling into and expanding existing accounts within our client base. You will promote and sell SaaS-based payments solutions specifically designed for aesthetic medical practices and salons, helping practitioners maximize revenue while simplifying their operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Lead Sales Efforts

  • Promote and sell SaaS-based payments solutions to existing client base, identifying expansion opportunities within current accounts and driving adoption of payments services.

Generate and Nurture Leads

  • Identify and pursue new client opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and leveraging company programs to build a robust pipeline.

Understand Customer Needs

  • Conduct in-depth discovery conversations with clients and prospects to identify their specific payments challenges, needs, and goals. Analyze their business models to uncover opportunities for payments optimization.

Deliver Compelling Value Propositions

  • Effectively communicate the benefits and value proposition of PatientNow's payments platform, highlighting its ability to boost revenue, seamlessly integrate with PatientNow's core EMR/PM software, and offer competitive rates. Compare clients' current payment processing costs with our solutions to demonstrate clear savings and competitive advantages.

Analyze Merchant Statements

  • Review merchant statements to identify all associated fees and costs. Demonstrate expertise in understanding different pricing structures (e.g., interchange plus, tiered pricing) and recognizing hidden fees or inflated rates that clients could eliminate by switching to PatientNow's payment solutions.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with sales, support, onboarding, product, marketing, customer success, and other internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction, support smooth implementation, and drive continuous improvements.

Achieve Sales Targets

  • Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales quotas and KPIs, demonstrating accountability and results-driven performance.

CRM and Sales Tool Expertise

  • Proficiently use CRM systems like Salesforce to track sales activities, maintain accurate account documentation, and manage the sales process with precision.

Competencies: To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following.

  • Adaptability - Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles. Measures self against standard of excellence. Recognizes and acts on opportunities. Sets and achieves challenging goals. Takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
  • Business Ethics – Inspires the trust of others. Keeps commitments. Treats people with respect. Upholds organizational values. Works with integrity and ethically.
  • Communications - Exhibits good listening and comprehension. Expresses ideas and thoughts in written form. Expresses ideas and thoughts verbally. Keeps others adequately informed. Selects and uses appropriate communication methods.
  • Continuous Learning - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses. Pursues training and development opportunities. Seeks feedback to improve performance. Shares expertise with others. Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills.
  • Problem Solving - Develops alternative solutions. Gathers and analyzes information skillfully. Identifies problems in a timely manner. Resolves problems in early stages. Works well in group problem solving situations.
  • Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities. Contributes to building a positive team spirit. Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views. Gives and welcomes feedback. Puts success of team above own interests.

Education/Experience:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in B2B sales with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a consultative selling environment
  • 2+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably selling to SMBs or mid-market accounts
  • 2+ years of direct experience in the payments or fintech industry, with deep knowledge of payment processing, merchant accounts, and fee structures
  • Proven ability to analyze merchant statements and identify cost-saving opportunities for clients
  • Experience in solution selling, with demonstrated ability to understand customer needs and position solutions as strategic business tools
  • Exceptional communication skills and proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and sales enablement tools
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in sales, business, or related field

Why You’ll Thrive Here:

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Work at the intersection of innovation and impact, helping real-world practices grow and thrive in a rapidly expanding market;
  • Collaborate with a talented, curious team that values experimentation, learning, and customer empathy;
  • Be empowered to lead with autonomy while supported by strong leadership and product discipline; and
  • Help modernize aesthetics software in an industry that’s ripe for transformation through innovative, AI-native technology.

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

** Remote role, must live in Florida or Georgia, travel is up to 75% within the state.**

Degree or equivalent and typically requires 2+ years of relevant experience.

Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!
As a Senior Software Developer III, you operate as a technical leader within your team and across the broader engineering organization. You shape architecture and design, raise the bar on engineering quality, mentor other developers, and partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate technical decisions into business value. You are equally comfortable guiding agentic-AI tools to deliver code, reviewing designs, and influencing how the platform evolves.
Location: This is a fully remote position located in Colombia.

Contact

Maira Russo - Senior Talent Acquisition Partner

Responsibilities

    • Create architecture, prototypes, and design proposals that deliver near-term business value while aligning with the future-state product and platform vision.

    • Influence technical direction through architecture reviews, RFCs, design discussions, and hands-on collaboration.

    • Partner with senior developers, architects, and tech leads to define and execute the product/platform architecture roadmap.

    • Balance delivery speed, quality, maintainability, and long-term platform health when making technical decisions.

    • Break down large initiatives into parallelizable chunks of work that deliver incremental business value.

    • Champion proposals through all phases of the SDLC, from design through production implementation.

    • Contribute to improving the core product build, CI/CD pipelines, and overall SDLC.

    • Troubleshoot and eliminate root causes of persistent production issues; drive reliability, observability, monitoring, and incident response.

    • Keep technical documentation current and create new artifacts as needed.

    • Facilitate design discussions within and across teams.

    • Represent the team in technical discussions with Tech Leads, Operations, Product/UX, Security, Domain SMEs, and external stakeholders.

    • Act as a trusted technical leader, helping teams succeed through collaboration, influence, and shared ownership.

    • Mentor other developers through design reviews, joint agentic-AI sessions, and feedback on skills, prompts, and other agent inputs; contribute to raising overall engineering maturity.

    • Share knowledge of new technologies and industry best practices.

    • Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and cloud capabilities that could benefit the platform.

Qualifications

    • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; 8+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrated impact beyond a single team.

    • Proven experience designing and operating distributed, cloud-native, SaaS/multi-tenant platforms at scale, ideally on AWS.

    • Strong software fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, SOLID principles, and a track record of advocating for code quality.

    • Experience with agentic-AI software development practices.

    • Experience designing and consuming well-designed HTTP APIs (REST, GraphQL, or similar).

    • Experience mentoring developers and influencing architectural decisions across teams.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

    • Strong initiative to improve processes, tools, methodologies, and product quality.

    • Experience building highly distributed microservice architecture using Java 25, and SpringBoot.

    • Deep expertise in Angular (or equivalent SPA framework) and TypeScript.

    • Proven experience owning front-end architecture and design-system strategy at scale.

    • Strong track record with accessibility (WCAG) and front-end performance optimization.

AI-Augmented Development Expectations

    • Use AI-assisted development tools — inline completion, conversational assistants, and agentic workflows — as a standard part of your daily workflow.

    • Critically evaluate and take ownership of all AI-generated output before it ships — verify correctness, security, and alignment with architecture and team standards.

    • Identify opportunities for agentic automation within your team, and lead the rollout of new AI-assisted workflows and tooling.

    • Mentor other developers on effective, responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

    • Help establish team-level practices and guardrails for using AI tools safely and effectively.

    • Build and refine feedback loops that improve the team's collective use of AI tooling over time.

    • Build and maintain highly distributed microservice architecture.

    • Design and develop highly scalable cloud services and applications

    • Define front-end architecture standards, including state management, component design, and design-system strategy.

    • Partner with UX and Product to translate design systems into scalable, accessible components.

    • Mentor front-end engineers and raise the bar on performance and accessibility.

Nice to Have

    • SPA development using Angular/TypeScript.
    • Experience with the Serverless Framework and trunk-based development. .
    • Automated testing frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright or JMeter.
    • Knowledge of accounting and auditing concepts.
    • Experience working within a large enterprise monorepo codebase.
    • Experience with container technologies such as Docker, ideally with orchestration such as Kubernetes.
    • Experience contributing to or maintaining a component library or design system.
    • Exposure to server-side rendering or similar rendering-performance techniques.
    • Experience with internationalization/localization in front-end applications

Tech Stack

    • Languages & Frameworks: Java 25 (SpringBoot); Angular, TypeScript, RxJS

    • Compute: Microservices on AWS EKS, AWS Lambda (Serverless)

    • Orchestration: AWS Step Functions, SNS/SQS

    • Big Data / ETL: AWS EMR (Hadoop, Glue, Presto, Spark)

    • Storage: AWS Aurora, DynamoDB, S3, AWS DocumentDB

    • Styling: HTML5, CSS3/SASS

    • Testing: Jest, Cypress, Playwright

    • Design Systems: Storybook or equivalent component library tooling

    • Accessibility: WCAG 2.1

    • Tooling: JIRA, Devin, Claude, GSuite, Slack, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Nx Monorepo

Perks & Benefits

  • ¨Contrato a termino Indefinido¨ with all the legal benefits
  • Prepaid Medicine
  • Life insurance and funeral assistance
  • Internet allowance
  • Home office stipend
  • Competitive compensation — above the market average
  • 100% remote work environment and an excellent work-life balance
  • 5 Personal Time Off days per year
  • Sick Leave Top up to total 100% of salary paid by the employer from Day 3 to 90.
  • Recognition Award, additional paid time off in recognition of the corresponding year of service
  • Upgrade vacation starting at 5 years of service
  • Opportunity to work for a growing global SaaS leader company
  • A culture that promotes independence, innovation, trust, and accountability
  • Open space to be creative, innovative and strategize for the future
  • Mentorship by highly experienced professional
  • Budget for training, we want you to grow
  • AI-first environment: Be part of an AI-first engineering organization that embraces modern tools, automation, and AI-driven ways of working.

What's in it for you:

▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions.
▪️We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team.
▪️Work-life balance is important to us. We offer flexible work options, remote opportunities, and generous time-off policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
▪️We offer competitive compensation, including a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits

▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth.
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team.

About Caseware:

Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.
With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.
One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at .

jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission

Engine Spaces is redefining how businesses discover, book, and manage meeting and event venues. With 40,000+ spaces on our platform, a fast-growing corporate customer base, and a team already in motion, you'll step in as the strategic leader who sharpens the vision, accelerates execution, and takes Spaces to its next stage of growth.

  • Champion the Spaces product vision: Own and evolve the strategy for how businesses discover, evaluate, and book spaces through Engine — from search and discovery through to post-booking — with a relentless focus on making every customer touchpoint feel effortless.
  • Obsess over the customer experience: Own the consumer-facing product from search through booking — making it intuitive, personalized, and delightful. You'll have a strong point of view on UX, and you'll use it to raise the bar on every touchpoint a customer interacts with.
  • Drive conversion and engagement: Dig into the funnel, identify where customers drop off, and build the features that move the needle — better search relevance, smarter recommendations, faster time to booking, and experiences that keep customers coming back.
  • Lead automation and AI-powered innovation: Eliminate friction across the booking journey through smart tooling and AI-driven recommendations — whether that's surfacing the right venue or streamlining the RFP and contracting process.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, and RevOps to ship high-impact work. You'll drive alignment across teams, turning competing priorities into a clear, shared direction that keeps the business moving.
  • Own the metrics that matter: Define and monitor KPIs across conversion, engagement, supply utilization, and net revenue — and use those insights to sharpen priorities and make the case for what to build next.

What You'll Bring to Engine

  • Experience: 8+ years in product management with a strong track record of owning consumer-facing products — ideally in marketplace, booking, or travel/hospitality. You know what great looks like from the customer's perspective, and you've shipped products that prove it.
  • Skills: You think strategically and execute precisely. You have a sharp design sensibility and deep customer empathy — and you're just as comfortable in a UX review as you are in a data deep-dive. You can go from vision to PRD to shipped features while rallying teams around a clear direction.
  • Tech-Savvy: Bonus points for experience with AI-powered search or recommendations, personalization systems, or RFP/contracting workflows in the events or hospitality space.
  • Mindset: You're a builder who moves with urgency and a bias toward action. You'll be joining an established team with a strong foundation — and your job is to take it to the next level.

Applications for this role will be accepted through 10/1/2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, total compensation may include equity and/or variable pay (OTE). Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$181,400—$251,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & CompensationWe believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with opportunities for bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at.
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we’ll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more.

jobs.description:
Duke University:

Duke University was created in 1924 through an indenture of trust by James Buchanan Duke. Today, Duke is regarded as one of America’s leading research universities. Located in Durham, North Carolina, Duke is positioned in the heart of the Research Triangle, which is ranked annually as one of the best places in the country to work and live. Duke has more than 15,000 students who study and conduct research in its 10 undergraduate, graduate and professional schools. With about 40,000 employees, Duke is the third largest private employer in North Carolina, and it now has international programs in more than 150 countries.

Be You. Be Bold. Choose Duke.

Grants and Contracts Administrator (Remote)

Office for Research and Innovation | Campus Grants Management Team

Job Code: 2647 | Job Level: 81 | Job Family: JF 28 | FLSA: Exempt

Be You.

At Duke, we celebrate individuality and the unique perspectives that each member of our community brings. This position is with the Campus Grants Management Team, a dynamic and growing unit in the Office for Research and Innovation, which provides cradle-to-grave grant management services for specifically identified departments. CGMT is dedicated to providing high-quality customer service and compliant award management to our customers. Lifecycle research administrators in CGMT are more than transaction processors; they are subject-matter experts and partners with their faculty in crafting excellent proposals and managing awards in accordance with sponsor guidelines.

Remote Work Eligibility

All Duke University remote workers must reside in one of the following states or districts: Alabama Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Maine, Missouri, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Vermont, Washington State, Washington, DC or Wisconsin.

Be Bold.

What You Will Do

This position is responsible for managing and overseeing an assigned portfolio of complex grants and contracts with a firm grasp of rules and regulations, technical expertise, analytical skills and an aptitude for using good judgement in applying grant management practices and procedures. The successful candidate for this position will be someone with a strong analytical background, ability to think critically, has strong attention to detail, makes sound independent decisions, provide sound, accurate guidance to PIs and their staff, and someone who is a high level excel user.

Pre-Award Responsibilities (30%)

  • Prepare and submit grants and contracts through pre-award process utilizing both Sponsor and Duke regulations.
  • Advise faculty/PI on administrative requirements in preparing proposal submissions.
  • Prepare, coordinate and review proposal elements such as biosketches, budgets, justifications and facilities & resources.
  • Monitor compliance with agency and University regulations regarding submission.
  • Manage the subcontract process with pre award office and collaborating organizations.

Post-Award Responsibilities (50%)

  • Manage budget, effort, reporting, and compliance timelines through the lifecycle of the grant or contract.
  • Advise faculty/PI on budget adjustments and revisions necessary to meet sponsor requirements.
  • Provide ad hoc reports to business managers and PIs as requested.
  • Establish sub-recipient financial and reporting requirements; coordinate issuance of sub-award agreements with pre-award office.
  • Reconcile monthly budget reports and inform faculty/PI and/or supervisor of corrections/adjustments that have been made.
  • Identify and submit the cost transfers resulting from budget reconciliation.
  • As requirements change, prepare and submit requests for re-budgeting/modifying the funded project.
  • Reconcile and close all sub-recipient cost objects and obtain all sponsor-required reports.
  • Monitor compliance with agency and University regulations regarding reporting.
  • Maintain financial records per the institutional document retention guidelines.
  • Manage overdrafts in line with unit procedures and institution guidelines.
  • Ensure proper recording of revenue associated with all projects; applying revenue management standards.
  • Close all funded projects consistent with university processes and timelines.

Administrative Responsibilities (20%)

  • Develop project management plan for review by the faculty/PI or senior level grants administrator.
  • Monitor and implement cost sharing to reflect appropriate labor distribution or related cost sharing obligations.
  • Apply federal and university rules to appropriately manage effort for individuals compensated, in whole or in part, from sponsored awards.
  • Submit reports to central and unit management as required.

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree required. Research or grants education and/or certification preferred. Completion of required Duke research administration training and Research Administration Academy (RAA) required within established timelines.

Experience: No experience required for candidates with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a directly related field.

Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; strong analytical background; advanced Excel proficiency; ability to analyze data, manage multiple projects, think critically, make independent decisions, and provide exceptional customer service.

Choose Duke.

Duke aspires to create a community built on collaboration, innovation, creativity, and belonging.



Anticipated Pay Range: Duke University provides an annual base salary range for this position as USD $61,026.00 to USD $98,838.00. Duke University considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position; candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills; internal peer equity; as well as market and organizational considerations when extending an offer.


Your total compensation goes beyond the dollars on your paycheck. Duke provides comprehensive and competitive medical and dental care programs, generous retirement benefits, and a wide array of family-friendly and cultural programs to eligible team members. Learn more at:

Duke aspires to create a community built on collaboration, innovation, creativity, and belonging. Our collective success depends on the robust exchange of ideas—an exchange that is best when the rich diversity of our perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences flourishes. To achieve this exchange, it is essential that all members of the community feel secure and welcome, that the contributions of all individuals are respected, and that all voices are heard. All members of our community have a responsibility to uphold these values.
