jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
We’re looking for regional ambassadors to help grow and strengthen local communities while expanding Espresso's global presence. As an ambassador, you'll introduce Espresso to new audiences and energize our existing local communities.

What you’ll be doing (ie, job duties):

  • Be the primary ambassador for Espresso in your country
  • Managing local channels, such as local TG and X channels
  • Establish and grow the local Espresso community of builders and supporters
  • Identify local app, distribution, and partnership opportunities
  • Help organize meetups to bolster the local Espresso community
  • Share market intel, community, and product feedback with the Espresso team
  • Ensure adherence of your community to Espresso’s norms, culture, and community guidelines
  • Cultivate and spread a deep understanding of Espresso’s tech and community

What our ideal ambassador looks like:

  • Experience in running communities in crypto
  • Thorough understanding of your local crypto market
  • A driven, solutions-oriented individual
  • Excellent communication skills in both native language and English
  • A real hands-on mentality
This is a paid part-time position. All successful candidates will need to undergo KYC/AML and will need to be eligible to work or contract for US-based companies.

A quick snapshot…

As a Staff Software Engineer, DevOps at Conga, you will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for designing, building, and evolving the infrastructure, automation, and cloud platform capabilities that power Conga’s revenue lifecycle management solutions. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Security, and Operations teams to establish scalable DevOps practices, accelerate software delivery, and improve platform reliability across our global SaaS ecosystem.

Why it’s a big deal…

DevOps is a critical pillar of Conga’s ability to deliver reliable, secure, and innovative solutions at scale. As our platform footprint continues to grow, maintaining deployment velocity while ensuring system resilience and security becomes increasingly important.

As a Staff Software Engineer, DevOps, you will help shape the future of our engineering platform by designing highly available cloud infrastructure, advancing automation capabilities, and enabling best-in-class development experiences. Technical Expertise

Key Competencies

Technical Leadership

You influence engineering direction through deep expertise, sound architectural judgment, and a commitment to engineering excellence.

You design scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions that support enterprise-grade SaaS platforms.

Strategic Problem Solving

You approach complex technical challenges with a systems-thinking mindset and deliver sustainable long-term solutions.

Collaboration & Influence

Operational Excellence

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a talented Sales Engineering Specialist - Security to join our global sales engineering specialist team. As a Sales Engineering Specialist focused on Security, you will work closely with our sales and field sales engineering teams to satisfy customers’ security needs. You will be responsible for providing timely responses to security questionnaires, engaging in customer-facing infosec calls, and collaborating with our internal SRE and Product teams focused on ensuring Fivetran’s platform security.

Technologies You’ll Use

What You’ll Do

jobs.excerpt: Paid Media Director: E-commerce• Salary: £70,000 – £80,000 • Type: Full Time • Location: Remote Our client has been named one of the UK's top 100 companies to work for in 2025 by the Culture 100 Awards, recognising the nation's most loved workplaces.
jobs.description:
Paid Media Director: E-commerce

  • Salary: £70,000 – £80,000
  • Type: Full Time
  • Location: Remote

Our client has been named one of the UK's top 100 companies to work for in 2025 by the Culture 100 Awards, recognising the nation's most loved workplaces.

Who we they:

They are a digital advertising agency for high consideration products. We help businesses with complex offerings increase their sales by combining the power of algorithms with human empathy, storytelling and style. Our primary way of doing this is through our Paid Media Management service, which is at the heart of our business. In addition to this, we also offer creative campaign development and social first content production.

About the job:

What you would do in this role:

This is a senior strategic role that sits between our Senior Paid Media Managers and our Partner & Head of Paid Media. You'd be the person who takes full ownership of a client's paid media strategy from day one; building it from the ground up, anchored to their commercial reality. That means understanding their P&L, their CAC targets, their LTV models and their broader business goals before you ever open Ads Manager.

Once the strategy is live, you own it. You're the one who spots when something isn't working, diagnoses why and course-corrects without waiting for someone senior to weigh in. You're also the person the client calls when there's an issue or a wider challenge. Not because you've been cc'd, but because you are their most senior point of contact. From Marfa Stance to Humanrace, the brands we work with have high standards and expect sharp, senior thinking from the people managing their spend.

Beyond your own accounts, you'll play a real role in developing the team around you. Our Senior Managers and Executives are talented, but they need someone who can coach them, challenge them and raise the bar on how we all work.

Who is this role for:

  • Strategists who think in spreadsheets, not just dashboards. You should be as comfortable modelling a client's unit economics as you are building a campaign structure. We need someone who can connect paid media performance to actual business outcomes.
  • You've managed Meta campaigns professionally for 7+ years and have solid experience across other channels, including intricate understanding of Paid Search. You know these platforms inside out, but you also understand their limitations and where they sit in a broader marketing mix.
  • People who own the room. You'll be the most senior person your clients interact with regularly. That means running QBRs, navigating tough conversations and presenting strategy clearly and persuasively. Your communication, both written and verbal, needs to match the calibre of the brands you'll represent.
  • You understand measurement beyond last-click. Incrementality testing, attribution modelling, the gap between what a platform reports and what actually happened. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to have a sophisticated conversation about what's really working and why.
  • Leaders who make others better. You'll mentor Senior Managers and Executives, set standards for how we work, and help build a culture where people grow. This isn't a people-management-by-title role. It's a genuine responsibility.
  • Experience from smaller agencies or lean in-house teams: you know what it's like to think on your feet with fewer resources, and you've developed the commercial judgement that comes with it. If you've only been in massive organisations, you probably don't have enough experience of the fast-moving clients and work cultures we work within.

What you'll get:

  • Working with fun & fascinating businesses – think music festivals in tropical locations, or Regenesis, Novak Djokovic's new entrepreneurial venture.
  • The chance to travel while your investment banker friends are slurping noodles at 2am somewhere dreadful like Canary Wharf.
  • The freedom of working remotely, but with trips every year to meet up with the team.
  • A meritocracy free from red tape or stupid barriers to your personal development – take Stephen as an example, he made Partner 4 years after joining as an intern.
  • Real strategic ownership. You won't be executing someone else's playbook. You'll be the one building it.

Timings & remuneration:

  • Start date: 2026. Full-time position, in it for the long run.
  • We're flexible around employment forms depending on location – we can figure out what suits both sides best.
  • Remuneration: £70,000 – £80,000 per year depending on experience.
  • Benefits & Perks:
  • Team trips to places like Barcelona, Nice and Mallorca (2-3 per year).
  • Fully remote workforce with team members based in the UK, Sweden, Spain, Germany, France and Portugal.
  • Casa Spekk in Barcelona (our own 'brand home'). Whenever you are in town you can take full advantage of this collaboration space.

Please apply if...

  • You're fluent in English. Native or bilingual.
  • UK/EU based.
  • You've spent meaningful time working with e-commerce brands, ideally in the premium or high-consideration space.
  • You have a genuine understanding of how paid media fits into a client's overall marketing strategy, not just how to optimise within a single platform.
  • You're the person clients trust to tell them what they need to hear, not just what they want to hear.
  • You can take a complex performance story and present it in a way that's clear, compelling and beautiful. Storytelling with data is your thing.
  • You can work during UK office hours (we're pretty flexible, but for meetings we'll need you to be around).

Bonus points if...

  • You have a strong feel for creative strategy in paid social. You understand what makes an ad work and can give meaningful input on briefs, hooks, formats and messaging. We think this skill will only become more important as platforms continue to automate the technical side.
  • You're curious about AI tools and how they might change the way we work, report, or think about performance.
  • You'd rather spend your money on seeing the world rather than buying more of what's in it.
  • You speak more than one language.
  • You have a morally and/or legally questionable story from your gap year to tell us.
  • You'd go to Burning Man over Coachella.

jobs.description:
Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Senior Marketing Manager, Global Marketing – Oncology (LUMAKRAS)

What you will do

Let's do this. Let's change the world.

In this vital role, the Senior Marketing Manager, Global Marketing will be a key member of the Global Oncology Marketing team supporting LUMAKRAS during an important period of brand evolution and launch preparation.

This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape global strategy for two anticipated first line launches in NSCLC and metastatic colorectal cancer, each presenting distinct strategic and commercial challenges. The successful candidate will help determine how LUMAKRAS can compete in an increasingly dynamic NSCLC market while also addressing treatment practice and behavior barriers that may affect adoption in CRC.

Reporting to the Global Marketing Director, this individual will have meaningful strategic responsibility across both first line indications, leading global marketing workstreams that translate market, customer, competitive, and clinical insights into clear strategic choices and launch plans. The role will provide broad exposure to global brand strategy, launch planning, lifecycle management, competitive strategy, and cross functional leadership.

The Senior Marketing Manager will also play an important role in connecting strategy to execution across the organization. This includes managing key Integrated Brand Team and Brand Working Group forums, partnering with regional and affiliate teams to incorporate market perspectives into global strategy and launch preparation, and ensuring decisions and plans are translated into coordinated action.

As clinical evidence, competitive dynamics, and customer insights evolve, this individual will help continuously refine the brand strategy and associated global deliverables to ensure LUMAKRAS remains responsive to a changing treatment landscape.

Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities below represent key focus areas of the role and are not intended to be exhaustive. As business needs evolve, the successful candidate will demonstrate flexibility and agility by taking on additional responsibilities and leading new initiatives that support the needs of the organization.

Global Brand Strategy and Strategic Planning

  • Lead global marketing workstreams supporting development, refinement, and execution of the LUMAKRAS global brand strategy across NSCLC and CRC.

  • Translate customer, market, competitive, clinical, and affiliate insights into clear strategic implications, choices, and recommendations for the brand.

  • Partner with the Global Marketing Director and cross functional stakeholders to identify emerging opportunities, challenges, and strategic considerations across the LUMAKRAS lifecycle.

  • Continuously assess assumptions underlying the brand strategy and recommend adjustments as the treatment landscape, evidence base, customer behaviors, and competitive environment evolve.

  • Help define where and how LUMAKRAS can create differentiated value across indications and markets, connecting strategic choices to measurable business objectives.

First Line Launch Strategy and Readiness

  • Support global launch strategy and readiness workstreams across anticipated first line NSCLC and CRC indications.

  • Help shape strategies that address the distinct adoption challenges of each market, including increasing competitive intensity in NSCLC and treatment practice and behavior barriers that may affect adoption in CRC.

  • Translate launch strategy into clear critical success factors, key decisions, risks, mitigation plans, and global deliverables.

  • Partner across Marketing, Medical, Value & Access, Commercial Excellence, Regions, and Affiliates to integrate functional and market perspectives into global launch planning.

  • Support global to local launch readiness by ensuring markets have the strategic direction, insights, resources, and global guidance needed to develop locally relevant launch plans.

  • Capture and apply launch learnings across markets to continuously strengthen global strategy and execution.

Market, Customer, and Competitive Strategy

  • Maintain a strong understanding of evolving NSCLC and CRC treatment landscapes, customer behaviors, competitive developments, and market dynamics and assess their implications for LUMAKRAS strategy.

  • Partner with Competitive Intelligence, Commercial Data and Analytics, Medical, regional teams, and affiliates to identify emerging developments that could materially affect launch strategy, positioning, or execution.

  • Translate insights into strategic recommendations, scenarios, and potential responses that enable the organization to anticipate changes in the market.

  • Lead or support strategic workshops, market working sessions, and scenario planning designed to pressure test assumptions and strengthen brand and launch strategy.

Positioning and Messaging Evolution

  • Lead or support evolution of LUMAKRAS positioning strategy and messaging as clinical evidence, competitive profiles, customer insights, and market dynamics evolve.

  • Ensure messaging remains grounded in approved evidence and aligned with the broader brand strategy and intended customer behavior change.

  • Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Legal, and other appropriate stakeholders to develop and refine global communication frameworks and resources.

  • Ensure changes to positioning and messaging are informed by clear strategic rationale rather than developed as standalone communication exercises.

Global to Local Strategy and Affiliate Partnership

  • Build strong partnerships with regional and affiliate marketing teams to incorporate relevant market perspectives and insights into global strategy and launch planning.

  • Manage LUMAKRAS Integrated Brand Team and Brand Working Group meetings, including meeting planning, agenda development, coordination of strategic discussions, and follow through on decisions and actions.

  • Facilitate alignment, sharing of launch learnings, and exchange of best practices across functions and markets.

  • Develop global guidance and strategic resources that enable affiliates to translate global strategy into locally relevant plans.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage agency partners, project plans, budgets, timelines, and deliverables across assigned workstreams.

  • Leverage AI enabled tools, analytics, and digital technologies where appropriate to strengthen insight generation, strategic planning, and operational efficiency.

  • Manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously while maintaining quality, strategic focus, and responsiveness to changing business needs.

Culture and Team Contribution

  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and engaging team environment that encourages trust, accountability, and shared success.

  • Build strong relationships across functions, regions, and affiliate markets that promote teamwork and accelerate execution.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, strategic curiosity, and improvement.

  • Proactively identify opportunities, solve problems, and support colleagues across the organization.

  • Model Amgen Values through collaboration, integrity, accountability, inclusion, and a commitment to delivering for patients.

What we expect of you

Basic Qualifications

Doctorate degree

OR

Master's degree and 3 years of marketing, commercial, consulting, life sciences, healthcare, or related experience

OR

Bachelor's degree and 5 years of marketing, commercial, consulting, life sciences, healthcare, or related experience

OR

Associate's degree and 10 years of marketing, commercial, consulting, life sciences, healthcare, or related experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of marketing, commercial, consulting, life sciences, healthcare, or related experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

  • Pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial experience, including global and/or regional marketing.

  • Experience supporting in-line brands through lifecycle management and evidence-driven commercialization.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate scientific and clinical evidence into compelling commercial strategies and customer-focused marketing messages.

  • Experience working effectively across international markets and diverse cultures.

  • Strong strategic thinking, project leadership, and execution skills.

  • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives and influencing without direct authority.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience partnering with external agencies and managing complex projects from concept through implementation.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and AI-enabled productivity tools.

  • Curious, collaborative, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement with a passion for delivering meaningful impact for patients.

The successful candidate will embrace opportunities beyond their defined responsibilities, adapting to changing business priorities and contributing wherever they can have the greatest impact across the General Medicine portfolio

Thrive

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The CEO of doit Holdings will build and own our regulated investment platform in Malaysia, and will serve as the Securities Commission's named Responsible Person for it. doit Holdings is applying to the SC for registration as a Recognized Market Operator running an e-Services Platform, through which users will invest in listed securities and unit trusts offered by licensed partners. We are not hiring a strategist to write slides from the outside. We are hiring someone who can run one of the businesses we acquire.

About the Role

The General Manager will be responsible for the day-to-day performance of an Aviara portfolio company.

You will inherit a real business with customers, employees, habits, constraints, and local reputation. Your job is to keep what works, fix what does not, and make the company more valuable every week. That means customer calls, sales follow-up, hiring, firing, pricing, collections, service delivery, process cleanup, reporting, and hands-on AI/process implementation.

This is a tactical operating role. You should be comfortable being close to the details: reviewing the pipeline, calling customers, checking cash, sitting with employees to understand workflows, installing simple systems, and making decisions quickly.

What You'll Do

  • Run the weekly operating cadence: sales pipeline, customer health, delivery, staffing, cash, receivables, priorities, and blockers.

  • Own revenue, retention, gross margin, customer satisfaction, and basic P&L performance.

  • Spend time with customers to understand why they buy, why they stay, what frustrates them, and where expansion is possible.

  • Clean up the sales motion: lead tracking, follow-up, pricing, proposals, close rates, renewals, referrals, and account expansion.

  • Manage the team directly. Set clear expectations, coach people, hire where needed, and make hard people decisions when required.

  • Map the company's core workflows from lead to cash: how work comes in, how it gets assigned, how it gets delivered, how customers are billed, and where things break.

  • Identify the first practical AI/process improvements, such as call summaries, customer follow-up, quote generation, document processing, CRM hygiene, reporting, scheduling, collections, internal knowledge search, or repetitive admin work.

  • Implement simple tools and workflows that employees actually use.

  • Build dashboards and weekly reports that show what is happening in the business without needing founder intuition.

  • Work with Aviara on budget, hiring, pricing changes, tuck-in opportunities, and the first 100-day operating plan.

First 90 Days

  • Build trust with the team, founder/seller, customers, and key local relationships.

  • Learn the business by sitting in the work, not just reviewing reports.

  • Produce a simple operating diagnostic: revenue drivers, customer segments, team strengths/gaps, margin leaks, process bottlenecks, cash issues, and AI/process opportunities.

  • Establish a weekly business review and a short list of measurable priorities.

  • Fix a few obvious problems quickly without breaking the culture.

What Good Looks Like

  • The team knows what matters each week.

  • Sales follow-up is no longer informal or founder-dependent.

  • Customer issues are visible and acted on.

  • Cash, receivables, pricing, and margins are watched closely.

  • Manual workflows are getting turned into repeatable systems.

  • Aviara can understand business performance from clean weekly updates.

  • The business is more organized, more commercial, and more scalable six months after you start.

Qualifications

  • 3-8 years of experience in operations, sales leadership, business operations, startups, consulting, private equity portfolio operations, search funds, local services, or entrepreneurship.

  • Evidence that you have owned outcomes, not just advised on them.

  • Strong commercial instincts. You are willing to sell, follow up, talk to customers, and ask for money.

  • Comfort managing people directly and holding a team to a higher standard.

  • Basic financial fluency: revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, cash, receivables, pricing, utilization, headcount, and working capital.

  • Strong Spanish and English communication for Argentina and Latin America roles.

  • High agency and low ego. You can do the messy work yourself before asking someone else to do it.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to reduce admin work, improve follow-up, and make the business easier to run.

Helpful but Not Required

  • Experience running or scaling an SMB, services business, professional services firm, software-enabled service company, agency, clinic, field-service business, or vertical-market software company.

  • Experience in Argentina, Latin America, or another emerging market.

  • Prior founder, chief of staff, BizOps, RevOps, sales, consulting, search fund, or portfolio operations experience.

  • Experience implementing CRM, finance systems, workflow tools, AI agents, or lightweight internal software.

Application Questions

  • Tell us about a business, team, or function you personally ran. What were the weekly metrics and what changed because of you?

  • Give an example of a messy operating process you fixed. What was broken, what did you change, and what happened?

  • How would you spend your first 30 days after taking over a founder-led services business?

  • Describe a time you had to push a team to a higher standard.

  • Are you willing to be hands-on with sales, customer calls, collections, hiring, process cleanup, and AI/tool implementation?

jobs.description:
Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.
  • Front-room participation in internal audits. Back-room participation in external audits.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all essential functions.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED AND/OR PREFERRED:

Strong understanding of other functional items including product development, design controls and risk management. Strong understanding of medical terminology, regulations, and guidelines related to medical devices and quality systems including FDA’s Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), MDD 93/42/EEC, MDR 2017/745, and ISO 13485.
  • Organization Skills - Information organized and accessible, maintains efficient workspace, manages time well
  • Product Expertise - Knows product features, understands marketplace, shares expertise with others
  • Professional Development - Seeks to identify one’s self-improvement opportunities at work and takes appropriate action to address
  • Project Management - Monitors status of projects, thoroughly deals with project details, holds project owners accountable, delivers clear, accurate depiction of status
  • Quality - Strives to eliminate errors, accurate work is a priority, seeks opportunities to improve product/services

Behavioral & Basic Skill Competencies

  • Communication – Communicates proficiently (written and verbal), delivers presentations, has good listening skills
  • Conflict Management - Good listener, committed to finding solution to problems, works well with difficult people

jobs.title: UX Researcher
jobs.excerpt: Highlights• Location: Spain Remote • Languages: Fluent in Russian and English About Fundraise UpWe’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all.
jobs.description:
Highlights

  • Location: Spain Remote
  • Languages: Fluent in Russian and English

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building alarge and complex product ecosystemthat serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a moderncheckout experience and customizable widgets(each a standalone SPA),donor, organization, and partner portals,admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.

About the role

Fundraise Up is building high-trust donation and fundraising experiences that help nonprofits grow their impact. We are looking for a UX Researcher to strengthen how UX research informs product decisions across the company.

You will focus on two areas: leading complex, ambiguous, high-impact UX research that informs product strategy, and building a scalable UX Research practice within the Design team. Designers will run simpler studies independently, while you provide the process, coaching, quality guardrails, and support that make research a consistent habit.

You will be the dedicated UX Research expert within the Research Team, working alongside Product and Marketing Researchers who will support you across your projects. You will bring deep UX Research expertise while collaborating closely with the wider Product, Design, and Analytics teams.

What You'll Do

  • Act as an active UX Research evangelist and change agent: proactively identify opportunities, coach and challenge colleagues, launch new initiatives.
  • Own and grow the UX Research practice: build a pragmatic research process for Design team, enable designers to run appropriate research independently, and create clear quality guardrails without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Lead high-impact research from the quarterly plan and run it end-to-end: intake brief → write methodology → conduct research → analyze → synthesize → present → push actions.
  • Choose the right method: interviews, usability tests, concept tests, surveys, desk research, competitive scans or others — based on uncertainty level, business goals, and timeline.
  • Run your work independently: access to tools/data, participant scheduling and confirmations, session logistics, note-taking, and documentation — no hand-holding.
  • Work closely with Product Analytics to connect quantitative and qualitative evidence. We work together and show a product manager a full picture of user behavior.
  • Experiment with new approaches and tools, from moderated and unmoderated testing to emerging AI-enabled methods such as synthetic users, where they can add real value.
  • Be the user's best friend: ensure user needs and constraints are represented in product decisions – not just opinions.

Requirements

  • Proven experience running research end-to-end with high ownership.
  • Experience working across both B2C and B2B products and audiences.
  • Fluent English — all participants are English-speaking; you moderate and present in English.
  • Regularly collect input from Sales, CS, Support, Marketing, Analytics and turn it into testable research questions.
  • High research quality bar: correct research methods, structured methodology, predictable timelines, ethical practice.
  • Use recruiting platforms and handle logistics yourself: access, scheduling, confirmations, tool setup, etc.
  • Use AI tools to speed up ops and synthesis (guides, notes, tagging/themes, survey drafts, summaries) while keeping human judgment and methodological rigor where it matters.
  • Be the team’s source of new knowledge: run a “research radar” across internal learnings, market/competitor moves, and high-signal UX/product sources, then share regular updates so the team stays current and avoids blind spots.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work. We will not teach you how to use AI, but we will give you everything you need, like unlimited Claude and support from AI-experienced colleagues.
  • Bring exceptional empathy and care for people: our users are nonprofits and donors—people doing good in the world—so you approach participants with respect, sensitivity, and high ethical standards.

Strong plus

  • NN/g certifications.
  • Academic/scientific research background (graduate/PhD track).
  • PostHog / Tableau (or similar analytics tools).
  • Productboard (or other insights repository tools).
  • Mentoring/teaching (workshops, onboarding, sharing research craft).

At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool — not an experimental one

We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €3,300 - €4,300 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 23 paid vacation days per year
  • 11+ paid public holidays per year
  • 5 company-paid sick leave days
  • English learning courses.
  • Relevant professional education.
  • Gym or swimming pool.
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • Co-working.
  • Remote working.

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

﻿Role Overview

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

Responsibilities

﻿

﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

2. User Needs & Automation

  • Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
  • Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

3. Product Development & Delivery

  • Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
  • Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration

  • Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
  • Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

5. Experimentation & Optimization

  • Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
  • Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
  • Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
  • Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
  • Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. (Examples will be requested).
  • Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
  • Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
  • Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
  • Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
  • Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
  • Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

Quantitative Strategy Development & Research

jobs.description:
About Collectly

Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation. Millions of patients navigate inefficient billing systems every day, while providers face delayed payments, rising administrative burden, and operational complexity.

Collectly applies artificial intelligence to automate workflows, accelerate cash flow, and modernize the patient financial experience; enabling healthcare organizations to operate more efficiently and focus on delivering care.

There could not be a hotter space to play in. Healthcare is a $4.9T industry and is adopting AI technology at 2.2x the rate of the rest of the economy. RCM is at the heart of this transformation as it has a clear and demonstrable ROI to our customers.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Talent Coordinator and Sourcer to join our Talent team. In this role, you will partner with the Talent Manager and Hiring Managers to ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. You will be responsible for scheduling interviews, managing logistics, and providing support to candidates and hiring partners.

Additionally, you will leverage your sourcing skills to identify and attract top talent through various channels. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to our recruitment efforts, improve processes, and play a key role in shaping our organizations talent acquisition strategy.

Key Responsibilities

    Coordination:

  • Partner closely with the Talent Manager and Hiring Managers to facilitate and streamline the interview process.

  • Schedule candidate interviews and coordinate logistics with accuracy and timeliness.

  • Manage the candidate experience, ensuring a positive and engaging journey that reflects our commitment to attracting top talent.

  • Support Talent Managers with job creation, as well as onboarding coordination and support.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Support efforts to standardize and document the hiring process.

    • Sourcing:

  • Utilize sourcing methods such as LinkedIn, job boards, and Boolean searches to identify and engage qualified candidates.

  • Provide innovative and scalable sourcing solutions to drive a robust talent pipeline.

  • Conduct proactive sourcing activities to identify potential candidates across various roles and departments, with a focus on passive candidates.

  • Review and screen resumes to assess candidate qualifications and fit.

  • Collaborate with the Talent Manager to develop effective sourcing strategies for hard-to-fill positions.

    • Process and Partnership:

  • Develop scalable processes and resources to enhance efficiency while maintaining a personal touch.

  • Cultivate productive relationships with cross-functional partners.

  • Communicate professionally and proactively with all stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

    Within the first 90 days, this individual will:

  • Be fully ramped on our ATS, scheduling tools, and interview process end-to-end.

  • Own interview scheduling and logistics independently for all open requisitions, with minimal oversight from the Talent Manager.

  • Have built strong working relationships with hiring managers and interview panels, understanding their availability, preferences, and process nuances.

  • Consistently deliver a candidate experience that’s accurate, timely, and reflects well on the business.

  • Be actively supporting background and reference check coordination as a routine part of the process.

  • Have supported the successful close of multiple hires end-to-end from a coordination standpoint.

    • Over two quarters, success includes:

  • Having the trust and process fluency to take on resume review, screening candidates for baseline qualifications and fit before they reach the Talent Manager.

  • Demonstrating sound, consistent judgement in resume screening, flagging strong candidates accurately and filtering out clear mismatches.

  • Having candidates sourced convert into actual hires.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, specifically recruiting coordination and sourcing in a B2B SaaS company,

  • Experience supporting Go-To-Market hiring (e.g., Sales, Account Executives, Implementation, Customer Success, Product, etc)

  • Familiarity with a variety of tools, including ATS, HRIS, scheduling tools, and LinkedIn sourcing.

  • Demonstrated accountability and a track record of taking ownership and problem-solving.

  • Strong communication and cross-collaboration skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving responsibilities.

  • Creative, curious, flexible, meticulous, and thoughtful approach to work.

  • Objective and adept at conflict resolution, seeking productive solutions to partnerships.

  • Enthusiasm for process improvement and refining the experience for partners and candidates.

  • Experience driving innovative process enhancements and supporting change management.

  • Alignment with Collectly's GTM Values:

  • We are owners - we have humility and put the team first.

  • We know our numbers - we are data-driven and understand how to impact our business internally and our customers' business externally.

  • We are AI powered - we automate easy repetitive tasks and research so we can solve harder problems and have a greater impact.

  • We are one with the Buffalo - we expect that there will be challenges along the way and, like the Buffalo, we confront these challenges head on by running INTO the storm.

Core Competencies

  • Sourcing & Pipeline Generation: Builds and maintains a consistent flow of qualified passive and active candidates using multi-channel, creative sourcing strategies.

  • Coordination & Logistics Management: Manages complex, multi-party scheduling and process logistics with precision, minimal errors, and strong follow-through.

  • Candidate Experience: Creates a professional, warm, and responsive experience for every candidate, regardless of outcome.

  • Data Integrity & ATS Management: Maintains clean, accurate, and audit-ready candidate requisition records; understands the importance of documentation for compliance and reporting.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicates clearly and proactively with hiring managers, candidates, and cross-functional partners, adjusting tone and format to the audience.

  • Adaptability & Prioritization: Manages competing priorities and shifting requisition needs in a fast-paced, evolving environment without losing accuracy or quality.

  • Discretion & Confidentiality: Exercises sound judgement with sensitive candidate and business information.

  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies process gaps and proposes scalable, practical solutions rather than waiting to be asked.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting or sourcing within healthcare, healthcare technology, or SaaS environments.

  • Experience with Lever (LeverTRM) or a comparable modern ATS.

  • Experience coordinating reference checks.

Why You'll Love It Here

jobs.description:
If you enjoy the innovation and flexibility of startups and want to work on some of society’s most pressing challenges, then you may be the right fit for our team. We have a pipeline of opportunities to achieve large-scale impact, and we have the resources to get them going. We are looking for entrepreneurial strategists who want to help address some of the largest social issues facing our world.

This role is a unique opportunity to be on the founding teams of startups and partnerships focused on social impact. You will work closely with social leaders, innovators, and entrepreneurs who are addressing some of the world’s biggest problems. Reporting to a Director, you will work across the Strategy & Build team to research, scope, shape, and prioritize the ideas and partners GDI takes on, and to develop initial blueprints into full-blown ventures. You will have the opportunity to landscape, analyze, and develop hypotheses across a wide range of sectors.

As a member of small entrepreneurial initiative teams, your attitude is that no task-is-too-small and your ethos is to dive into work that is both at the 30,000 foot strategic level and the 'in the weeds' tactical level when called for.

You will often be the person holding the work together: running workstreams end to end, managing relationships across funders, partners, and founding teams, and facilitating the conversations where strategy gets made. You will participate in (and at times lead) senior-level meetings with experts and partners. You will own workplans, budgets, and delivery. Although you will work closely with Strategy & Build Directors as managers, you are expected to exercise a high degree of autonomy and initiative and to take on significant responsibility.

A couple of notes on how we work:

  • This role will involve significant external consultations with global stakeholders and will require a work schedule that can periodically accommodate calls slightly earlier or later than usual work hours. At the same time, our teams respect personal boundaries and maintaining healthy work / life balance is an important part of our culture.
  • AI tools are increasingly part of the modern workplace, and that’s true at GDI. We’re looking for people who use them skilfully and thoughtfully: leaning on them to raise the quality and pace of their work, while keeping clear judgment about where they fall short.

Responsibilities

Strategy Development

  • Proactively identify the need for and execute complex impact, financial, market, and policy analyses.

Research + Communication

Donor Engagement

Support to GDI

Qualities of GDI Employees

Compensation and Benefits

Tell us about a time you had to get up to speed on something you knew nothing about and produce something useful quickly. How did you approach it?

GDI is only able to consider candidates based in and authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship. Global Development Incubator is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

From climate to agriculture, health to economic inclusion, we build across sectors to drive game-changing impact at scale. Whether the concepts originate from sector experts, or are developed and tested ourselves, we create new approaches to address persistent global issues.

jobs.excerpt: Quantitative Developer — Proprietary Trading Infrastructure We are partnering with a globally recognised prop trading firm to recruit a Quantitative Developer who will architect and build the core revenue engine from the ground up.
jobs.description:
Quantitative Developer — Proprietary Trading Infrastructure

We are partnering with a globally recognised prop trading firm to recruit a Quantitative Developer who will architect and build the core revenue engine from the ground up. This is not a standard software engineering role, it sits at the intersection of quantitative finance, low-latency systems engineering, and brokerage technology.

You will design, build, and optimise a proprietary trading bridge and risk engine that connects a 220,000+ user demo trading platform to real-world Liquidity Providers, identifying alpha and monetising it through high-speed execution. If you have a trader's mindset, a quant's toolbox, and an engineer's discipline, this is the role you've been waiting for!

Who they are

A global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, empowering the world's most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm — 220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

Your Role in Our Mission

You are not just writing code; you are building a money-making machine. We are seeking a Quantitative Developer with a deep "Trader's Mindset" to design, build, and optimize a proprietary bridge and risk engine.

Your primary mission is to unlock the value in our data. You will build the infrastructure that connects our demo environment to real-world Liquidity Providers (LPs), identifying our best traders and mathematically replicating their success in the live market via high-speed execution.

How You'll Make an Impact

The "Bridge" & Risk Engine

  • Architect and build a low-latency "Trading Bridge" that sits between our proprietary platform (MetaTrader/cTrader) and external Liquidity Providers.
  • Develop a sophisticated Risk Engine that analyzes thousands of demo traders in real-time to identify "toxic flow" (to hedge) and "alpha flow" (to copy/monetize).
  • Implement statistical models that filter noise from trader data to execute profitable replication strategies on real markets.

FIX Protocol & Connectivity

  • Act as the subject matter expert on the FIX Protocol (Financial Information eXchange). You will write the custom engines to manage sessions, parse messages, and handle order routing with various LPs and Prime Brokers.
  • Build aggregators that connect to multiple venues simultaneously to find the best pricing and execution speed.

Quantitative Modeling & Math

  • Apply advanced statistics (Time Series Analysis, Stochastic Calculus) to create pricing models and execution algorithms (TWAP, VWAP, Sniper) that minimize slippage.
  • Build a simulation environment that can replay millions of historical retail trades to validate your copy-trading algorithms before live deployment.

High-Frequency & Low-Latency Engineering

  • Optimize Python (and potentially C++/Rust modules) for microsecond-level latency. In FX and CFD arbitrage, milliseconds matter.
  • Ensure the system can handle massive bursts of quote updates and order events without clogging or crashing (AsyncIO, ZeroMQ, shared memory architectures).

What You Bring

  • FIX Protocol Expert: You know the FIX tags by heart (4.2/4.4). You have built or maintained a FIX engine that connects to real LPs.
  • Math & Stats Whiz: You have a strong academic or practical background in Mathematics, Statistics, or Quantitative Finance. You understand probability, variance, and risk modeling deeply.
  • Python Performance: You don't just write Python; you write fast Python. You know how to use numpy, pandas, cython, and asyncio to squeeze every bit of performance out of the interpreter.
  • Trading Architecture: Experience building Order Management Systems (OMS) or Execution Management Systems (EMS).
  • Brokerage Tech: Deep understanding of how Forex Brokers, ECNs, and Liquidity Providers operate (A-Book vs. B-Book execution, slippage, spread arbitrage).
  • Trading Platforms: Familiarity with the backend protocols of MetaTrader (MT4/MT5) or cTrader is a massive advantage.
  • C++ Experience: For the critical hot-paths of the execution engine.
  • Crypto/DeFi: Experience connecting to crypto exchanges (WebSocket/REST) alongside traditional FX.

Your X-Factor

  • We are looking for someone who understands the "Quantlane Model" — the ability to treat a prop firm not just as an education platform, but as a source of liquidity and alpha.
  • You possess the hybrid skill set of a Senior Software Engineer and a Quantitative Trader.
  • You understand Market Microstructure: You know what happens to an order after it leaves the terminal, how it hits the matching engine, and how to exploit inefficiencies in that process.
  • You are P&L Driven: You are not just building software; you are building a system designed to generate revenue.

Why Join Us?

This is a rare opportunity to build a hedge-fund-grade system from the ground up, backed by the data and capital of one of the world's fastest-growing prop firms. You will not be a cog in a machine; you will be the engine builder.

The future of fintech is algorithmic. Come build it with us.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is an Australian paediatric hearing services business that assesses children's hearing across clinic, school and home-visit settings, and delivers a growing program of hearing screenings in schools across NSW (expanding to 30–40 schools next year). Billing is mostly through Medicare and private patients, with a small but growing number of NDIS-funded families. The business is led by its Practice Owner, who this role reports to directly, supported by a small team of audiologists and casual screeners.

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • A full-time Practice Manager role — in Australian healthcare, this sits above a medical receptionist, owning the administrative and operational back end of the clinic (patient and referral administration, reporting, scheduling and compliance) rather than front-desk reception duties.

  • The role is split across two core areas: day-to-day patient and referral administration in the practice's patient management system, and end-to-end coordination of the school hearing screening program — from first enquiry through to the results summary sent back to each school.

  • This role is trusted with genuinely confidential information — referrals, clinical reports, Medicare and patient details, and student data — so accuracy and discretion matter on every task, not just the obvious ones.

  • This role is not asked to just follow instructions — it's expected to review its own work, ask questions, and genuinely learn a process once rather than needing it re-taught.

  • Day to day, this role works independently across several systems (a patient/practice management system, Excel, Outlook, Canva, SharePoint) and will regularly hit things that don't quite fit the standard process — a missing referral, a doctor not yet in the system, a parent's booking details not matching their child's. The right person investigates and resolves what they can before escalating, rather than deferring every question upward.

  • There's a lighter, ongoing layer of practice support on top of this — scheduling and rostering audiologists and casual screeners, social media content, SOP updates and compliance record-keeping — that adds variety without taking priority over the patient and school-screening workload.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

To independently and accurately manage patient and referral administration, and to coordinate the school hearing screening program end to end — on schedule, with genuine attention to detail and confidentiality — while escalating only genuine exceptions rather than routine questions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    ▸ Patient & Referral Administration

    • Upload doctor referrals to the correct patient profile, and create new patient records directly from an incoming referral

    • Create new doctor contacts in the system, sourcing correct details from the referral or the practice's website

    • Send completed clinical reports to doctors and parents once clinicians have finished them, and prepare clinician letters, including uploading the relevant audiogram

    • Keep patient profiles accurate and complete — correct formatting, Medicare details and contact information

      • ▸ School Screening Coordination

      • Manage enquiries from prospective schools and keep a database of contacted, interested, confirmed and declined schools

      • Reach out to returning schools each year to confirm the following year's screening dates, and manage the confirmation, flyer, e-contract and parent-broadcast process for each

      • Maintain the school screening schedule and prepare each school's screening list ahead of time, sending reminders at one month, two weeks and one day before the visit

      • Support the day of the screening visit remotely, including flagging any new bookings that come through

      • Process each school's PASS/REFER results after the visit, prepare the summary report, and update the master database

        • ▸ Staffing, Systems & Practice Support

        • Schedule and roster audiologists and casual screeners across clinic, school and home-visit services

        • Maintain accuracy across the practice management system, Excel trackers and the practice's master database

        • Support updates to SOPs and clinic guides, and help keep the staff compliance register (working with children checks, first aid, insurance, equipment calibration) current

        • Coordinate university clinical placement enquiries — sending the clinical handbook and information to new students and organising an introductory call

          • ▸ Marketing & Content Support

          • Help produce 2–3 educational social media posts per week aimed at schools and parents, and support content scheduling

            • ▸ Communication & Judgement

            • Ask a specific, informed question rather than guessing or defaulting to escalation — investigate first using the available data and SOPs

            • Recognise the difference between an inbound referral (confidential, internal use only) and an outbound report (requires parent consent to share) and handle each correctly

            • Own a mistake immediately and follow the correct process rather than hoping it goes unnoticed

              • ▸ Working Hours

            • Full-time, aligned to Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) business hours, working the same calendar as the Australian-based team

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Referrals, reports and patient records are accurate, complete and handled confidentially — first time, every time

  • A process taught once, through training, SOPs or videos, doesn't need to be retaught

  • Small discrepancies — a mismatched count, a missing contact — are caught and resolved independently, with only genuine exceptions brought to the Practice Owner

  • School screening visits run to schedule from first outreach through to the results summary, with nothing missed along the way

  • The Practice Owner can hand over patient and student information without needing to double-check the work behind it

MUST-HAVE (ESSENTIAL)

  • 3+ years' hands-on experience as a Practice Manager or running a clinic's admin — worth more than a formal qualification alone

  • Meticulous attention to detail — checks their own work rather than assuming it's right, especially with patient and clinical information

  • Learns a new system quickly from training and SOPs, retains it, and follows it independently without needing the same thing re-taught

  • Genuine initiative — investigates a discrepancy using the data and SOPs available, and comes back with a specific question rather than deferring everything upward

  • Understands, or can quickly learn, the difference between a confidential referral and an outbound report — and handles each correctly

  • Comfortable in a patient/practice management system alongside Excel and Outlook — can sort/filter data and spot a broken list

  • Discreet and professional handling genuinely confidential patient and student health information

  • Strong organisational skills to manage several school screening visits at once against fixed deadlines

  • Comfortable asking questions and raising concerns directly rather than waiting to be asked

  • Own computer/laptop and a private home office suitable for full-time remote work

  • Available full-time on hours aligned to Australian business hours (AEST)

NICE-TO-HAVE (DESIRABLE)

  • A formal qualification in practice management or healthcare administration (a bonus, not a substitute for experience)

  • Familiarity with a patient/practice management system such as Splose, Cliniko or Halaxy

  • Experience with Canva, SharePoint and/or scheduling social media content for a business

  • Experience coordinating with schools or in the education sector

  • Familiarity with NDIS-funded client coordination (most billing here is Medicare/private)

Required Experience

  • 3+ years' hands-on experience as a Practice Manager, or running the administration of a clinic or similar healthcare/allied health setting — this hands-on experience matters more than a formal qualification on its own

  • Comfortable handling confidential or sensitive information as a matter of course — healthcare, allied health, education or a similar regulated setting preferred

  • Demonstrated ability to learn a new system or process from training or SOPs and follow it independently afterwards, without repeated re-training

  • Comfortable working across multiple systems at once (a patient/practice management system, Excel, Outlook) to coordinate multi-step, deadline-driven work

  • Able to work full time on hours aligned to Australian business hours (AEST)

Required Skills

  • High attention to detail — checks their own work rather than assuming it's correct, particularly with names, dates, contact details and clinical information

  • Solid working Excel skills — comfortable sorting and filtering data and spotting when a formula or list looks broken; doesn't need to be formula-building level, but needs to trust and verify what the spreadsheet is showing

  • Genuine initiative — investigates a discrepancy or unclear situation before escalating it, and asks a specific question rather than a general one

  • Strong written English for professional correspondence with doctors, schools and parents, and comfortable asking questions and raising concerns directly

  • Comfortable and discreet handling confidential patient and student information
