jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Databricks, Security & Governance
jobs.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Peraton is seeking a Database Engineer SME with expertise in cloud data platforms and federal data governance to lead the database design, security implementation, and production migration for a federal data integration program. You will serve as the database authority for the project, ensuring all data is handled in compliance with federal security and governance standards within a hybrid AWS cloud environment.

Work Location: Remote

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of the harmonized data schema for federal species data within a cloud data lakehouse, reconciling structural and semantic differences across multiple source systems
  • Produce the field-level source-to-target mapping document, documenting transformation logic, data type conversions, null handling, and data lineage
  • Define and enforce metadata standards across all ingested datasets, ensuring consistency, traceability, and regulatory compliance
  • Design and implement automated data quality validation frameworks within ETL pipelines
  • Design and build the Metadata and Authoritative Source Registry, cataloging all data sources, ingestion pathways, update frequencies, and data stewardship contacts
  • Implement FIPS 140-compliant encryption and enforce NIST SP 800-171/800-172 database security controls and role-based access controls
  • Ensure Federal CUI Registry and data governance standards are applied to all data stored and processed within the platform
  • Lead database performance monitoring and optimization within the cloud data platform
  • Contribute to the Data Model Harmonization Report, providing database-layer schema design decisions, field-level mapping documentation, and metadata standard definitions for government review
  • Lead the development of the production migration runbook database components and execute database migration tasks during production cutover
  • Contribute to the Production Deployment Report, documenting database migration outcomes, post-deployment data validation results, and production monitoring findings
  • Lead the Final Operational Playbooks database documentation

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree and 12 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 10 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 14 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 16 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • Extensive years of database engineering experience with expertise in cloud data platforms
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, or equivalent cloud data lakehouse platforms
  • Proficiency in Python or Scala for ETL pipeline implementation, data quality framework development, and database automation scripts
  • Knowledge of FIPS 140, NIST SP 800-171/800-172, and federal CUI data governance standards
  • Experience designing and implementing RBAC and data security controls in federal cloud environments
  • Experience leading database migrations and production cutover activities on federal programs
  • Experience with version-controlled code repositories and peer review enforcement
  • Experience documenting post-deployment monitoring results and production validation outcomes
  • Strong data modeling, schema design, and metadata management skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or equivalent FedRAMP-authorized cloud environments
  • AWS Certified Database Specialty or AWS Certified Data Engineer certification
  • Experience with Apache Spark for large-scale distributed data processing within Databricks environments
  • Familiarity with federal environmental or geospatial data systems
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer or equivalent certification
  • Experience with ETL pipeline data quality framework design
  • Active Public Trust Clearance

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help lead the design, evolution, and reliability of the data platform supporting GolfNow and the broader sports technology ecosystem. You will shape data architecture, influence technical direction, and build scalable, high-quality data systems that enable analytics, reporting, and product innovation.

Working at the intersection of sports, media, and technology, you will partner closely with engineering, product, analytics, and business stakeholders to translate complex needs into durable data solutions. You will also help establish engineering standards, improve data quality and governance, and mentor other engineers across the team.

Why This Role Matters:

Data is foundational to how we understand our customers, improve our products, and make informed business decisions. In this role, you will help turn data into a strategic asset by strengthening the platforms and practices that support decision-making, unlock new product capabilities, and serve athletes, fans, partners, and internal teams at scale.

This is a fully remote role, with opportunities for intentional in-person collaboration approximately 10% of the time to support team connection, planning, and key initiatives.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architect, build, and evolve scalable data pipelines and platforms across AWS and Microsoft technology ecosystems.
  • Design data models, warehouse structures, and orchestration patterns that support analytics, product insights, reporting, and business intelligence.
  • Establish and continuously improve standards for data quality, governance, reliability, observability, performance, and scalability across the data lifecycle.
  • Partner with engineering, product, analytics, and business stakeholders to define data strategy and translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Mentor and guide data engineers, helping strengthen engineering practices, technical decision-making, and team capabilities.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and approaches that improve the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of data operations.

What You Bring:

  • Significant experience in data engineering, including a demonstrated record of designing, building, and scaling data platforms in cloud environments; experience with AWS is strongly preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, including experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines and optimizing large-scale data systems.
  • Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modeling, warehousing, orchestration, and distributed data processing concepts; experience with tools such as Airflow is valuable.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS technologies such as Glue, Lambda, and Step Functions, as well as infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
  • Proven ability to influence technical direction, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and collaborate across teams to deliver meaningful business and product outcomes.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to strong engineering standards, practices, and culture.

You will also bring Versant’s How We Do It behaviors to the way you work:

  • Trust: Take ownership of critical data systems, make sound technical decisions, and consistently deliver reliable, high-quality solutions.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate across engineering, product, analytics, and business teams to create solutions that support shared goals.
  • Transparency: Communicate clearly about technical trade-offs, risks, progress, data integrity, and decisions.
  • Agility: Adapt effectively as technologies, priorities, and business needs evolve while maintaining focus on quality and impact.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Proactively identify opportunities to innovate, simplify systems, improve processes, and expand how data creates value for the business.

Bonus Points:

Experience with one or more of the following would be beneficial:

  • SSIS, PowerShell, or SSRS
  • Tableau, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools
  • Agile development environments and collaboration tools such as Jira or Confluence

Why You’ll Love It Here:

You’ll work on high-impact data platforms at the intersection of sports, media, and technology, with the opportunity to influence data strategy and technical direction at scale. You’ll collaborate with experienced teams across disciplines, help shape how data supports products and decision-making, and contribute to an environment that values strong engineering practices, continuous improvement, and professional growth.

This role offers the flexibility of remote work while maintaining meaningful opportunities for in-person collaboration, team connection, planning, and key initiatives approximately 10% of the time.
